chapters.title: Chapter 3580 Defiant! III
paragraphs: A Pathway to the True Source of Amarantos was open!
Truly Severed and profoundly his, he dreamed with it as he pulled on the entanglements of the weavings of a mastermind and resonated them with Amarantos.
The result...was the entanglement being pulled over here.
They would have felt a nudge. But they would have to follow this nudge themselves to arrive here.

The moment his voice rang out, the visage of Azzurra shone with a terrifying glow as, around her, endless darkness erupted. Trillions of Source Runes gushed out alongside her actions as they spread out in this space painted with gold clouds- almost as if seeking to get control of it!
But...
"This is MY Dream."
Noah spoke out coldly.
And in the next moment, any and all erupting weavings disappeared and collapsed as if they never existed!
Only golden clouds rolled around calmly. Azzurra's dark hair glimmered as she looked at him coldly. Defiantly!
After his mention of McAllister...
"Noah Osmont, is it?" "The one and only." Noah nodded as he looked at Azzurra up and down, peering into her weavings as much as possible as he continued.

"Are you a Dreamer too? I sensed a greater resonance than it should have been possible under the banner of Amarantos...you should have this Rune as well. What are you? And why exactly was it pertinent for the Logos of the Wheel to ensure my disappearance into Hell Terra Firma? For you to send a bad Father to try and kill me? If I ask nicely like this, do you think you will answer easily?"
His words were tyrannical and casual.
Azzurra still looked at him coldly while gazing around this shocking dream, the Rune of Amarantos buzzing in her eyes as she said nothing!
Noah looked at her coldly as his eyes finished their evaluation.
"Azzurra."
He dome out coldly while pages of golden records flickered around him.

"I've perused your weavings from all that McAllister has given me. In the past eons, the missions you gave out for the Logos of the Wheel all seemed inclined to aid in the flow of the Wheel of Existence one way or another. But at a certain point in time, you changed. Missions that went against the flow began to be given, and you became less and less present within the Logos. What changed, Little Azzurra? What caused you to turn your back on the Flow of the Wheel and join a group that now threatens Megalocides across countless Frequencies of Existence?"
His words caused her expression to change as she finally and truly looked at him.
Her eyes held distaste as she shook her head.
"A creature like you does not understand anything. I do not go against the weavings of the wheel, and those I am with...only seek an alteration of weavings, and not destruction!"
Her gaze was fierce.
Noah looked at her coldly as he sat on a cloud of gold, knowing he did not have too much time.
"Yes, just like they did not seek the destruction of the Prime Frequency of Life."
WAA!
Her eyes buzzed as she heard this, looking towards him sternly as he continued.

"Are you having fun there? Watching over the countless quintillions in the lands you helped kill? I ask this because I mean to disturb your weavings. Because I can see that you, Little Azzurra, hold a trace of doubt in your eyes."

"It is why I detest creatures like you. I came to find you and planned to decimate the weavings of some grand Mastermind who was behind missions that helped bring about a change, but I instead find a creature with decent enough complexity, and yet she shows hesitation throughout her whole being. Otherwise, you would not have easily entered this dream. You would not still be here. I can see it in your weavings as clear as day. After you did all of this, are you only now starting to have doubts? Do those you are with know you have these doubts?"
HUUM!
The greater he was in complexity, the more he could see.
And the Pathway to the True Source of Amarantos...was able to innately pick up even more the moment an entity became ensnared in a dream!
Azzurra seemed to know this as at this time, her eyes burned with Runes of Amarantos that surged and multiplied to cover her body entirely.
"You talk a lot of rubbish, Noah Osmont. I am not someone with doubts about the path I am on! What needs to be done must be done. What-"

"Fuck off. I am short on time as the entity you and the Faceless Lifeforms follow has obtained something I don't particularly like him to have. If this dream with you is a useless one, I will get the answers with your main body. Tell me, how is the Prime Frequency of Life right now? Have you all turned into a bastion of a fortress?"
His figure rose from the golden clouds he sat on.
Azzurra looked at him with inexplicable shock as at this moment, he had kept her in a dream long enough to obtain the coordinates of where she was!
After her shock faded, she shook her head incredulously as she harrumphed.
"Come! Things can then be finished off. What are you before the might of multiple Prime Source Complexities? Multiple Greater Source Complexities?!"
Her eyes carried rage and lividity as she knew Noah was right.
She had observed the Prime Frequency of Life.
The Lifeforms that Giuseppe aligned himself with.
She understood their plight.

She saw those whose weavings held determination to do whatever it took. She saw their progeny as the moment they arrived into the Prime Frequency of Life, they ran around with a sense of freedom and happiness that had seemingly not been in their life for eons.
But...it all also felt so off and foreign that the distortion of weavings of existence threw her off!
She asked herself, what more would have to be done? What more would Giuseppe lead others to do that she would follow?
And when it was all over, would the weavings of the Wheel be at all close to what she knew?

chapters.title: Chapter 3581 Defiant! IV
paragraphs: Noah looked closely at Azzurra as he shook his head.

At times, he theorized and imagined what terrifying enemies were behind all the changes and life-altering events across frequencies, as they were thought to be complex beings doing things for terrifying reasons. But at the end of it all, he comes to find someone emotionally driven and filled with hesitation.
The grand Black Cat that McAllister showed him the weavings of.
An entity at the very precipice of the Greater Source Complexity as she nearly grasped Prime Source Complexity!
And yet he could play her like a fiddle as, at this time, the only enemy he did not pin down and seemed to have genuinely complex weavings for what he was doing...remained Bob.
Bob!

To find out exactly what he could be doing right now, Noah moved as the Pathway to the True Source of the Megalos burned brightly. The Pathway leading to the True Source of Outerversal burned brilliantly as, at this moment, Noah activated the True Severed Outerversal Regnum of Existence!
A terrific obsidian stellar brilliance covered him as with it; he could cast his weavings into any Megalos within a Frequency of Existence!

So at this moment, he cast his Regnum towards a Frequency that even the Singed were watching carefully to understand what was done and how it could be prevented, but they never entered as within, normal weavings of the Wheel were tremendously deteriorated while the abnormal weavings of the Faceless Lifeforms were considered normal. Going within and fighting was tantamount to suicide.
For many.
But then, there was him.
A man with the newly designed Source of Ordo Ab Chao, whose very existence held constant explosions of complexity due to containing all three states of Existence!
He was defiant in the face of what others considered impossible.
He was defiant and did what others considered suicide!
HUUM!
Black brilliance shone around another body of his as it began tearing across a place he could barely make any headway in.
A weaving filled with darkness that he appeared in after he truly severed everything.

Traversing across it...seemed to be the fastest to go from one Frequency of Existence into another, as if this torrid space of complete darkness was some blueprint or coding that held hidden pathways to everything!

True Severed Outerversal Regnum of Existence burned brilliantly, Noah's weavings tearing across complexity as after his entrance into the Dead Prime Frequency of Genesis where he now stood alone, he went onto the second Frequency apart from his own.
The Prime Frequency of Life that was under the banner of the enemy, and yet he entered it without fear!
As someone on the Cycle of Ordo, what exactly did he have to fear?
Mysara swept across the Megalos Beyond as she cleared out any last Remnants of the Faceless Lifeforms.
Her gaze remained somber as she was among the Singed who were monitoring what had changed with the Prime Frequency of Life.
And what they analyzed was an utter violation of the flow of the Wheel!
As if land and earth had been twisted.
What was once white was now black. What was natural for the flow of the Wheel was now backwards!
If any common Greater or even Prime Source Entity or Singed entered the weavings of that Frequency currently, they would come to find that even exerting the power of a Lesser Source would be hard.
The flow of the Wheel was twisted that much!
Meanwhile, the Singed observed weavings of Lifeforms with circular masses of obsidian bodies, their musing feeling so extremely different from everything they knew.
The Prime Sources of the Singed continued to monitor this Frequency as of this moment, it was already considered lost and irrecoverable.
The most they could do was gather information on their enemies as...!

Mysara's blue eyes trembled as she finished ripping apart another set of Faceless Lifeforms, and she nearly tumbled out of the skies as her body that was among the few designated Singed observing the Prime Frequency of Life saw...a burst of resplendent weavings erupting out within the center of the enemy base- these weavings manifesting into a form of a man she knew very well!
The color drained from her face as she shouted out incredulously at seeing the visage of Noah appearing amidst clusters of countless Faceless Lifeforms.
"O Origin Singed!!!"
Across complexities of weavings of Existence.

Within a Prime Frequency of Life that always had a glorious allure of brilliance, with its Expanse filled with verdant Strings of Existence and serene domains that emanated the glorious allure of life.

Currently, pervasive Obsidian radiances spread out all across it- burning Dark Towers releasing waves of complexities and droves of Faceless Lifeforms that seemed to be coming out without end from these Towers.
Within such a place.
"Yes, we are ready to...!"
Noah heard the voices of countless beings all at once as he calmly appeared near the location where the weavings of Azzurra were locked onto.

He saw her floating near a man whose body held half of a veiled suit of a Faceless Lifeform hanging around his waist- as if it were simply a suit he adorned before and was even getting ready to have it fully cover his body again.
Both Azzurra and this being turned to look towards him the moment he arrived in shock, alongside those who were near them.

Circular Lifeforms whose bodies were akin to wriggling black masses- with three of them burning with the terrifying complexity of a Prime Source while there were dozens stretched out throughout this place who were radiating the grandeur of Greater Source!
Those of the Lesser Source were in the hundreds.
Noah arrived at such a place as his gaze did not change, and he calmly looked around as Azzurra was looking at him as if she had seen a ghost- not able to believe that he actually came!

Why...would he come to a place with multiple Prime Source Complexities that could make the strongest of entities across the frequencies steer clear of? Especially within a Frequency whose weavings of the Wheel were entirely distorted?!
The answer was something many of them simply didn't even think of.
As a man in a Cycle of Ordo, he simply held no fear as nothing...could damage his weavings!
A stunned silence settled onto a domain filled with complexity on this day.

chapters.title: Chapter 3582 Indestructible! I
paragraphs: Noah floated grandly, his figure adorned in a white blue robe that had etchings of infinity symbols throughout.
His dark hair flowed down as if he were an ancient Emperor, his fair skin emanating a glow of luster even in this dark space as his eyes...burned with unfathomable radiance!
Behind him, an aurora of multicolored wings gloriously flowed as after he looked at Azzurra and those around her, he actually turned his head calmly to stare at everything else.
As if even they did not matter!
His casual demeanor and nonchalant manner threw many people off here, with the figure of Giuseppe reacting first as his body began to burn with the shocking brilliance of a Prime Source.
Nearby, two black masses had the faces on their circular bodies become heavy, while one still held the full adornment of the Veil of a Faceless Lifeform as his face had no expression to show!
Three Prime Source entities.
Dozens of Greater Sources as powerful if not more powerful than Persephael.
All of them did not yet make a move as they did not understand the newly appearing entity, and had not accurately gauged his power as they did not make a move yet!
There were millions of their people here.
The vast majority having not even grasped a Source of a Pathway.
This was akin to their home base that an enemy had just now entered as they had to move carefully!
With his hand calmly behind his back, Noah even turned his body away from the cluster of beings near Azzurra as he looked at the Dark Towers stretched throughout these domains here.
The constant flow of obsidian life forms coming out.

And the fact that in these surroundings, there seemed to exist weavings that really sought to put down his own- as if he was existing some place he shouldn't. But the glow of his lineage alone pulsed such an oppression away!
True Severed Origin Osmontian.
A man with three states of Matter surging and exploding within him as he constantly and passively had his complexity rising!

"I was curious to understand. The reason for all the deaths and carnage. What could possibly be driving those behind all of this? I've come across so many beings over the years as everytime, I tell myself that surely, it is not because they wish to just be stronger beings or those seeking greater complexity. That the masterminds behind all of this are complex creatures with heavy reasoning behind the things they do. I have so far only been disappointed as I ask you all...why do all of this?"
At this moment he looked at the altered Prime Frequency of Life and spoke out.

"I was curious to understand. The reason for all the deaths and carnage. What could possibly be driving those behind all of this? I've come across so many beings over the years as everytime, I tell myself that surely, it is not because they wish to just be stronger beings or those seeking greater complexity. That the masterminds behind all of this are complex creatures with heavy reasoning behind the things they do. I have so far only been disappointed as I ask you all...why do all of this?"
He asked nonchalantly as if he were talking about the weather.
Giuseppe looked at such a being sternly as his complexity scaled up, his deep voice echoing out.
"Who are you? Why does it matter why we do all of this? It is done because it has to be done!"
WAA!
His musings carried an undeniable air.
He was ready to attack!
Noah did not even turn back to look as he spoke softly.

"I'm someone you all have tried to kill repeatedly. Noah Osmont, in the flesh. And I just became curious about all of this and sought to understand before I utterly destroy everything. Sometimes, understanding can prevent so much, you know?"
Understand before he utterly destroyed everything!
Such words caused the Lifeforms here to become livid as the three Prime Source Faceless Lifeforms began to burn with brilliance.
Giuseppe looked at this as there were still too many unknowns, with his raising his hand to hold them back as the name Noah Osmont...he knew!
After all, he was the one to give this name and many others out to Azzurra.
He turned to look at her as he saw her grave expression, and he spoke out grandly.
"I know of you. A component of the Change that needed to go. Is that why you are here, for revenge?"
Noah stopped looking around and turned towards Giuseppe.
He saw this complex being standing side by side with Azzurra as it was easy to read the complexity between them!
He shook his head at such a scene as Azzurra seemed to be frozen at the fact that he was here.
"Were you the one to give my name out for the mission?"
He wanted a confirmation.
And grandly, the man beside Azzurra with the suit of Faceless Lifeforms adorning half his body nodded grandly!

"I was the Architect of the Change. To create an environment conducive to certain elements. To get it done, entities with a heavy flow of the weavings of the Wheel had to be destroyed, displaced, or turned. I did not know who you were or what you stood for. If your plight is with me, we can take it elsewhere."
There were too many Lifeforms here.
A clash would be utterly disastrous when they just arrived to set everything up!
Noah saw such an intent in his eyes as he spoke coldly.

"You allow entire Megalos of a Frequency to die, and yet care so much about the deaths of these Lifeforms? My disappointment only continues to grow at the so called masterminds behind all of this as let me know if I am wrong here. Let me know that it is not something as stupid as you are somehow seeking even greater complexity, so you join hands with them..."
Noah turned his gaze towards the three Faceless Lifeforms as he continued.

"And they...are Lifeforms seeking to alter the flow of the Wheel to carve out a home for themselves. Tell me it's not that stupid. That all the Change, the deaths, and chaos does not come down to outsiders seeking a place to call home, so they enact a genocide across Megalos to make it happen. Did it not occur to you all that there are many other ways to make such a thing happen? Is everything really that fucking stupid?!"
HUUM!
As he spoke, his eyes radiated a terrifying pressure as he seemed akin to a judge about to lay down interminable judgment!

Giuseppe looked at such a being sternly as his complexity scaled up, his deep voice echoing out.
"Who are you?
Why does it matter why we do all of this?
It is done because it has to be done!"
WAA!
His musings carried an undeniable air.
He was ready to attack!
Noah did not even turn back to look as he spoke softly.
"I'm someone you all have tried to kill repeatedly.
Noah Osmont, in the flesh.
And I just became curious about all of this and sought to understand before I utterly destroy everything.
Sometimes, understanding can prevent so much, you know?"
Understand before he utterly destroyed everything!
Such words caused the Lifeforms here to become livid as the three Prime Source Faceless Lifeforms began to burn with brilliance.
Giuseppe looked at this as there were still too many unknowns, with his raising his hand to hold them back as the name Noah Osmont...he knew!
After all, he was the one to give this name and many others out to Azzurra.
He turned to look at her as he saw her grave expression, and he spoke out grandly.
"I know of you.
A component of the Change that needed to go.
Is that why you are here, for revenge?"
Noah stopped looking around and turned towards Giuseppe.
He saw this complex being standing side by side with Azzurra as it was easy to read the complexity between them!
He shook his head at such a scene as Azzurra seemed to be frozen at the fact that he was here.
"Were you the one to give my name out for the mission?"
He wanted a confirmation.
And grandly, the man beside Azzurra with the suit of Faceless Lifeforms adorning half his body nodded grandly!
"I was the Architect of the Change.
To create an environment conducive to certain elements.
To get it done, entities with a heavy flow of the weavings of the Wheel had to be destroyed, displaced, or turned.
I did not know who you were or what you stood for.
If your plight is with me, we can take it elsewhere."
There were too many Lifeforms here.
A clash would be utterly disastrous when they just arrived to set everything up!
Noah saw such an intent in his eyes as he spoke coldly.
"You allow entire Megalos of a Frequency to die, and yet care so much about the deaths of these Lifeforms?
My disappointment only continues to grow at the so called masterminds behind all of this as let me know if I am wrong here.
Let me know that it is not something as stupid as you are somehow seeking even greater complexity, so you join hands with them..."
Noah turned his gaze towards the three Faceless Lifeforms as he continued.
"And they...are Lifeforms seeking to alter the flow of the Wheel to carve out a home for themselves.
Tell me it's not that stupid.
That all the Change, the deaths, and chaos does not come down to outsiders seeking a place to call home, so they enact a genocide across Megalos to make it happen.
Did it not occur to you all that there are many other ways to make such a thing happen?
Is everything really that fucking stupid?!"
HUUM!
As he spoke, his eyes radiated a terrifying pressure as he seemed akin to a judge about to lay down interminable judgment!

chapters.title: Chapter 3583 Indestructible! II
paragraphs: A single man spoke to clusters of beings with heavy complexity as he showed no fear!
At his words, they all became even more stern as Giuseppe's eyes showed growing rage.
"Our weavings are not that simple! Things are never so simple! Enough of this- protect those nearby, let us bring this to a close!"
HUUM!

His body spilled with incorrigible power as behind him, the Three Prime Source Faceless Lifeforms moved to surround Noah, while the dozens of Greater Sources further formed a ring in the periphery as the circular black masses of Lifeforms and Dark Towers slowly began to be moved back from here.
"I, Giuseppe, shall take you on!"
A Prime Source.
It was far too brilliant to even comprehend as the moment he moved...
His fist smashed toward Noah, and in front of it, everything cracked.
Space, weavings, existence...everything became like a shattered mirror, the weavings of the Wheel themselves distorting as these cracks extended towards Noah's position!
Any Existence they came across, they would shatter.
They shattered the very weavings of existence as by the time they reached Noah's figure...
BZZT!
Everything around him shattered, but his visage only glowed with a radiant white light as it remained unfettered!
He didn't even move a muscle. He didn't activate any weavings.
He did not alter anything or do anything!
And yet...
Giuseppe became grim at such a weaving as his body flickered, riding across the cracks of weavings he had caused to appear right above Noah.
His hand swung down again as it cracked any remnants weavings of existence, but when it was inches away from Noah...the shocking force just faded as if he was entirely impervious to it!
He simply looked ahead, his eyes showing an increasingly cold light as he withstood a Prime Source Complexity...without so much as lifting his hand!
Those watching this became dazed.
"OOOH!"

Giuseppe's weavings tumbled like a storm as he used both of his hands to smash down, the attack being so heavy that the cracks of existence spread out far- to the point that one of the Prime Source Faceless Lifeforms had to stop them as they stretched out too far.
The Prime Source Faceless Lifeform roared out as illusory obsidian towers appeared around it en masse, burning with an inextinguishable black flame as they formed a wall over the coming cracks!
And...
BOOM!
Over half of the illusory obsidian towers crumbled while the rest had cracks spreading throughout them.
A crack even lacerated the suit that the Faceless Lifeform wore as its obsidian mass spilled out!
The attack was that heavy even against a Prime Source- the hands of Giuseppe seemingly carrying a form of Raw Power that decimated entire weavings of existence themselves.
And yet against the one at the center of the impact...
He shook his head coldly as he remained unaffected.
He gazed out at the millions of lifeforms here as he spoke coldly.
"Then it seems destruction must be met with destruction. What utter stupidity."
He waved his hands as in the next moment, a statue bound by rope and simmering with a silver white light appeared in his hands.
A statue!
And yet the moment it appeared, all Greater Sources felt a tremendous sense of trepidation while all remaining entities below this level of power felt the threat of certain death!
Giuseppe's eyes burned as he looked around to see the weavings of death and decimation around the Faceless Lifeforms, thinking back to his agreement with them as he could not have this happen!
In the distance, Azzurra observed everything and saw the eyes of Giuseppe.
She knew him too well as the distress she saw...was one akin to everything he had worked for coming down crumbling!
She felt pained at this as she called out.
"WAIT!"
A piercing cry.
But it did not ring out in the Prime Frequency of Life.
It rang out in a Dream amidst rolling golden clouds!
She called out with a difficult expression as it was her figure within that dream that did this, but in doing so- the rope that was about to be released on a certain statue stopped!
Noah's weavings inside the Amarantos Dream looked towards her coldly as he spoke out.
"You have the span of a nanosecond."
WAA!
He gave her a time limit as her weavings moved fast, her expression filled with complexity and determination as she spoke out.
"You have been looking for the one responsible for all this, right?"
As she spoke, she felt her heart breaking as the moment she did this, she felt like she was betraying all the things she stood for these past eons- all the things she stood by Giuseppe for!
But she saw the errieness of the weavings of those he was aligned with. And now, if everything he worked for was about to break down...
A buzz of confusion swirled around her as, in the distance, Noah looked at her and spoke out as, finally, his weavings caught something.
"You all are no masterminds. You are mere pawns. I want the man behind all of this- the one even you may not know, but your man over there, Giuseppe, does. The one he is receiving orders from."
Bob.
At the end of the day, it all led back to Bob, and what this being truly planned to do.
He had to catch traces of this being as even if he destroyed masses of weak Faceless Lifeforms, he would not be any closer to him.
So...
He looked at a weak point in all these weavings.
Why this dream was still active!
His weavings locked onto Azzurra as she spoke heavily.

"Destroying everything there will not get you anything. Giuseppe has a direct link to the one controlling everything. Do not destroy everything he worked on as per his agreement with them, and I...I will deliver the one behind all this to you. I will remain at the core of their weavings and let you know the moment he makes contact or where he will be! I will..."
She felt disheartened as she said this, as if her very heart was burning!
And Noah gazed towards her with a terrifying light of power, his eyes radiating waves of splendor!

chapters.title: Chapter 3584 Spy! I
paragraphs: A Greater Source.
Azzurra!
When he saw her, he was disappointed as he had thought she would be someone who should have been a great mastermind, but it turned out she was simply following orders.
The one who orchestrated his entry into Hell Terra Firma, a creature that he found to have been mixed in a state of doubt and confusion?
It was laughable!
At this moment, it seemed that the one behind it all could be attributed to Bob.
Bob!
And to get to this being, he could only utilize the clear lines of weaknesses.
"What do you know about Bob?"
He asked her coldly as they exchanged weavings rapidly in a short span of time.
"Bob?" And Azzurra carried herself while blinking with confusion, only replying right after.
"A Watcher of the Wheel we locked away right after the change. Why..."
She didn't even know who she had been taking orders from this whole time.
Noah further shook his head as he voiced out coldly.
"I hate creatures like you."
WAA!

"Weak-minded, and easy to change all because of...emotions. You say you will deliver the true mastermind behind all of this to me, but I do not trust someone as weak as you to do something that critical. And I surely will not go based on your word. If there is any ounce of complexity and commitment inside of you, then stand by the decision you have made fully. If I am to stop my movements out there at this moment, I need to know they will yield sure results."
His eyes flashed coldly. And Azzurra began to feel rising anger herself as she had already come this far, and this being before she continued to be unreasonable!
"What more do you want?!"

"I do not want anything more apart from the Mastermind, but the one to present him to me cannot be in the state she is in right now. I do not trust it. In exchange, I need to alter your weavings to ensure no possible mistakes. So, are you committed, Black Cat?"
Was she committed?
Memories of Giuseppe and all the things they had talked about flashed through her eyes as she ground her teeth while staring at Noah coldly.
An evil, manipulative creature was how she saw him.
But at this moment, even someone of a Greater Source felt helpless against a being who stood unfettered against any attacks from a Prime Source Complexity!
She nodded firmly.
For him.
For the one she loved. What was another change when she had already gone through so much?
HUUM!
The roiling clouds of gold in this Amarantos Dream churned as Noah clenched his fist, the dark-haired figure of Azzurra instantly changing position to appear right before him as he spoke out coldly.
"Bring over 90% of your complexity into this weaving of a Dream."
Most of her complexity lay within the Prime Frequency of Life where she was watching Noah holding a statue bound by rope that caused her and other Greater Sources to feel waves of trepidation.

At this moment, the rune of Amarantos flashed in her eyes as most of her being flowed into it, her body in the Amarantos Dream becoming more and more solidified as it continued to stare at Noah coldly!

He bothered not for her looked as his palm faced upwards, the golden brilliance of gold reflected on it before in the next moment, a dazzling pillar of white gold flames erupted out and showed an illusory weaving of a flame that held a glorious road at its center.
The Pathway to the True Source of the Singed.
When his son stepped on this Pathway for his choice, he became a Singed at that moment.
It was a moment that made it abundantly clear that Noah himself could burn others and allow them to become Singed.
And if he had to turn someone and have them be his spies...it had to be someone whose body was burning with weavings he could easily control!

Now, she did not walk on the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed willingly as for her...Noah's hand holding the representation of this pathway moved forward like a spear and pierced into her stomach.
The sound was heavy as Azzurra gritted her teeth.
"That was for partly being responsible for sending me to Hell Terra Firma."

Noah spoke out coldly as he could see the light in her dark eyes clearly, the place he pierced his hand into her body beginning to burn as he grasped on the vast majority of her Greater Source and began to change it!
While looking into her eyes, he saw the clear and complex Runes of Amarantos as he asked.
"When did you obtain the Rune of Amarantos?"
She held these Runes even before he pulled her in the dream.
And with a pained expression as her very Source was being burnt, she spat her words out with hatred in reply.
"I've had them all my life."
She had them...all her life?
She did not go to a Megalos Beyond in all the Myriad Megalos Variations and Transformations out there and obtain them from the weavings of the Great Beyonder?!
Noah looked at this entity closely as he thought of the Omnifather.
Like the Beyonder, he was gone and nowhere to be seen as the current prospect was them being in a place none of them could see- protecting them from threats they didn't even know existed.
But there was a Remanant of the Omnifather.
This Azzurra could not be some residual thing that the Beyonder left behind, right?
WUU!
Noah's weavings buzzed with complexity.
It was a possibility.
Entrench a part of himself, or in this case, it was actually herself, into weavings that would act to protect the Frequencies of existence.
With no memories of anything, she eventually veered off as at the very end, as a great threat that she helped propagate spread, she is turned to be someone who could help stop it?
"Is that the flow of the Wheel...?"
His voice was cold as he thought about this, and yet before him...
"What the fuck are you talking aboouut!!"
Azzurra roared out as her whole body was aflame, her Source being scorched and turned into something else entirely!

chapters.title: Chapter 3585 Spy! II
paragraphs: Scorching.
Her whole being was scorched inside out; her Source being utterly overturned as its very center, there was only the Flame.
That Flame altered everything as even in her eyes, the Runes of Amarantos turned to gold, her strands of hair on her head becoming dark gold while her Source felt even more exuberant.
"Haa...haa!"
She breathed out heavily as Noah's hand left her stomach, still feeling the flames he put inside her continue to burn every recess of her Source as at this moment...
"You belong to me now."
BOOM!
The voice was cold and heavy.
As if it despised her.
She gritted her teeth as she despised him too!
"I can collapse your weavings at any point, and I will know if anything is being kept from me. So, speak."
He sat back on the golden clouds, his hands freely resting on his knees as he looked like a thug while gazing at her.
A flaming gold robe replaced the dark one that Azzurra was adorned in, tears spilling in her eyes as truly, his words were not wrong.
Her Source was now bright with the Flame of the Wheel of Existence that her own man, Giuseppe, was intent on going against!
If ever he found out...

Her heart beat frantically as she made sure the dark-haired and dark-robed body of hers in the Prime Frequency of Life did not show any changes, and she pulled even more of its weavings into this body here to make sure that nothing regarding the flame leaked out.
And she began to speak as her eyes became filled with determination.
She overcame many things before, she would overcome this as well.
And as soon as she figured out a method for Giuseppe to attain what he wanted, or if she could just get him to stop...everything would be alright.
Right?

"They...whoever Giuseppe and the others listen to has planned for us to take care of the Singed next. We are to attack the Prime Frequency of Flames and do the same thing we did for the Prime Frequency of Life."
"Oh?"
Noah only nodded coldly at this as he thought about many things.
"Tell me the movements of the Faceless Lifeforms across Frequencies, and how the Logos of the Wheel aids them. My people will be hunting soon and need clear targets to hunt."
He said such words as Azzurra looked towards him as if he were a monster.
"You know...they are just looking for a home where their very weavings won't be burned just by existing."
She spoke as she recalled the Faceless Lifeforms that were younger. The joy they had in their weavings just by being able to run around freely.
Noah's gaze turned even colder as he waved his hands.

"And that's what makes this all so damn stupid. There are so many ways such a thing could have been done, but they went the genocidal route and burned everything for everyone here. What is good and bad...I will decide for myself. They decided for themselves, and you've made your own decisions. Now, live by them and speak."
WAA!
His eyes kept their coldness as Azzurra gathered herself on the golden clouds, her figure burning with white gold flames carrying a unique new flow of the Wheel.
Outside of the Dream.
In the Prime Frequency of Life.
WAP!

The statue bound in rope, emanating a heart-rending aura, disappeared, the stifling sensation wrapping around everyone being gone along with it as Noah gazed at Giuseppe, who also gazed at him coldly.
His body burned unfathomably powerful as his Prime Source was heavy, whereas if Noah had not been in the Cycle of Ordo, he did not know whether he could have faced this being.
He then looked at the masses of Lifeforms, the three Prime Source Faceless Lifeforms falling in his eyes the most as he spoke out while a portal bloomed behind him.
"Let this serve as a warning."
...! A warning.
He said this while gazing at all of them a few seconds longer, his gaze even returning to Giuseppe and passing over to Azzurra, who turned her eyes down as even in that time...nobody attacked him!
He then calmly walked into the portal and disappeared as finally, those here felt like they could breathe again.
"Fuck!" Giuseppe roared out as existence crumbled around him.
"Noah Osmont...Noah Osmont!"
He uttered out this name as if he were cursing it before he turned to the three Prime Source Faceless Lifeforms.
"I told you all that these Weavings of the Wheel still hold other powerful unknown Complexities that may be able to threaten you all. Bringing out you people this early..."
"We know!" A Faceless Lifeform roared while looking at the thousands of Dark Towers stretching out across this Frequency.
"We will divide our people and not have them all in one place. Then, we can continue the mission as needed. If that Osmont comes again, he will not be able to use our people to threaten us!"
The Prime Source Faceless Lifeforms looked at each other as they began to move.
Giuseppe shook his head and sighed as he warped beside Azzurra.
He held her head and kissed it as he voiced out lowly.
"My love, I gave you the weavings of that target from his entanglements. Why did you not tell me his complexity or the progress with him?"
He didn't yell at her. He just asked calmly as Azzurra looked into his eyes, but she was not able to hold her gaze as she looked at his chest while replying.
"I left it to McAllister due to their entanglement, but it seems he is gone. We were wrong about him."
She said this softly as at this moment, she could not bear to look into his eyes, lest he be able to see right through her and know that from here on out, she would be acting as a spy against him!
The flow of the Wheel continued unabated.
The flow of the Wheel went towards unknown directions.
At this time.
Back within Noah's home Frequency.

Another body of his floated in the Expanse as he watched Ruination bring the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel pulsing with the Heart of Megalos Ynnere up, her hand wiping sweat from her brows as she voiced out valiantly.
"It is done, Master."
All weavings of the Change within the Expanse were eradicated, as it should be immune to any grand changes from here on out.
This Frequency, at the very least... should be secured!

He would have to secure other frequencies as well because, from the continued analysis of the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence under the Infiniverse Megalos, she had affirmed that one of the larger possible uses of this flame...could be the erasure of entire Frequencies of Existence if the flow of the Wheel was altered enough.
And yet, they still sensed no grand moves on the side of Bob.
He was an enemy that Noah did not like the most.
Low key. Patient. And with a lot of unknowns.
He much rather liked the showy enemies that he could know exactly where they were and what they were doing!
This type of enemy that he did not even know the plans of...was difficult!

sentences.text: Scorching.
Her whole being was scorched inside out; her Source being utterly overturned as its very center, there was only the Flame.
That Flame altered everything as even in her eyes, the Runes of Amarantos turned to gold, her strands of hair on her head becoming dark gold while her Source felt even more exuberant.
"Haa...haa!"
She breathed out heavily as Noah's hand left her stomach, still feeling the flames he put inside her continue to burn every recess of her Source as at this moment...
"You belong to me now."
BOOM!
The voice was cold and heavy.
As if it despised her.
She gritted her teeth as she despised him too!
"I can collapse your weavings at any point, and I will know if anything is being kept from me.
So, speak."
He sat back on the golden clouds, his hands freely resting on his knees as he looked like a thug while gazing at her.
A flaming gold robe replaced the dark one that Azzurra was adorned in, tears spilling in her eyes as truly, his words were not wrong.
Her Source was now bright with the Flame of the Wheel of Existence that her own man, Giuseppe, was intent on going against!
If ever he found out...

Her heart beat frantically as she made sure the dark-haired and dark-robed body of hers in the Prime Frequency of Life did not show any changes, and she pulled even more of its weavings into this body here to make sure that nothing regarding the flame leaked out.
And she began to speak as her eyes became filled with determination.
She overcame many things before, she would overcome this as well.
And as soon as she figured out a method for Giuseppe to attain what he wanted, or if she could just get him to stop...everything would be alright.
Right?
"They...whoever Giuseppe and the others listen to has planned for us to take care of the Singed next.
We are to attack the Prime Frequency of Flames and do the same thing we did for the Prime Frequency of Life."
"Oh?"
Noah only nodded coldly at this as he thought about many things.
"Tell me the movements of the Faceless Lifeforms across Frequencies, and how the Logos of the Wheel aids them.
My people will be hunting soon and need clear targets to hunt."
He said such words as Azzurra looked towards him as if he were a monster.
"You know...they are just looking for a home where their very weavings won't be burned just by existing."
She spoke as she recalled the Faceless Lifeforms that were younger.
The joy they had in their weavings just by being able to run around freely.
Noah's gaze turned even colder as he waved his hands.
"And that's what makes this all so damn stupid.
There are so many ways such a thing could have been done, but they went the genocidal route and burned everything for everyone here.
What is good and bad...I will decide for myself.
They decided for themselves, and you've made your own decisions.
Now, live by them and speak."
WAA!
His eyes kept their coldness as Azzurra gathered herself on the golden clouds, her figure burning with white gold flames carrying a unique new flow of the Wheel.
Outside of the Dream.
In the Prime Frequency of Life.
WAP!

The statue bound in rope, emanating a heart-rending aura, disappeared, the stifling sensation wrapping around everyone being gone along with it as Noah gazed at Giuseppe, who also gazed at him coldly.
His body burned unfathomably powerful as his Prime Source was heavy, whereas if Noah had not been in the Cycle of Ordo, he did not know whether he could have faced this being.
He then looked at the masses of Lifeforms, the three Prime Source Faceless Lifeforms falling in his eyes the most as he spoke out while a portal bloomed behind him.
"Let this serve as a warning."
A warning.
He said this while gazing at all of them a few seconds longer, his gaze even returning to Giuseppe and passing over to Azzurra, who turned her eyes down as even in that time...nobody attacked him!
He then calmly walked into the portal and disappeared as finally, those here felt like they could breathe again.
"Fuck!" Giuseppe roared out as existence crumbled around him.
"Noah Osmont...Noah Osmont!"
He uttered out this name as if he were cursing it before he turned to the three Prime Source Faceless Lifeforms.
"I told you all that these Weavings of the Wheel still hold other powerful unknown Complexities that may be able to threaten you all.
Bringing out you people this early..."
"We know!" A Faceless Lifeform roared while looking at the thousands of Dark Towers stretching out across this Frequency.
"We will divide our people and not have them all in one place.
Then, we can continue the mission as needed.
If that Osmont comes again, he will not be able to use our people to threaten us!"
The Prime Source Faceless Lifeforms looked at each other as they began to move.
Giuseppe shook his head and sighed as he warped beside Azzurra.
He held her head and kissed it as he voiced out lowly.
"My love, I gave you the weavings of that target from his entanglements.
Why did you not tell me his complexity or the progress with him?"
He didn't yell at her.
He just asked calmly as Azzurra looked into his eyes, but she was not able to hold her gaze as she looked at his chest while replying.
"I left it to McAllister due to their entanglement, but it seems he is gone.
We were wrong about him."

chapters.title: Chapter 3586 Knowns and Unknowns! I
paragraphs: The weavings of the True Severed Origin Osmontian burned with glory as beside him, Ruination was looking at the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel with the Heart of the Megalos as she asked lightly.
"Shall I go ahead, Master?"
She asked for permission.
And Noah gave a light nod as he looked at the instrument he had used to carve out Ordo Ab Chao.
The latest Source to occupy his Atlas of Existence.
An Atlas that had very little spots remaining as the moment that it would be full neared.
The Authority of the Administrator of the Atlas of Existence burned brightly, and it would no longer remain that of the Administrator much longer as its completion was in sight.
The Mundis of Power held the Conceptual Source of Existence, the Outerversal Source of Existence, the Ingeniare Source of Existence, Kuklos, Megalos, Singed, and now...Ordo Ab Chao!

When he was measuring his complexity and seeing how to move from here on out, he looked at the completion of his Atlas as one way to do so in addition to the weavings of the True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence, Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity, and Absolute Infinitum Existentialism among other wonders of complexity he held...

He had so many methodologies of increasing his power that he could even opt out of making a decision to kill purely based on the need for Loot- forgoing a battle of destruction in the Prime Frequency of Life and risking losing the one connection there was to Bob, and instead playing a game of waiting and inserting his own spy.
He had options.
For his Atlas of Existence that all Systems of Existence sitting at the highest peaks of the Ninth Echelon, he had to make a choice regarding balance.
Regarding what he knew and did not know.
His gaze flashed as it sought to summarize the most critical things into a single stat sheet.
[Noah Osmont](True Severed Origin Osmontian)
<Atlas of Existence>::
Conceptual System of Existence Echelon 9(Pathway to the True Source Unlocked)
Outerversal System of Existence Echelon 9(Pathway to the True Source Unlocked)
Ingeniare System of Existence Echelon 9
Kuklos System of Existence Echelon 9
Megalos System of Existence Echelon 9(Pathway to the True Source Unlocked)
Singed System of Existence Echelon 9(Pathway to the True Source Unlocked)
Ordo Ab Chao System of Existence Echelon 9(Pathway to the True Source Unlocked)

<Unique Modifiers>:: Absolute Infinitum Existentialism(All accumulated complexity geared towards the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed), Limited Fictional Transcendence, Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity(Random and Selective), True Severed Adaptive Power of Existence[Primary Target: Bob(Unknown Lifeform), Secondary Targets: Prime Source Complexities...], Megalocide, Heart of Infinity...
<Constructs>:: Infiniverse Megalos(Undefined), Ruination(Undefined), Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence(Undefined)

<Complexity>:: Undefined (Currently in a state of Absolute Infinitum Indestructibility, making Damage to your Weavings of Existence impossible by any definable weavings you come across. Greater Source Complexity entities are currently defined with the Orange Color, with Prime Source Complexities retaining the danger level of Red.)
Trying to summarize his weavings into a simple summary panel was nigh impossible due to everything he held.

His weavings could fill up pages as just under a single System of Existence, there were layers of uniqueness as how he was quantified regarding Echelons was vastly different from how others were quantified.
And more than this, the more he began walking on the Pathways to the True Sources, the further he went from any definable echelon of power!
The most critical Pathway at this moment could be argued to be Singed.
A single Singed Pathway, once he walked across its path enough, he would be able to use it to truly Sever himself to the 54th level!
And yet, one could also argue for the pathways of Cheats, Quintessence, Plot, Protagonist, Infinity, Megalos, and even Ordo Ab Chao for the Absolutes of unique modifiers they provided.
There were many possibilities as Noah looked at the different parts of himself.
In all of these different parts, there had to be a balance.
Many of his systems of Existence related to Matter, with Outerversal shining for Dark Matter and Ordo Ab Chao being particularly radiant for Anti-Matter.
Ingeniare...was utilized in the background so far with its own unique potential that allowed for him to easily engineer the ridiculous things that made his complexity.
When he looked at himself, all he truly needed was time, as now and in the past, time seemed to be the singular thing that was always the hardest to achieve.

But he would make his own time as for now, while his complexity increased and he sought Bob...his focus would be on finally completing the Atlas while traveling further across the Pathways to the True Sources, especially Singed, and spreading himself out across frequencies!
For him, it was simple enough.
Just another Tuesday.
Tuesday?
"What day even is it?"
He blinked as he momentarily found himself shaking his head and focusing on Ruination.
She just swallowed the Piece of the Spoke of the Wheel of Existence as her body was luminous.
Around her, an illusory construct of a Wheel began to form as she lay at the very center.
A Wheel.
She had swallowed multiple small pieces relating to the Wheel.
And now, with a Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel...
|The Undefined Construct, Ruination, is transforming towards the complexity of Ruined Miniare Wheel of Existence.|
WAA!

With her crimson gold figure at the center, her hands and legs transformed to become sharp points as they stretched out into an X, a ring forming at their ends as she truly looked like the core piece of a forming Wheel!
And from her chest, a pulsing heart of a Megalos beat as from it, another Spoke extended to connect to the outer ring.

It looked like the start of a dazzling Wheel with multiple Spokes, with the eyes of Ruination opening at this moment to release beams of crimson gold light that flashed across the Expanse and continued to stretch out as if they were searching for something!
|The Innate Feature of the Ruined Miniare Wheel of Existence, Flow, has been brought to fruition.|
|A passive and natural detection and retrieval of more Pieces of the Wheel has been deemed the primary factor of the current Flow, with its search range capable of wading across an entire Frequency.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3587 Knowns and Unknowns! II
paragraphs: Ruination, transforming to become a Ruined Miniare Wheel of Existence.
Something Unknown and unfathomable as even if one was asked to define it now, they wouldn't be able to say for sure just what that meant.
But, something called Flow was now available.
The Flow of the Ruined Miniare Wheel of Existence.
And it had deemed that the most important thing for the Flow...was the search and retrieval of more pieces of the Wheel.
There were many implications to think about here, but Noah only asked Ruination lightly.
"How does it feel?"
His words were akin to a jolt of electricity as Ruination blinked multiple times before she replied with a smile.
|Unique, Master. Akin to unlocking a new possibility for myself. Even now, what I can do or potentially have the capability to do is not set in stone, with me having leeway to define things myself.|
Ruination uttered some terrific words as Noah smiled.
|I'll be able to aid Master in designing the remaining Systems of Existence, and as per the Flow...there seem to be multiple Pieces of the Wheel scattered out across the stretches of this Frequency.|
WAA!
Noah's eyes became bright at such words as his body pulsed with black and white radiance.
"Let's start touring this Frequency of ours then, shall we?"
Many things occurred.
Many methodologies of complexity presented themselves.
Now, all that was needed was time.
"Time." Noah uttered this word calmly as another part of him in the Infiniverse Megalos began moving to accomplish even more things in the time span he held.
Amidst a roiling Pantheonic Haven swirling with the allure of Dreams, he looked at the throngs of complexities that he was entangled with.
"My Regnum...will take you where you need to go."

This body of his became wrapped with the brilliance of Outerversal as obsidian gold flames danced over his figure, his Regnum burning silently behind him as amidst the glorious rolling seas of golden light, obsidian gateways began to open.
Gateways across leading to entirely different Frequencies of Existence.

His son, Henry, looked at the nearest one as he floated towards it without a delay, the Pathway of the Singed he carried granting him the strength of a Source that was entirely backed by the True Severed Origin Osmontian.
His Heart of Infinity withstood the cost for him and many others to utilize his Paths with their true power!
Against a singular path, even a Greater Source would find it difficult to take down.
After Henry, an Emperor Penguin cried out with infallible pride, its body shooting towards the same Gateway as many others began to make their own choices.
Kazuhiko. The Kraken. Ayame. Erikson. Lilith. The Bard of Quintessence.
DUM!

The last one held drums dancing to the beat of colorless waves of Quintessence as he chose the Pathway to the True Source of Quintessence, the power he found himself accessing making him want to howl as he sought the perfect field of battle to unleash a Quintessential symphony!
But one by one, Noah's Regnum carried his people across towards different Frequencies of existence, his reach extending out as far as it could.
At the same time, he wondered.
In the search for any traces of Bob who could be in the myriad of Frequencies, there were a few others his weavings were entangled with.
He mentioned the Great Usurper that he knew very well.
He mentioned a Gem Master that he knew nothing about.
There were even others that he mentioned he became entangled with that could be potential routes to follow up on!
With anything falling into the realm of possibility, he tugged on the weavings of entanglements of the Great Usurper while his people, carrying his Regnum, stretched out across frequencies.
At the same time...
"O Origin Singed!"
The cry of a shocked and excited Mysara rang out across his weavings as she also tugged on their entanglement, her voice booming out.

"Origin Singed! We saw you. We saw you in the Prime Frequency of Life as you effortlessly stood against the Faceless Lifeforms, with even their Prime Sources unable to do anything to you! Why leave them as is, O Origin Singed? Their weavings are entirely opposite ours as they will not stop..."

The weavings within the Prime Frequency of Life were questioned as Noah didn't explain their purpose of bait- with this bait soon breaking apart to continue their attacks as he would be able to take bites of its Prime Sources then.
He simply replied to Mysara's weavings with a voice that reached her very weavings of existence.
"Have the Singed prepare for a War. The Faceless Lifeforms have their sights on them next. And set up an introduction with the current leader of the Singed for me."
The one leading the Singed at this very moment. He wanted to see if such a Prime Source Entity knew anything more regarding the Flames of the Wheel of Existence!
Mysara heard his words as her eyes flared while she nodded excitedly, her weavings within the Prime Frequency of Flames making a move...
Across the interminable weavings of the Wheel.
In a certain Prime Frequency of Existence.
Layers of Megalos were stacked on top of each other to form a unique tower the size of tens of thousands of Omniverses, with this tower surrounded by waves of incandescent radiance.
At a small point of such an endlessly massive tower, there was an Omniverse with a crystalline glow.

In its depths, inside a small domain surrounded by different colored crystals and gems sprinkled across the skies, a man could be seen standing in front of a forge as he hammered down a dazzling colorless gem!
On his chest, a nine-pointed star could be seen as it glowed with the silent complexity of a Source.

At this time, the eyes of this being flickered as he looked up to see space tearing apart, the figure of a bald-headed creature with tentacle-like limbs stepping out as it waved towards him with a smile.
And yet, facing such a phenomenon, the being with the nine-pointed star became somber as he put down his hammer and spoke out coldly.
"Is it about time for all pretenses to drop?"
His voice carried an ancient coldness as he spoke, and the new arrival, Bob, shook his head with a smile as he came closer, his mouth opening like a zipper.

"Nothing that crazy. I just had my first true long conversation in quite some time and it reminded me of the being that seemed to always have suspicions. This is just me humoring myself, but I came to get closure to understand what I did wrong. Do you have time for a short conversation, O Peacemaker?"

At a small point of such an endlessly massive tower, there was an Omniverse with a crystalline glow.

In its depths, inside a small domain surrounded by different colored crystals and gems sprinkled across the skies, a man could be seen standing in front of a forge as he hammered down a dazzling colorless gem!
On his chest, a nine-pointed star could be seen as it glowed with the silent complexity of a Source.

At this time, the eyes of this being flickered as he looked up to see space tearing apart, the figure of a bald-headed creature with tentacle-like limbs stepping out as it waved towards him with a smile.
And yet, facing such a phenomenon, the being with the nine-pointed star became somber as he put down his hammer and spoke out coldly.
"Is it about time for all pretenses to drop?"
His voice carried an ancient coldness as he spoke, and the new arrival, Bob, shook his head with a smile as he came closer, his mouth opening like a zipper.
"Nothing that crazy.
I just had my first true long conversation in quite some time and it reminded me of the being that seemed to always have suspicions.
This is just me humoring myself, but I came to get closure to understand what I did wrong.
Do you have time for a short conversation, O Peacemaker?"

chapters.title: Chapter 3588 Fables! I
paragraphs: Multicolored crystals and gems floated in the skies.
On the ground below, there was an incandescent forge where the man had stopped the process of a dazzling gem as he looked towards the arrival of Bob somberly!
And yet Bob simply replied in a casual manner that he was just here to talk. That he came to get closure!
The Peacemaker's eyes flashed at such words as he put his hammer down, walking towards a simple set of chairs and a table near this place as he sat down while motioning for Bob to do the same.
Bob had a smile on his face as he breathed out while humming, looking around this domain with a knowing look as he shook his head right after and asked.

"You see, I have many things that I don't like about myself, with one of those being a tendency to think of every little mistake that I make. I fixate on it. No matter what I'm doing, it buzzes in my head until it drives me nuts. So with you...I wanted to ask, how did you know?"
WAA!
"I came to you a gracious figure willing to aid and help in your time of need, and yet you were always suspicious. You never used any of the things I gave you. Why? How did you know?"
His eyes flashed with a light of complexity as he wondered. For others, something like this may be nothing. For him...it was everything!
Opposite him, the Peacemaker had a calm gaze as he looked at the silently burning forge while replying.

"To maintain my Peace, I always obtain countless memories and records of Complexity all around me. From the environment and from the life forms. No matter their complexity. When you appeared...I received nothing."
His gaze flashed brightly.
As if he remembered that day with heavy clarity!

"Not a single flow of information. As if you were not part of the environment. As if...you were not even a lifeform. You terrified me that day, and I had to play along as you came down like an elder figure to help. I thought I played everything well every time I came across you, but it seems like it was not sufficient enough as you saw something. Since then, I have been trying to get away from you. To regain my peace and be at a stage where I didn't have to fear you the next time you arrived."
His words were heavy with remembrance.
And Bob listened to them calmly as he nodded right after, looking around this domain once more.

"You seem to have succeeded. I only noticed it a few nanoseconds after arriving here. None of this...is real. It is a reflection of what used to be here, yes? Your complexity has edged upwards again."
He touched the table between them as it turned hazy.
The blinking gems in the skies seemed to flash with luminosity as if they were lights, and even the body of the Peacemaker turned transparent!
Yes.
He wasn't even here.
Bob raised his tentacle like limbs as they pulsed with a white light that caused him to shake his head even more.
"Woah, and even with our entanglement, I cannot find where you went. I want to ask you how you managed this and where you are now, but you seem to have had your fill of this conversation already."
The hazy figure of the Peacemaker had risen.
It was now clear that he was only a projection of himself, his gaze clear as he nodded while asking in turn.
"If I can also ask something about you...what exactly was your goal? With me? With the Megalos or even Frequencies out there? What does a being like you plan to do?"
He was asked a question that someone else not too long ago had asked him.
As if they all believed him to be some sort of homicidal maniac!
The mouth on Bob extended to the ends of his face with a smile of complexity as he also rose.

"There isn't some grand plan of the domination of existence or anything like that. I'm not cut out for something like that. All I have to do...is to make a change. A small change. Just like I told another before you, you would not understand even if I laid everything out before your eyes. You would look at me and think I was nuts. No matter. The little talk we had today brought me some closure as I can go ahead without fixating too much. Now, I have to go do something that really causes my heart to ache. But it has to be done...so, until we meet again, Peacemaker."
The visage of Bob began to flicker as in the distance, the illusory figure of the Peacemaker shook his head!
A meeting with Bob was not something he would wish on his worst enemies!
"Oh..." He shook his head in thought as he remembered that there were no enemies of his remaining.
For the sake of peace, they were all gone!
As he thought of this, he wondered about the last words from Bob.
He said he had to do something that pained him.
Just what horror was going to be done that it caused the heart of a being that should not even be a lifeform ache?
It was a heavy question with no answer.
Across the weavings of existence.
In another Prime Frequency.
Within Noah's home Frequency.
The visage of Noah and Ruination arrived in a unique location of the Expanse they had never been in before.
Around them, golden Strings of Existence were reforming one by one as a dense eruption of Atmospheric Weavings of Existence returned.

In this cluster of the expanse, there were layers upon layers of collapsed mirror like weavings of Megalos- Megalos that were not fully formed and in no way habitable as the collapsed layers of mirror like Megalos held a level of sharpness that could cut the bodies of even Lesser Sources!

chapters.title: Chapter 3589 Fables! II
paragraphs: A dangerous environment where even Lesser Sources could be injured by malformed Megalos of Existence!
Ruination looked into such a region as she nodded with confidence.

"These unique Megalos were not able to successfully form over the years purely because in their heart, there lies a Piece of a Core Trace of the Wheel. It has only caused a natural process to be inhibited over the years until this bloomed."
Her voice was radiant and filled with life as her transformation into the Ruined Miniare Wheel of Existence only allowed her to become ever so radiant!
Noah nodded as he stepped forward, the glass mirror like layers of Megalos stretching out for light years ahead buzzing the moment his figure came near.
Before the weavings of Existence of anyone else, they may have been cut open and shredded apart even if they had established a Source!
Yet for him...
BZZZT!

His skin shone with a white luster as any possible damage was negated, and mirror-like shards began to break as he floated into this terrifyingly sharp Malformed Megalos with Ruination following behind him.

Every now and then, she would turn and point to a certain direction as they changed their path, their figures beginning to cross the Malformed Megalos of Existence rapidly as they sought another piece of the Wheel!
And after a few minutes...
BZZT!
Noah and Ruination arrived before shattered space as before them, a spinning singularity holding a Core Trace of the Wheel burning with an ancient allure could be seen!

The core tracing was in the form of a rune as just gazing at it now, it read <RA> very clearly, Noah not even trying to guess what the scattered Runes carrying different letters could come to as there could be millions of combinations.
He simply allowed Ruination to step forward and wave her hands, the Core Trace of the Wheel shooting towards her like a magnet before it was absorbed smoothly!
Her figure then began to burn with radiant weavings of Existence, her complexity becoming a level greater as Noah already began to move once more.
BOOOM!
Suddenly.

His eyes became sharp as an explosion of terrifying complexity shattered a distant area not far from them, the weavings being utterly unique as there was a chaotic swirling of a foreign Frequency amidst them!
A foreign Frequency.
It was someone seeking to enter this frequency from another, and it was with a heavy force at that too!
"AAAH!"

A sharp, piercing scream exploded out along with one final bang, and a singularity ahead spit out a haggard existence scrambling around as her body had dozens of golden strings tying up what looked to be...books.
Her hands also clasped multiple books within them as she tightly hugged another book on her chest, her expression utterly livid at this moment as she cursed out!
"Fuck that guy! Fuck! That! Guy!"
WAA!

Her bellow was brutal as the singularity behind her pulsed as it released another burst of brilliance, and she quickly scrambled away as if she feared whatever she had run away from following her here.
It was at this moment that her weavings spread out as she came to gaze upon Noah and Ruination's figures.
And her figure instantly froze before she...
"AAAH!"
Shrieked out in...excitement.

Her face brightened up tremendously as she gathered the books connected to her, her multicolored pupils becoming clear as she flew towards Noah and Ruination as if she had found exactly what she was looking for.
Her hair dangled messily in a cluster of black and white, the white dress she wore ripped in multiple places, and her fair skin was exposed in multiple areas.
Noah's eyes were stern as his weavings pulsed- affirming this entity before them was...emanating a vibrant aura of a powerful Greater Source!
Yet he could not sense any malice from her as she came to stop right before him and Ruination, her eyes shaking with visible excitement as she laughed victoriously right after.
"Haha! Let's see if he is brave enough to come after me now! My gosh...you're actually real..."

Her thoughts seemed scattered and not all there. Her eyes screamed crazy as if she was bubbling with excitement, and she seemed to have noticed this as she turned around one more time at the disappearing singularity of the frequency she came from to make sure she wasn't followed, and she then coughed as she spoke out with nervousness.
"The Unfathomable Weapon, Ruination! The 9th Infernal Lord, the Gazer of the Unscalable Wall, Mr. Noah Osmont! It is nice to finally meet you!!!"

Her eyes radiated splendrous light as she spoke such shocking words, Noah's eyes becoming extremely sharp as Ruination's eyes turned cold, a crimson gold Spoke appearing in her hands as she prepared to strike out!
The unique entity before them saw this and became distraught right after, her hands scrambling as she pulled out the book she held tightly on her chest and pushed it forward while she screamed out.
"Please don't kill me on a misunderstanding! I'm just a big fan!"
The book she thrust out had a dazzling title.
It read.
[The Fable of Noah Osmont]
Noah looked at such a thing as his eyes became blindingly more dangerous.
His Fable? His Fable was his and his alone too, with his Records not being available to others ever since he took everything into himself!
So, who was this to hold a thick golden book that had his name on it?
She opened her eyes hesitantly as she blinked with nervousness; Noah looked at her figure and began to observe the other books connected to strings around this woman as he spoke coldly.
"Who are you?"
A simple question.
And yet the one it was directed to looked starstruck the moment she heard it, and she grasped the book she held ever so tightly on her chest as she straightened up before she replied!
"I am your biggest fan, the Queen of Matter!"
She stumbled out her words as if she had practiced them again and again.
And Noah's eyes retained their coldness as when the Queen of Matter saw this, she spoke out a bit more, this time with a tinge of seriousness.

"I wouldn't normally bother you, but that fucking guy, Bob, just broke into my home and snatched away the Book of Existence! I thought he was about to kill me, so my weavings sought out the one person who could possibly protect me."
She blinked with vibrant and complex weavings of existence.
She uttered out words that only made others baffled more and more as at this moment, the Queen of Matter made her appearence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3590 Fables! III
paragraphs: The Queen of Matter.
In a region of Malformed Megalos of Existence, dangerous layers mirror like shards stuck out all around as even a Lesser Source would be skewered by these surroundings!
Yet her body was covered by a unique hue of power that protected not just her weavings, but the weavings of the books she carried.
Books attached to golden strings of existence or held tightly in her hands.
Such a being had spoken of many shocking things, but the latest one related to Bob!
"Bob?"
Noah's eyes flashed dangerously as he asked.
"Bob!" And the Queen of Matter nodded multiple times over seriously as she affirmed!

Noah gazed at the flickering singularity she had come through as when it lingered there for just a few seconds, the Queen of Matter became shocked while shaking her head as she stood between him and its line of sight.
"Woah, your next thought isn't, 'Since Bob is in those weavings of Existence, then I will merely go to those weavings of Existence!' right? Right???"
She spoke once more in a manner as if she knew him.
An action that only made Noah's eyes flash at her with more and more coldness as he replied while moving towards the singularity she came from.
"Stay here."
BZZT!
The weavings of a grandiose Regnum erupted around Noah as he delved into the collapsing singularity that the Queen of Matter had come from right away!
"Woah...he really is the Tyrannical Emperor! How could he not be scared of that monster? Hey, Miss Ruination..."
The Queen of Matter turned around to observe the figure of Ruination with vibrant eyes, while Ruination, on the other hand, stuck her hands out while speaking coldly.
"The book. Let me see it."
She pointed to the thick golden book labeled Noah Osmont that the Queen of Matter grasped even tighter.
"This..." She seemed conflicted by such words as if she never wanted to say no to Ruination, but the book she held to her chest was truly too important for her to just give away!
"What if...I give you another one? I've got the Records of the Ruination Cores right here!"
She tugged upon a golden string of Existence as a crimson gold bordered book appeared.
The Records of the Ruination Cores.
Ruination tugged and brought this book into her hands while opening it, seeing pages that were filled with Records of a very, very distant past.
A past of the Primordial Cosmos. Of Universes brought to Ruin. Of Noah discovering her and bringing about the emergence of Ruination.
After these records, there were a few more as she flipped across the pages, quickly going through the book as when it came towards the latter part, the pages were empty.

Her eyes flashed with questions at this as she was about to raise her head to ask the Queen of Matter when somehow, this woman had already appeared beside her, her eyes showing pride and excitement as if she had achieved a certain dream of hers to read a book about someone with that someone.

"Is it not crazy how far you've come? I was only able to find out about and record your early life. Before your existence became increasingly complex to the point that your weavings became your own, and your Records could not be easily discerned. But the Flow of the Wheel is tremendous, and anything that Matter has an ear to, I was still able to work hard to note down. What sucks is that I don't know much about the details of what you and the True Emperor of Quintessence have been up to these past weeks. Do you know how hard it was? I had to listen and record other Fables that weren't nearly as tyrannical as his. I-...!"
Her words stopped as while holding her Book in one hand, Ruination's other crimson gold hand shot out to wrap around the neck of the Queen of Matter!
Ruination's eyes were sharp as she did not like to see weavings of her past written, even if it was before her Records were made her own.
"Do you know what I am now?"
She spoke coldly while coming to really look at the Queen of Matter.
The woman who, even with her throat grasped, showed an excited expression as she shook her head!
"No, but seeing how you can bypass a natural barrier of a Greater Source easily...my gosh, what has the True Emperor of Quintessence fed you?!"
She took none of this seriously at all as it caused a sense of dissonance, and at this time...
BOOM!
The decaying singularity where Noah had just disappeared to opened again as he returned.
His gaze was chilly as he looked at the scene of Ruination holding the Queen of Matter by the neck as he voiced out.
"No sign of Bob anywhere around your weavings. What did you say he took?"
He floated over while the Queen of Matter hummed as if she was truly enjoying herself today, still hugging a certain book on her chest tightly.

"He stole the Book of Existence. It holds everything that Matter has laid witness to across the Frequencies- weavings of important Nodes of the Flow of Existence. Where any weavings of the Weaving might be hidden, and other forms of knowledge relating to the Wheel that could be very dangerous in the wrong hands. I knew he was sketchy when he came to meet me before and was curious about the Fables I was recording, but I didn't think he would steal like this! But hey, at least he left some important books behind!"

She said this while clutching the book with the title of Noah's name closer, the other books around her connected to the strings of Existence shining brilliantly as Noah began to reach out and flip through them.
"You seem to know who we are, so you should know about my nature. I will give you a chance to explain thoroughly and clearly right now, O Queen of Matter."
His voice was heavy and serious!

And yet when he uttered her name and looked at her seriously, the visage of this Greater Source entity brimmed with excitement as she hummed and began to speak- her showing how she absolutely enjoyed this whole interaction!
