A past of the Primordial Cosmos.
Of Universes brought to Ruin.
Of Noah discovering her and bringing about the emergence of Ruination.
After these records, there were a few more as she flipped across the pages, quickly going through the book as when it came towards the latter part, the pages were empty.

Her eyes flashed with questions at this as she was about to raise her head to ask the Queen of Matter when somehow, this woman had already appeared beside her, her eyes showing pride and excitement as if she had achieved a certain dream of hers to read a book about someone with that someone.
"Is it not crazy how far you've come?
I was only able to find out about and record your early life.
Before your existence became increasingly complex to the point that your weavings became your own, and your Records could not be easily discerned.
But the Flow of the Wheel is tremendous, and anything that Matter has an ear to, I was still able to work hard to note down.
What sucks is that I don't know much about the details of what you and the True Emperor of Quintessence have been up to these past weeks.
Do you know how hard it was?
I had to listen and record other Fables that weren't nearly as tyrannical as his.
Her words stopped as while holding her Book in one hand, Ruination's other crimson gold hand shot out to wrap around the neck of the Queen of Matter!
Ruination's eyes were sharp as she did not like to see weavings of her past written, even if it was before her Records were made her own.
"Do you know what I am now?"
She spoke coldly while coming to really look at the Queen of Matter.
The woman who, even with her throat grasped, showed an excited expression as she shook her head!
"No, but seeing how you can bypass a natural barrier of a Greater Source easily...my gosh, what has the True Emperor of Quintessence fed you?!"
She took none of this seriously at all as it caused a sense of dissonance, and at this time...
BOOM!
The decaying singularity where Noah had just disappeared to opened again as he returned.
His gaze was chilly as he looked at the scene of Ruination holding the Queen of Matter by the neck as he voiced out.
"No sign of Bob anywhere around your weavings.
What did you say he took?"
He floated over while the Queen of Matter hummed as if she was truly enjoying herself today, still hugging a certain book on her chest tightly.
"He stole the Book of Existence.
It holds everything that Matter has laid witness to across the Frequencies- weavings of important Nodes of the Flow of Existence.
Where any weavings of the Weaving might be hidden, and other forms of knowledge relating to the Wheel that could be very dangerous in the wrong hands.
I knew he was sketchy when he came to meet me before and was curious about the Fables I was recording, but I didn't think he would steal like this!
But hey, at least he left some important books behind!"

She said this while clutching the book with the title of Noah's name closer, the other books around her connected to the strings of Existence shining brilliantly as Noah began to reach out and flip through them.
"You seem to know who we are, so you should know about my nature.
I will give you a chance to explain thoroughly and clearly right now, O Queen of Matter."
His voice was heavy and serious!

And yet when he uttered her name and looked at her seriously, the visage of this Greater Source entity brimmed with excitement as she hummed and began to speak- her showing how she absolutely enjoyed this whole interaction!

chapters.title: Chapter 3591 Fables! IV
paragraphs: "I record down Fables across the Frequencies of the Wheel. Some stories tug at my heart, others are left behind. Yours...is one I followed closely even after your weavings were retracted. But of course, there are entanglements, other people who know of you, or when you simply speak about yourself or your distinctions near the State of Matter."
While held by the neck, the Queen of Matter spoke excitedly as if she was meeting a celebrity she looked up to this whole time.

"The more complex you became, the harder it was to read about your Fable. To the point that recently, all I got were weavings of the flow around you. Through the eyes of others. Through events. You can just consider me an existence who peeks at the flow of the wheel and anything happening around Matter, and all I have done so far is record things down. With the advent of the Change, I was 100% sure which Fable would take Centerpoint and steer the ship, and it was why I pulled upon my Exclusive Flow of Matter to tunnel across Frequencies to come to you the moment I felt my weavings threatened!"
A unique existence.
Noah perused through the many books she had connected to her as ultimately, he even came across a book titled...the Great Usurper.
He opened its first few pages and raised his brows at what he read.
An Idle Gaming System? Crucibles?
He remembered the Systems that seemed like ages ago when he read this as right now...everything seemed to be so far above it all.
There was even a volume on the book of the Great Usurper titled- the Clash of Two Giants! Noah VS Noah!

All of it seemed so ridiculous that Noah couldn't help but shake his head and close the book of the Great Usurper that had very few details towards the end, just a few known titles or distinctions and possible locations across the weavings of the Wheel.
"Let her go."
He gave the command to Ruination who released her grip on the neck of the Queen of Matter who nodded at her as if to tell her she could hold her neck anytime she wished.
Noah then beckoned at her while pointing to the book she held most closely.
"My Book."
HUUM!
Just two words.

But his intents were clear as with rising nervousness, the Queen of Matter unclasped her hands as if she were giving away a precious treasure, slowly allowing it to flow towards Noah as the authority of a Greater Source surged out into the surroundings to encapsulate everything- as if she wanted to ensure that no accidents could occur or have this book be lost!
Noah obtained the thick golden book as he opened its first page.
And there it was.
His story.
His Fable.
Something he thought he had pulled entirely into himself without any record of it being visible elsewhere.
"It took all of my power just to not have those records be erased."
The voice of the Queen of Matter echoed out nervously in front of him as she continued.

"I had to increase my complexity so much and so quickly just to make sure that what I had already written down would not fade away, to the point that, recently, it felt like even my own memories were being lost slowly. But I did my best to preserve the Fable..."
His Fable.
There was a lot in the beginning, but the pages became thinner and thinner as time went on until there were only blank white pages.
Nothing much written regarding the past days or weeks.
Noah nodded as he spoke out.
"So you can easily gain knowledge regarding the flow of the Wheel across all Frequencies of Existence?"
He closed the thick book and kept it with him as he looked at her figure closely.
And she fidgeted under his gaze as she did not show the demeanor of a Greater Source at all, her heading nodding timidly as she replied.
"I sought you out because I felt threatened, and out of the monstrous possibilities out there, my weavings brought themselves to you. I hope...you won't send me away!"
She bowed her head down as if she waited for a great judgment.
And her gaze even flickered right after as if she remembered something, her right hand digging into her chest as she pulled out a multicolored singularity.
"I also know that trust does not come easy, so here is my Source, do what you wish with it!"
Her Greater Source.
She actually presented her Greater Source to Noah as he grasped it, his gaze piercing into it as Severed Extractor brought about its information clearly!
<Fabled Matter>
A unique Source unlike many others that he had come across.
His weavings spilled into it as he found a Source so unfathomably complex that it even rivaled some of the Sources within his Mundi of Power!

It was so unique that he was almost inclined to design something just like it for one of the remaining slots on the Atlas of Existence, but that would once more be the tipping of the scale even more towards Matter.
Matter...that an entity like the Queen of Matter could peer across Frequencies of to listen in and obtain tidbits of records of others!
His weavings flooded into the Source of the Queen of Matter to ensure there was nothing he missed and he then looked at her figure again as she stood straight.
As if she was ready to be analyzed.
She even turned sideways while he was perusing the rest of her weavings as she proceeded to ask.
"Am I...curvaceous? With a blessed chest?"
She spoke such words that caused Noah's eyes to flash with a colder light as she coughed right after and stayed still.
After Noah passed multiple of his Pathways to the True Sources and confirmed no possible gaps or issues, he spoke out.

"I will take you in, Queen of Matter, if nothing but for your use in listening to the flow of Matter across Frequencies. Would you be able to listen in on the appearance of Bob in any possible weaving of existence?"
He gave his verdict that caused the Queen of Matter to become unfathomably joyous as she nodded her head like a chicken right after!
"I will do that and more! Just tell me of anything you can think of, and I will do my best to contribute!"
Her Source in his hands visibly vibrated with enthusiasm as he allowed it to flow back into her.
There were many knowns and unknowns in the weavings of the Wheel.
He may have just gotten his hands on something that would make weavings a bit more clear as...

When his eyes landed on the Queen of Matter again, he saw that complex weavings already gathered in her hands to form a pristine white and gold book, a title already being etched on it in real time as it read....
<My Adventures With The True Emperor of Quintessence>
The Queen of Matter was already humming with excitement as if she was in her own world, Ruination coming to be beside Noah as she spoke out to him.
"Master, this is a crazy one."
A crazy complexity of Existence!
Even Ruination could see it as the mental state of this Queen of Matter....did not seem to be all there!

chapters.title: Chapter 3592 Fables! V
paragraphs: The strings of existence holding floating books around her seemed ever brighter as the Queen of Matter hummed while she held another book titled <My Adventures With The True Emperor of Quintessence!>
Newly formed.
Blank.

A pen appeared in her hands as she stopped right after as if she had remembered something critical, and she looked towards Noah with a troubled expression, mustering her courage before speaking once more.
"I just have one condition that must be adhered to, O 9th Infernal Lord!"
She spoke with stern seriousness as if she would die on this mountain. Her gaze held nervousness as the pen in her hand fidgeted, as if the condition she was about to state would be extremely heavy.
That if this condition was not fulfilled, things would not work out.
Noah looked at the Queen of Matter calmly as books swirled around her strings of Existence, and he nodded to tell her to proceed.
She nodded and brought her hands together as she shouted out.
"Please...do not make me one of the members of your Harem!"
"What?" Noah tilted his head to make sure he heard correctly.
And the Queen of Matter nodded heavily as she began to pace around, her books following her closely.
"To be a member of your harem is to be quickly forgotten after a few pages in your Fable. I wouldn't be able to handle that, O Antiquity of Mana!"
Noah's eyes were sharp.
But this woman continued. "To be poor Anna Lexalius Dannicus. To be Athena! To be Valentina! Ah, the poor things, where are they now..."
HUUM!
This woman was truly serious when she said this as her craziness continued.
His women were forgotten? He had many clones spending time with them every day- barring when he was thrown into Hell Terra Firma!
Just because she did not hear about them from the Flow of Matter, she thought them to be forgotten?
Towards this request of hers though, Noah did not think much of it as he waved his hands.
"I will not lay my hands on you. You have my word."
She seemed a bit more on the crazy side. He had many more things to worry about now than dealing with an extra layer of craziness!
When she received this affirmation, the Queen of Matter became happy again as she turned her head sideways, her hands crossed with pride as she began speaking towards...nothing.
As if there were a group of people she was talking to in that direction, but Noah knew there was nothing there but stretches of Malformed Megalos for light years.
But she really turned and began to speak.

"Hey, look at us. You never thought you would see me on the big screen with Osmont himself, huh? This is to tell you kids to never stop dreaming. Some day, you will meet your heroes, and they won't disappoint you!"

She spoke to a blank of nothingness before she gave a thumbs up and turned back to Noah and Ruination, blinking at them as if nothing had just happened as Ruination could not help but ask her with incredulity.
"Who the hell were you talking to?"
The Queen of Matter blinked as if she did something that she naturally did before, but now had other people witness it! She coughed as she stumbled her words out.
"I...was just breaking the fourth wall lightly there. Just something I do, don't mind me."
"..." Ruination shook her head incredulously as if she couldn't understand.
HUUM!
"..." Noah understood the language and her intent as he wondered if mental states of Greater Sources could be warped this much as he sighed before he spoke out.
"You...have read too many Fables throughout the Flow of Matter across Frequencies as things can at times feel detached or not real."
HUUM!
His complexity buzzed as he beckoned towards the Queen of Matter, and her gorgeous figure came to be inches away from him.
"There are Fables across frequencies, yes, but this is very, very real."
She was inches away from him as her eyes buzzed.
She saw the seriousness within them as she nodded up and down!

"There is an entity unknown in nature with goals we do not understand who has gotten their hands on the Primal Flame of the Wheel and now, a so called Book of Existence. There are many complexities to be discerned as those moving against such a being have to be, at the very least, a bit serious."
"...!" Her mouth opened in an O shape as she seemed absolutely shocked.
"He has the Primal Flame of the Wheel?! No!"
Her eyes showed pure panic at this and Noah kept calm.

"No...if he has the Primal Flame of the Wheel and the Book of Existence, he can connect to all the Nodes of Existence at once and change and make any changes to the flow of the Wheel that he wishes! But...it shouldn't be like this. The flow...the flow!"
She pulled on her hairs as if the world around her was ending.
"Just when I meet my Hero..." Her shoulders slumped as if she truly believed this was the end.
Noah adapted to the complexities of this being as he voiced out with a sigh.
"He only has less than half the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence. I have the other half."
WAA!
Two sentences.
But they took the Queen of Matter who had fallen to the depths of despair into bright light again as she looked towards Noah with eyes of blinding luminosity.
As if her belief in him had just shot up to the highest levels!
She was close to him as her hands reached out as if to confirm he was real, only to be pulled back by the neck like a chicken as Ruination held her while gazing coldly.
But the Queen of Matter was entirely rejuvenated as she puffed up her chest while speaking out.

"As expected of the True Emperor of Quintessence! If that's the case, then all is not lost! After all, I was the Librarian of the Book of Existence, and I remembered everything within it! If I add what I know to you..."

chapters.title: Chapter 3593 Fables! VI
paragraphs: If she added what she knew to him!
"Huhu! Haha!"
The Queen of Matter laughed to herself even as she was held by the neck, and her eyes gazed at Noah luminously as she continued.

"Have you used the Primal Flame of the Wheel yet? I know of the Node of Existence at the center of this Prime Frequency of the End as we can use that alongside the Primal Flame of the Wheel to make our own changes to the Flow!"
She spoke with shining eyes as on this, Noah finally became interested.
He also noted the distinction of the Prime Frequency of the End!
"Oh?"
"Mmm, let me see. The Node of Existence in the Prime Frequency of the End...."
She flipped through an empty book that had no words on its pages, her hands stopping on one empty page as her hands hovered over it while her Source burned brightly.

Ruination saw her focusing on such a task as she released her hands around the neck of the Queen of Matter, but subconsciously, this woman actually Ruination's hand and returned it towards her throat as if it could remain there a little bit longer!
Ruination pulled her hand back even faster while keeping a distance from the Queen of Matter, her gaze a weird one as she could not understand the tendencies of this being.
"Here we go! I can take us to the Node right now if you guys are good?"
Her eyes shone with accomplishment as she showed a white page that now had scribbles forming into a ridiculously bad map; Noah only glanced at it before he nodded.
"Lead the way."
"Yes, Sir!"
The Eyes of the Queen of Matter shone brightly at this as her Greater Source burned furiously, her power being so unique that no other Greater Source could possibly take her down!
With a glimmer of brilliance, she disappeared towards a certain direction as Noah and Ruination followed.
While such complex weavings of Existence were taking place.

In the distant weavings of the Infiniverse Megalos, Noah was staring at the blistering Primal Flame of the Wheel alongside the Infiniverse Megalos Body, but his figure was surrounded by a unique entanglement that crossed Frequencies to connect to another being!

From a connection of a distant past, the Entanglement with the Great Usurper was pulled on as Noah was currently conversing with Eckert freely across Frequencies- something that his true severing allowed him to do with ease as even a distance of Frequencies was severed to be nothing for his entanglements!
The voice of the Great Usurper was different as it felt like layers of other voices as he spoke out.

|Bob came to me not too long after I entered the Megalos Nihilos, calling my weavings unique before he sought to give me Core Tracings of the Wheel. Nothing about it seemed off, but he did seem like a big boss so I tried to usurp his soul to no avail multiple times. I haven't had any interactions with him apart from that.|
The musings of Bob were looked at and how they stretched out across the Megalos, with Noah nodding lightly as he replied.

"Okay. I met another creature who also came across Bob, a weird one who could peek across weavings of Matter to observe many things. She had a Book about me and my past adventures, as well as a Book on the Great Usurper."
|Oh?| The reply from Eckert was one of interest as right after...
|How tasty would a Source like that be? I have Anti-Matter and my initial state of Matter so maybe the change won't be too unique...|
The Great Usurper thought about other things entirely as it caused Noah to pause again before he continued talking with the Great Usurper!
His other body following the Queen of Matter, on the other hand, arrived at a unique region as they left the Expanse entirely to appear within an Omniverse of the Megalos Ynnere.

Within this Omniverse, the Queen of Matter disappeared into an Existential Domain and delved into a particular Reality that held an unknown number of Universes, eventually settling on a small Galaxy that had a few million stars within it.
Inside a minor world in such a small corner of absolutely nowhere.
Their figures came to a stop in the skies above farmland with swathes of corn fields stretching out.
A few tractors were seen in the distance alongside farmhouses with normal human beings who weren't even able to notice their existence at this moment.
Noah looked around such a small, insignificant place as he asked.
"Here?"
Even as his will swept out around not just this world, but its universe and larger Omniverse it was it...he found nothing!

And yet the Queen of Matter nodded with affirmation as she hummed and floated down the corn fields, their figures arriving between rows of corn as The Queen of Matter pointed into the earth down below where...a wooden stake pushed into the ground could be seen.
"This is the Node of Existence running through the Prime Frequency of the End!"
She spoke such words with confidence as she turned towards Noah as if waiting for cheers and accolades.
Yet he only gazed at her calmly as she coughed and pointed to it.
"If you would please conjure up even a flicker of the Primal Flame of Existence..."
A Node.
The Node of the Prime Frequency of the End.
Noah looked at the nondescript piece of wood stuck in the earth as, on his palm, a flame of terrifying temperature and complexity bloomed that the Queen of Matter danced excitedly at its appearance!
Behind her, a book had its pages open as it stated <Chapter 1: Altering the Node of the Home Frequency of the 9th Infernal Lord!>
And the moment Noah brought out the silver white flame.
BZZZT!

A terrifying burst of complexity exploded out from the common wooden stake right after, Noah feeling a type of Complexity far exceeding any Source he had met so far rage out as amidst such blooming complexity, the excited shouts of the Queen of Matter could be heard!
"Now, you can alter the Flow of Existence in this Frequency to be whatever you like!"

"Huhu!
Haha!"
The Queen of Matter laughed to herself even as she was held by the neck, and her eyes gazed at Noah luminously as she continued.
"Have you used the Primal Flame of the Wheel yet?
I know of the Node of Existence at the center of this Prime Frequency of the End as we can use that alongside the Primal Flame of the Wheel to make our own changes to the Flow!"
She spoke with shining eyes as on this, Noah finally became interested.
He also noted the distinction of the Prime Frequency of the End!
"Oh?"
"Mmm, let me see.
The Node of Existence in the Prime Frequency of the End...."
She flipped through an empty book that had no words on its pages, her hands stopping on one empty page as her hands hovered over it while her Source burned brightly.

Ruination saw her focusing on such a task as she released her hands around the neck of the Queen of Matter, but subconsciously, this woman actually Ruination's hand and returned it towards her throat as if it could remain there a little bit longer!
Ruination pulled her hand back even faster while keeping a distance from the Queen of Matter, her gaze a weird one as she could not understand the tendencies of this being.
"Here we go!
I can take us to the Node right now if you guys are good?"
Her eyes shone with accomplishment as she showed a white page that now had scribbles forming into a ridiculously bad map; Noah only glanced at it before he nodded.
"Lead the way."
"Yes, Sir!"
The Eyes of the Queen of Matter shone brightly at this as her Greater Source burned furiously, her power being so unique that no other Greater Source could possibly take her down!
With a glimmer of brilliance, she disappeared towards a certain direction as Noah and Ruination followed.
While such complex weavings of Existence were taking place.

The voice of the Great Usurper was different as it felt like layers of other voices as he spoke out.
|Bob came to me not too long after I entered the Megalos Nihilos, calling my weavings unique before he sought to give me Core Tracings of the Wheel.
Nothing about it seemed off, but he did seem like a big boss so I tried to usurp his soul to no avail multiple times.
I haven't had any interactions with him apart from that.|
The musings of Bob were looked at and how they stretched out across the Megalos, with Noah nodding lightly as he replied.
"Okay.
I met another creature who also came across Bob, a weird one who could peek across weavings of Matter to observe many things.
She had a Book about me and my past adventures, as well as a Book on the Great Usurper."
|Oh?| The reply from Eckert was one of interest as right after...
|How tasty would a Source like that be?
I have Anti-Matter and my initial state of Matter so maybe the change won't be too unique...|
The Great Usurper thought about other things entirely as it caused Noah to pause again before he continued talking with the Great Usurper!

Inside a minor world in such a small corner of absolutely nowhere.

chapters.title: Chapter 3594 The Flow! I
paragraphs: It was a unique type of Complexity.
Nothing like the complexity of Sources as this felt like a convergence of everything in a single point of brilliance.
It only reacted to the dazzling silver white flames as after being activated, its weavings pulsed while showing a possibility of change.
Change that could only be carried out and etched by the silver white flame dancing in his hands!
With them, he could change the Flow of Existence of this Frequency as he wished.
The Flow.
What exactly what the Flow?
Noah's eyes flashed with incandescent radiance as beside him, the Queen of Matter had a serious expression filled with regality as she spoke out.

"Over the years, as I perceived and read the flow of different Frequencies and how Matter intertwined with all the beings there, I came to realize that even I cannot fully say I understand and comprehend everything about the Flow of the Wheel itself. But I came to think of it akin to a big puzzle. And all the myriad of creatures within a Frequency make up pieces of this puzzle. Some of these pieces have an extremely large influence as if they are taken away, a significant effect could be imposed on the flow, while other pieces carry such little effect that even if multiple are taken out, nothing will occur."

Her voice was serene and seemed to resonate with the surrounding weavings of matter, Noah's eyes remaining placid as he looked at the dancing silver-white flames and the stake that now looked like an insurmountable convergence of Existence itself.

"Nothing is ever set in stone. The biggest finding I came to realize over the years is that the flow...does not favor anyone. It is not emotional, nor is it apathetic. It just exists for the sake of itself as if the flow is disrupted...if an Ankyra of a certain Frequency dies, the flow does not mourn. It simply looks for another who is receptive enough to handle the heavy flow that was left behind, and someone else takes the mantle. The flow is logical. If there exists something far outside the scope of understanding and norms, let's say a certain Emperor of Quintessence arises as due to his power, causality, and effect he has on the surrounding existence becomes significant enough...he can siphon off the heavy flow of all others around those weavings of Existence."
WAA!

"He can outshine an Omniversal Ankyra, and he could theoretically siphon off the flow of a Frequency Ankyra without ever knowing them. The Flow...allows different levels of alteration to occur across the weavings of Existence as someone heavily surrounded by the flow will have an acceleration in their growth of complexity. But the terms of the Flow are set. Unchanged. Unchangeable. Unless...you have the same instrument that was there when these terms were born in the first place. The thing used to nurture and etch the terms of the Flow of Existence down an unknown number of cycles ago. The Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence."
HUUM!
The Node of Existence before Noah remained the same, but in his eyes, his will sank into it as he felt everything expanded and contracted at the same time, as he felt big and small at the same time!
It was only with the silver-white flames that he could stabilize himself as he saw the Node...was filled with constantly changing waves as if it were an endless sea made up of small, tiny nodes.
And he...was in a small portion of such an endless sea, flowing across large and small waves as everything moved together like a weave.
If there was a pull, there was a push.
And the way that this sea- this weave moved, had a certain flow to it that always remained the same!

Around him, there was a swirling mass of weavings that represented a massive convergence of the flow, with his figure having a big presence and effect on the surrounding weavings of existence as he could impose what he wished freely and with relatively low effort on his behalf.

His Pathways to True Sources made it possible for him to easily impose his existence and change the surrounding outcome, but at the end of the day, the flow of Existence always returned to what it was before!
But...
BZZT!

Noah brought the silver white flames onto the Node of the Prime Frequency of the End as the very structure of the weave stopped being so rigid- and there was a level of malleability towards it as the flow could be tweaked!
And so, he tried tweaking it just a little at first.
"In this Prime Frequency of the End, all scattered Tracings, Pieces, Spokes, or anything relating to the Wheel of Existence naturally gather towards my existence."
WAA!

The silver white Primal Flame of the Wheel burned and erupted out like a scorching whip, smashing down onto the weave of the Flow of Existence that the Node of Existence of the Prime Frequency of the End was connected to.
A clear white scorching mark spread around the Weave, but it was cemented as part of the Flow of Existence of this frequency itself!
WHOOSH!
And a wave of brilliance spread.
Everything turned silent.
As if there had been no change whatsoever.
But in the next moment...
Space nearby began to tweak and tremble.
Weavings shook tumultously as in the next moment, multiple heavy singularities of complexity crossed untold distances to appear all around Noah!
A terrific piece of a wooden rune with shattered runic letters.
A Core Trace that looked like a shield!
A Phantom Trace that looked Ethereal in nature.

A massive golden pillar that had a pointed end as it was another Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel- but this one held an entity that was impaled and still struggling to move as his Source raged out maddeningly!
Golden blood leaked from his chest where he was impaled, his visage being utterly astonishing as he held a glorious wonder of none other than someone Noah had seen before. A Golden Titan!

chapters.title: Chapter 3595 The Flow! II
paragraphs: A Golden Titan impaled by a Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel of Existence!
"OOOOH!"

The tremendous movement of the Spoke that had occurred as a result of Noah's alteration of the Flow of Existence actually pulled along an impaled Golden Titan that seemed to be struggling endlessly these past eons!

His body and blood were shockingly fused onto the Spoke by a unique power that seemed to hold him down this whole time, his eyes filled with rage and torment as it was only now that he realized he was not in the hellish prison he used to be in!
"Huh?"
He grasped the Spoke impaling him and looked around as his eyes locked onto the eyes of Noah, Ruination, and the Queen of Matter.

His weavings of a Prime Source stretched out as truly, he affirmed he was at an unknown location, freed from the bonds of a certain prison where he would have been kept until he chose to collapse his own Source!
But he persevered!
His Prime Source burned as he felt how much his restrictions had loosened, his hands clutching the Spoke he was impaled on as he roared out while starting to pull.
"I, THEODOSIUS, PERSEVERED!"
HUUM!
His Prime Source burned as seas of golden radiance erupted around him.
Theodosius!

Noah looked at this being impaled by the Spoke of the Wheel as he knew him very well, the severed weavings of Pyrrhus that held absolutely no claim over him now recognizing this Golden Titan that led the charge against the Megalonians!
His True Severed Weavings of the Megalos surged as they looked at this being coldly, Noah uttering out towards Ruination.
"Take everything."
WAA!

Ruination did not need to be told twice as all the Pieces relating to the Wheel in the surroundings surged towards her and fused into her body, her weavings erupting upwards in a show of glory as beside her, the Queen of Matter pointed her hands towards the struggling Theodosius as she yelled out in shock!

"Theodosius! Theodosius! I was wondering why I couldn't read your brutal reign anymore; you were actually imprisoned this whole time?! Who did such a thing to the prideful Theodosius?! Oh, was it him? Was it the Omnifather?!"
She asked such a question freely as the struggling Theodosius burned with ever greater fury, turning towards their direction as his giant hand shot down to extinguish them with perilous Complexity!
"BEGONE!"
HUUM!

It felt like the skies themselves collapsing after seeing such a show of force; the Queen of Matter yelped as she came to hide behind Noah, her books held by the strings of existence coming closer to her.
And Noah looked up at the descending golden palm as he raised his own to meet it.
The impact was heavy as shockingly, even with the terrifying complexity that Theodosius held, he was not able to cause Noah to move even a single inch!
The Queen of Matter looked at such a scene as her eyes trembled with excitement, looking between Noah and Theodosius as if this was the single greatest day of her life.
Her voice was resonant as it echoed out while she peeked from behind Noah!
"Merely a Prime Source Complexity that is unable to ascertain the depths of the heavens and the earth!"
Her voice was filled with courage and excitement as she pointed to an enraged Theodosius still struggling to escape the massive Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel.

"Do you know who you stand before?! This...is the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian that was promised! A man of sheer tyranny and pure will who blocked your entire Sourcd with a single effortless smack! What are you befo-...Mmm!"
The Queen of Matter began to speak about a distinction she only heard recently in the musings of Matter, beginning to prop up the brilliance of Noah at the same time when...
Ruination appeared behind her and clamped her mouth shut as up ahead, Theodosius heard her words as his eye gained clarity amidst the rage.
"What?"
He spoke with incredulity as he looked at Noah.
Really looked at Noah!
"Is it you? Is it really you, Megalonian?!"
WAA!
His weavings turned tumultuous as Noah waved his hands and pulled out a statue bound by a rope that he began to loosen.
The silver-white aura burning around the statue- a Tzar Versepiercer containing all three states of Existence tumultuously being unfurled!

"This is an unexpected surprise, Theodosius. I saw you once before as after I eradicated your Golden Titans, I thought you would come charging out next. I didn't expect you to be held down by a mere Spoke!"
WAA!

Noah's voice echoed out amidst an unfurling Tzar Versepiercer that caused Theodosius to feel a sense of trepidation, his weavings seeking to surge out and extinguishing everything before him as already, an unfathomable musing of Existence that had been exploding and building up a force was erupting out.
Theodosius felt it as he roared out.

"You all needed me! I was meant to go where that foolish idealist went! I was meant to exceed the weavings of the Wheel just like them! Do you truly think after being freed after all these cycles, you would deny me my birthright once more?! Who do think you are?!"

His Prime Source shone illustriously. He stopped struggling to leave the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel as he fully focused on Noah and the statue expanding like a balloon in his hands, with the body of Theodosius erupting with trillions of golden strings all around like an incandescent sun.
His gaze was filled with malice as he roared out with defiance.
"I was born of royal lineage and utmost regality, with my weavings meant to cover the vast frequencies and flows of the Wheel! Before me, what are you to deny any of this?!"
HUUM!

Utmost brilliance flared as behind Noah, a trembling Queen of Matter had a book in front of her writing everything down furiously, her eyes looking at everything as if she were just a mere observer in a grand Fable!

chapters.title: Chapter 3596 The Flow! III
paragraphs: A man of supreme lineage and purpose!
This was who Theodosius was as how dare others do this to him?
The Omnifather was a feeble idealist who had the help of others, while these people here...
"HOW! DARE! YOU!"
He bellowed out as around his body, lights perfectly converged to cover absolutely everything in a show of wonder and power.
Prime.
What did it mean to be a Prime Source?
Behind Noah, a trembling Queen of Matter was speaking out as if she were reciting a book.

"Theodosius! A tyrant who moved for the sole purpose of more and more power, with his path and source being something very few could even attain! He held the Source of the Golden Ratio- his Source being capable of calculating and overcoming any opposition by calculating the golden ratio of exactly what was needed to overcome it!"

"All weavings around his source do trillions of calculations instantly and proceed to enact absolute distortions of existence to defend against attacks or ensure that their weavings achieve the purpose of destruction. It is a glorious source to have!"
Her eyes were bright as she said this, Noah's Severed Extractor having just attained the name of the Source of this being as he could confirm it.
Golden Ratio.
A unique weaving, but was there any possible calculation that existed to provide defense against a Tzar Versepiercer?
And he was in the Cycle of Ordo at this moment as absolutely nothing could hurt him!
Pillars of golden light illuminated all directions as the Tzar Versepiercer unfurled fully at this time.
WUU!
The surroundings became eerily quiet as in the surrounding, multiple overlapping ancient wooden-like Wheels of Existence bloomed as all of them were at the very center.
Not a single Wheel- but 9 Wheels with their own spokes and ancient wooden majesty as they bloomed into a circle with each covering a different direction.
And the Prime Source complexity that was Theodosius happened to be at the very center of these 9 Wheels as his weavings quaked.

His expression was calm as his body impaled in the Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel was utterly still, waves of golden light surging around him as it calculated everything that was coming and began to distort existence.

The eerie quietness remained as it was like nearby existence was forced to be this way by the emerging Tzar Versepiercer, which told everything around it had to quiet down before its brilliance unfurled! Even the sound of golden waves of a Prime Source moving in constant flux as they calculated for the golden ratio was forced to be quiet as Theodosius' voice bloomed lowly and intently in all this.
"All my life was for a singular purpose. So the people seeking to take my purpose away...are peeling apart what I am at my core."
HUUM!
"Such people are-..."

He was in the middle of talking in this quiet space, but he was interrupted by a sharp voice that was looking at everything nearby with pulsing eyes of excitement. "He's so fucking cool, if he wasn't such an asshole, he could have used his source for great things!"
The Queen of Matter said this as Theodosius was forced to quiet down.
His golden light continued to calculate for that perfect number.
For the golden ratio that allowed him to enact the perfect defense against this terrifying attack that shockingly had extremely genuine weavings of the Wheel all around.
And as if his thoughts could be read, Noah looked at this being in this state of silence as the ancient wooden wheels around them began to tremble and had cracks spread throughout them.
"Whatever golden ratio you have...you will not be able to find the perfect formula against this. For that, you would have needed to solve the Three Body Problem. Have you done that, O Theodosius?"
WAA!
His words were filled with impenetrable regality as behind him, the Queen of Matter visibly squealed at his voice while she wrote everything down furiously!
And Theodosius held no answer as, even at this moment, his Prime Source was still calculating.
It always seemed close to finding an answer to the equation, but the factors making up the equation would change right after and cause the ratio to change.
He was sure that it would just take time. He didn't think he would come across an ever-evolving problem that his golden ratio would spend so much time looking for the answer to!
And the problem itself waited no longer.
The trembling cracking wheels instantly began to reduce in size, and they were radiant in color as some Wheels were white, some gold, and some were black!
They all reduced in size like spinning wheels of glory as they locked onto the figure of Theodosius and reduced to cover his figure entirely!
Their spokes passed through him as if he didn't exist.

All 9 converged around his body that was shining with lustrous golden waves of distorting existence, and yet none of the distortions were able to do anything as Theodosius became bound by nine ancient wheels that exploded at once!
Behind Noah, the eyes of the Queen of Matter were luminous as she spoke to herself.

"Ladies and Gentlemen, what we are watching now is the very unwinding of Existence of a Prime Source. A Prime Source- something untouchable in nature as it has reached a pinnacle of existence others can only dream of. While others look at this in fear, the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian looks at this and asks, what Prime Source? What Pinnacle? Is it anything good for me to even worry about?"

"He looks down upon such a Source as he proceeds to skin a Prime Source of his unfathomable weavings like an animal. Like a dog. And a grand entity that has lived for cycles is reduced to wonder...were they truly just a dog this whole time? It is a reality of a hunt conducted like a symphony by an advanced hunter others do not understand, and a primitive animal struggling to find its purpose."
Her voice was serene.
It held a unique sense of charm as ahead of them, a Prime Source was screaming in the middle of an impaled Spoke!

chapters.title: Chapter 3597 The Flow! IV
paragraphs: The Queen of Matter narrated what was happening as if she were overseeing a documentary of nature and commenting on it.
A documentary of a hunter taking down an animal whose weavings were not at all comparable!

But in the perspective of Theodosius, this was his very life and livelihood as his weavings illuminated brightly to cover any gaps amidst the subsequent and constant explosions that erupted with Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter constantly- each one being akin to the collapse of multiple Megalos all at once.
His Golden Ratio sought an answer as it never stopped!
"OOOOOH!"
His purpose never left him.

And because his Source was Prime, it held enough power as even though it could not find the perfect golden ratio, it still covered his existence from being entirely torn apart and had enough weavings left over!
BOOM!
The last explosion occurred as the Prime Source of Theodosius breathed heavily.

His golden skin was peeled and torn all around, and his body looked utterly grotesque, white gold muscles spasming all around as deep ravines could be seen extending in the depths of some parts of his body.
His Prime Source was injured.
But he was alive.
Even though he could not find the perfect equation, what he had managed to solve was still enough to allow him to survive!
He looked coldly at Noah while behind him, the Queen of Matter continued to speak out.
"The Theodosius is a primitive animal, found in the mountain ranges of the Ethereal Titanos Megalos..."
As if she was speaking about and observing an animal in nature, she continued!
Every word of hers simply caused Theodosius to feel waves of unbridled rage as when he got out of this; he would skin her alive and eat what gave her the capability to talk!
"Being a primitive animal that prefers isolation, it does not have its herd around it as it finds itself in a perilous situation."
WAA!

"Having survived against an unfathomable attack, it prepared for a counterattack as this primitive creature has missed something truly critical. If it was still in a good state of mind, it would be able to ask itself, why do I only see two existences ahead of me at this moment? Where is that gorgeous-looking girl bathed in red and gold? Just where, oh where, is Ruination?"
The infuriating words had caused him to pause as his weavings looked down below.
Only Noah was staring at him coldly, and the visage of an excited narrating Queen of Matter could be seen, the third entity not with them here!
Noah's eyes flashed with brilliance as he spoke out to Theodosius.
"Be proud, for you are the first to fall under the hands of the Ruined Miniare Wheel of Existence."
HUUM!
The pupils of Theodosius shone tremendously as an instant later, his golden pupils began to reflect red.
Red!

Behind him, out of nowhere, the visage of Ruination had appeared silently without being discovered by the weavings of a Prime Source, her hand having transformed into a Spoke that had its pointed end touch the back of the head of Theodosius!

The entire body of Theodosius froze as Ruination also had her limbs expand to wrap around the golden Spoke that impaled him and already became entrenched in the heart of his Source as her voice echoed out.
"Ruination of Existence."
HUUM!
Ruination.
After absorbing nearly all the Sources of Pieces relating to the Wheel of Existence in this Frequency, she imposed Ruin for the first time on a Source.

The Prime Source of Theodosius, already impaled by a Spoke and heavily injured by a Tzar Versepiercer...was forced to freeze the moment it did not sense the silent Ruination as right away, its Golden Ratio became filled with crimson radiance.
Ruin descended upon its source freely and heavily!
He tried to speak.
He recalled his glorious lineage.
His birthright.
What he was meant for.
He was not meant to die!
And even in this state, that voice that had distracted him enough to not even be able to sense another nearing continued!

"And now, we see the last death throes of a primitive animal. Violent. Heaving. Sad. It is the final moments of a creature that has roamed these Megalos for cycles being put to rest by a predator it did not understand. I would say that maybe it could learn from this and do better in its next life, but there is no such thing for this creature as this...is the last chapter of its book!"
BOOM!
The Queen of Matter closed a massive book.
As if she had written everything she needed to!

The weavings of Theodosius wanted to rage, but his Prime Source became filled with endless waves of Ruin as he could no longer calculate anything, his golden ratio communicating with him one last time as it told him of a shocking finding.
This whole time, it could not find the perfect formula for defense or opposition against that being that stood against him.
A ratio did not exist to counter him!
HUUM!
Immense weavings seethed as the massive body of Theodosius became utterly still, his scorched skin showing wriggling muscles bathed in crimson ruin.

From his back, a Piece of a Spoke of the Wheel of Existence began to slide out of him smoothly as Ruination pulled it out herself, her mouth opening as the massive spoke became smaller and was swallowed by her entirely!

And the figure of Theodosius remained frozen as in the next moment, ancient crimson tattoos with Runes that read <RUIN> began spreading all around him, his body becoming covered with them as his Prime Source...did not decay and die.

Under the Ruin of Existence, the Prime Source was altered as it thrived and became even more intense, a terrifying aura blooming around Theodosius as Ruination removed her hands from him cooly while speaking out.
"Master, I give you the first of many gifts. I give you the first Ruined Prime Source Complexity- Theodosius."
In the next moment, Theodosius opened his eyes again.
But all they held was Ruin.
No mention of its previous cognizance.
The moment it woke, it gazed towards Noah and bent its knee!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 3598 The Flow! V
paragraphs: An entity of immense pride.
An entity of a terrifying Prime Source!
An entity that, at the moment he became a Ruined Prime Source of Existence- his towering visage becoming a crimson gold Titan that bent its knee towards Noah!
As it did so.
"This is just one of many gifts, Master."
Behind the Ruined Theodosius, Ruination tapped out to the head of this Prime Source as his whole body buzzed, his head splitting open as vibrant crimson gold singularities flowed out!
Each one felt like a terrifying aura just as intense as the Ruined Prime Source Theodosius himself, but they were separated from him as he spat out 6 in number.
"Purified Ruined Prime Sources for Master to utilize as he wishes. This is the second gift."
Ruined Prime Sources of Theodosius!
Noah grasped just one of these singularities as they looked like dazzling fruits plucked from gardens of terrifying complexity.

Behind him, the Queen of Matter had an expression of intrigue and surprise as she looked at the Prime Sources, her eyes luminous while she also stared at Ruination who had managed to defeat an enemy, turn them into a soldier of the True Emperor of Quintessence, and still obtain loot from them that was multiplied in number!
A terrifying thing that only Ruination would be capable of!

"The Prime Source of a man that had the potential to be similar to the weavings of the Omnifather, the Great Beyonder, and others that took their Sources and exceeded their weavings even further. The 9th Infernal Lord looks at the Source of such a being as he...!"
The Queen of Matter observed Noah placing the dazzling Source in his mouth and start chewing, his expression a calm one as if he was testing just what flavor a Prime Source had!
The Queen of Matter pulled on her hair at this crazily as she continued!
"A mere question of flavor! This is what a Prime Source Complexity has been reduced to! Oh! But from it, the True Emperor of Quintessence shall attain..."
The eyes of the Queen of Matter were bright.
She knew that Noah went by many distinctions and held many different parts under his source.
If he was eating the Prime Sources of Theodosius...would he simply obtain the weavings of the Source of the Golden Ratio just like that?
The Queen of Matter only had this thought, but Noah was already watching prompts rolling down that told him many things!
|The Source of the Golden Ratio has undergone True Severing and has been incorporated into your Atlas of Existence.|

|The Conceptual Pathway to the True Source taken on the Golden Ratio under its banner, rounds of Severings starting to occur as the True Severed Weavings of the Golden Ratio are burned by the purifying flames of the Singed.|
It was a powerful Source.
The moment that Noah understood it and watched it become truly severed, his body pulsed as it began to conduct rapid calculations endlessly...for everything about him.
Not just the best ratio for defense and offense.
The golden ratio for his weavings of existence.
He knew that this weaving was bound to give him many surprises as in the midst of all of this...
|Purposefully, the selection of seconds has been selected after countless formulaic equations that have altered and triggered the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity.|

|The passage of an instant may not be allowed without your complexity undergoing a targetted, significant burst of elevation that will be supported entirely by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.| |The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has purposefully declared the burst of elevation to stem from the weavings of...Kuklos.|
|The Severed Weavings of Kuklos, backed by the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity, surge across Severings and heads towards their Final Severed State!|

Surprises were abundant all around as countless calculations were made, and Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity was triggered based on the calculations of the Golden Ratio...the thing that was triggered was actually Kuklos!
That after looking at all the possible concepts within Noah's weavings, it was decided from countless computations that currently, Kuklos had to be next.
This was what the musings of the Golden Ratio brought as within his Mundis of Power, a particular one...had a wheel that began to spin slowly.
Kuklos.
A word relating to the Wheel! Relating to a sense of continuity that a circle had as for Noah, it could have many meanings.
But for now, it went towards becoming a pathway.

All six Ruined Prime Sources from Theodosius were absorbed into Noah's body as they would all be used as fuel to further walk on the focused path of the Singed that had its road continue to be built even now.
And as all of this occurred, Ruination came closer to Noah as she spoke out.
"The third gift to Master..."
She had begun to speak as the Queen of Matter turned to her with great focus, but when her eyes landed on her, they froze as if they finally had something click!
"Wait...wait!" At this moment, The Queen of Matter froze as if she remembered something truly important.
She opened a book she had recently closed and read what she had just written down with a shocked face.
"You said a little while ago that Ruination was a Ruined Miniare Wheel of Existence? A Wheel of Existence?! What!?"
Her eyes showed great shock as she was ashamed for having heard this and not registering it in real time.
She had been too excited to narrate the death of the Great Theodosius as such a thing passed over her head!
A Wheel!
Granted, a Ruined Miniare Wheel of Existence, but a Wheel was a wheel!
The Great Queen trembled as she looked towards Ruination with a heated gaze as if she were looking at the most treasured item in the world.
"Do you know what it means to start gaining the distinction of a Wheel? Even if it is any type of Wheel at that- do you know, Ruination?!"
The gaze of the Queen of Matter was heated as she went closer to Ruination!

chapters.title: Chapter 3599 The Flow! VI
paragraphs: She went closer to Ruination while ignoring everything as Ruination had to place her hand on her head to stop her from coming any closer, her eyes simmering with the light of stars as she continued!

"To be a Wheel is to start having your own Flow. To be independently taken out of the Flow of Existence all of us are in. With this, your Source can become anything in the realm of possibilities as for you to be a Wheel....ah!"
The information seemed to have overloaded her brain as her body that was pushed back by Ruination continued looking up in shock while floating listlessly!
Ruination shook her head to ignore her while coming behind Noah and placing her hands on him.
"The Severed Singed Affixes of Existence can be tremendously elevated, and new ones can be designed, Master. I can start on this process."

Ruination worked efficiently as her complex weavings of Existence already began to flow within Noah who already currently had an explosive change taking place due to Kuklos going towards becoming a Pathway.
He nodded calmly as his hands still held the Node of Existence as the silver flame that burned around it.

He had altered the Flow of Existence once as the result was all pieces relating to the Wheel brought to him within this frequency, and such an action even brought a chained Theodosius who was taken down to grant him the Source of the Golden Ratio among other things.
Those other things...were possibilities of information.
Noah looked towards the kneeling Theodosius and the listlessly floating body of the Queen of Matter that had floated close to it as he asked.
"You knew the Omnifather. Where has he and others gone in these past eons? Where have you been trying to reach this whole time?"
The weavings of Theodosius were ruined and scattered, but they were still there as this being remained kneeling while he spoke.

"The Omnifather was an idealist, but his path was a strong one. He was lucky enough to have the help of the Megalonian, who sacrificed herself for his Source- gaining a mutation that further helped him exceed Prime Source Complexity. That helped him transform and attain an Undeniable Telos Source that the weavings of the Wheel could do nothing against, and he came to imprison me for my actions after that."
WAA!
The Ruined Prime Source of Theodosius still spoke with hate towards the Omnifather, thinking back to the eyes that looked at him as if he were beath everything.

"He told me that he would not kill me, and would instead imprison me until he was back as he went to the very last Observable Flows of the Wheel to forge himself into something that would far exceed any Prime Source! A Place I only dreamed of but would remain chained for cycles to never ever see!"

Theodosius revealed unique weavings of existence as when he did so, the visage of the Queen of Matter was recharged once more as she came to sit on the shoulders of Theodosius with an excited expression.
She seemed like an ancient child who knew a lot but was easily distracted by one thing after another, a book already in her hands as she wrote down everything!
Around this same time.
Away from this small world the Node of Existence was hidden in, in the larger Megalos Ynnere.
WAP!
The figure of Mysara floated grandly between an expanse of Omniverses as she saw the unfolding flaming rift in space where from it, the figure of a terrifyingly powerful Source walked out.
A flaming woman with extremely concentrated white gold flame of the Singed, her source burning furiously bright as she seemed like a gorgeous sun.
Tendrils of white gold flaming hair flowed down her back, her eyes shining like golden suns as her skin undulated with white gold light.
The blue flames around Mysara quivered as she gave a light bow.
"I apologize to the Prime Singed for the secrecy. I-"
"Is it him?"
She interrupted Mysara as she was currently a bit out of sorts.
The Singed who were observing the Prime Frequency of Life taken over by the Faceless Lifeforms had managed to get a glimpse of him.
When she saw him, her heart fluttered as many memories arose, but she was not sure.
And then, Mysara called out to her within the Prime Frequency of Flames as she said...the one they had seen oppose Faceless Lifeforms would like to talk to her!
Which Singed would not even tell her the identity of another person as they would proceed to be mysterious like this?
What would make a Singed not tell everything to the one currently overseeing the direction of all Singed?
When all of this came together, she had to ask.
She was Emelline of the First Flame.
One of the earliest Singed after the Origin Singed as she held countless waves of knowledge.
And even she asked Mysara.
Was it him?!

Mysara turned emotional at this question as she knew how much the identity of the man who enacted all these weavings meant to them, and she nodded furiously as beside her, space flickered while the visage of Noah stepped out.
Noah, in a golden Emperor's robe while his body silently burned with an incandescent glow of flames that were the most advanced path of his weavings.
The weavings of the Singed were vibrant around him as when Emelline of the First Flame saw them...
BOOM!
Her Prime Source instantly exploded as she disappeared where she was!

When Mysara blinked, she only felt burning heat near her as Emelline of the First Flame smashed into the Origin Singed, her body hugging him tightly as her expression showed loss, anger, and joy at the same time.
"You left us...you left us, O Origin Singed!"
She howled out her anger and loss as if she had to bear far too much weight on her shoulders this whole time.

Around them, a white gold flaming domain began to form as Emelline of the First Flame showed tremendous anger, her legs locking onto Noah's waist as she pushed him down onto burning flames while her figure draped off the golden sun dress she wore.
"Before you disappear from us again and leave everything to us, I will take what you promised me before and attain the Telos Source of the Singed!"

Noah raised his brows beneath this fiery woman that he called over to just ask some questions, but just like Mysara, she truly took him to be the Origin Singed she knew of as she was even more entangled with them!

And at this moment, her incandescent figure of utmost beauty and glory became bare before him as, with anger swirling around her, she sought a connection to his Pathway to the True Source of the Singed!

chapters.title: Chapter 3600 Wheels and Flames I
paragraphs: A shocking weaving of existence erupted in a certain point of the Megalos Ynnere that became covered by white gold flames and obscured everything else!
Amidst the white gold flames, the shocked blue flames of Mysara remained as she witnessed something unspeakable.
But all of this...was in a state of matter.
All around, even the flames of the Singed, were surrounded by weavings of Matter!
Thus...
Back in a nondescript world where the Node of Existence of the Prime Frequency of the End was located in.
The figure of the Queen of Matter was sitting on the shoulders of a massive Theodosius while swinging her legs freely.
Books connected to strings danced around her gleefully as suddenly, her legs stopped their laid-back kicking as her eyes glazed white and black.
Her Source pulsed as Fabled Matter received feedback based on any important events occurring across matter relating to certain key figures!
And at this moment, she caught a glimpse of the weavings of Matter around a certain area as she couldn't help but scream out.

Her resonant screams interrupted a somber atmosphere of Theodosius thinking of the past, and Noah along side Ruination were carrying out heavy advancement to their weavings of Existence at the same time!
The Queen of Matter screamed in the middle of all of this as she looked towards Noah in dismay.
"What...what are you doing to the Flower of the Flames, Emelline of the First Flame?!"
She had a look of dismay as if something that shouldn't be getting desecrated was being desecrated greatly right now!
Noah's eyes turned sharp as he waved his hands, the visage of the Queen of Matter being pulled towards him and standing inches away as he asked.

"Just how pervasive is your Source? Anything relating to Matter that you deem important gets reported to you? Do you also have records of what went around Matter cycles ago? Records of the Omnifather and others?"
Her gaze truly saw far as the Source she had was utterly broken.

Emelline of the First Flame had just appeared before him now and began doing what she did, and why would he say no to a proactive cultivation with a Prime Source Complexity- a Singed at that who was deeply connected to the flames of the Wheel?
And her words also interested him when she spoke of attaining an Undeniable Telos Source from him!
But these were his matters.
The Queen of Matter...gazed upon and even saw this as his interest in her Source became elevated even more.
And yet, towards his questions, she looked at him with great grievances as she spoke out sullenly.
"Sir Osmont. Mr. True Emperor of Quintessence. Mr 9th Infernal Lord. I....say with utmost respect and adoration for you, but I think you may have a problem, Sir."
Her eyes were sincere.
Her eyes were clear!
But Noah remained unfazed as he knew her character by now, watching her with interest as she continued with a serious, aggrieved look!
"Women. Dual Cultivation...I think this may be a problem for you, sir."
She said this without blinking.
And as if every word she said was right, she was only more bolstered and courageous as she continued!

"For example! Emelline of the First Flame is a critical figure on the Flow of Existence of multiple Frequencies of Existence! If you are out here poking around her right now, and she becomes another harem member whose existence disappears into oblivion, how will the flow of existence across different Frequencies continue?!"
WAA!
Emelline!
An important leader of the Singed whose flow affected multiple Frequencies.
In her knowledge and view point, she could not just become another forgotten member of the Wheel!
So she stood up against the one she adored the most.
She told Noah that he had a problem!
He looked at her and smiled, his eyes causing her to become frightened as she covered her face and chest as if Noah would become enticed by her and devour her here too.
Yet the True Severed Origin Osmontian spoke calmly as he felt Kuklos approaching the 81st Severing.

"I was a man, and I am still a man all these years later. I do not believe in losing the desires that made me who I was just because I am transcending countless weavings of Existence. I do not believe in becoming some apathetic Transcendent entity looking at everything in black and white."
HUUM!
As he spoke, his weavings churned tumultuously as behind him, Ruination elevated two Severed Affixes to a tremendous level at this same time.

"Food. Women. Loot. Power...these are just parts that make the True Emperor of Quintessence you know so well. Maybe they are flaws, but that's more than okay. After all, who in these fantastical weavings of existence is perfect? I've been a Conqueror, a Chef, a Farmer, and many more. If there was not an unknown Frequency Shattering Entity running around with a Primal Flame of the Wheel out there, I might have sought the True Sources of a farmer or cook first before anything else. But circumstances change many things. But circumstances...do not change me."
He tapped out as he uncovered the hand of the Queen of Matter covering her face as he continued.

"As for Emelline of the First Flame. Who are you to say the flow of the Wheel is not following its natural progression right now? She seeks to obtain the Undeniable Telos Source from me. What if she obtains it and becomes capable of fulfilling her weavings of the flow smoothly after this?"
His words were resonant as the Queen of Matter was shocked, her eyes gradually becoming confused before they became determined.
She began to mutter.
"Circumstances change many things...circumstances do not change me..."
She muttered out words that seemed like gospel as she copied them down on a book right away, her eyes shining as she looked towards Noah with unfathomable radiance and spoke out.

"How could I ever doubt the Dreamer of Extremity? I apologize for veering off the path, Sir Osmont. I have a couple of names of entities with the same calibre if not a little bit lower than Emelline of the First Flame. Shall I set you up with them too?"
WAA!
He told her a few words, but she was too easily swayed by him as she went from one extreme of telling him he had a problem to now wanting to contribute to this problem!

chapters.title: Chapter 3601 Wheels and Flames II
paragraphs: The eyes of the Queen of Matter shone dangerously as she simply waited for the orders of her True Emperor of Quintessence.
He shook his head as he thought of all the possibilities out there.
What could be.
What could have been.

He did not wish to have any regrets as while his other bodies increased his complexity and sought grander Pathways, he still had other bodies within the Infiniverse Megalos enjoying the same hobbies he always had.
He was surprised that after all this time, there wasn't a random selection to take the True Severed Weavings of Cooking onto a Pathway already!
But...
"Everything happens in its own course. On its own...Flow."
HUUM!
As he said such words.
His weavings began to shake and tumble as a golden wheel began to spin around him.
A wheel that, with every turn, seemed to be breaking and shattering the weavings of Existence around him.
The Flow of Existence around him felt a disconnect!
Almost as if...he would enact his own Flow!
|The Severed Weavings of Kuklos have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of Kuklos has opened.|
|The True Severed Kuklos of Existence has been born.|
|The True Severed Wheel of the Origin Osmontian has been born.|
|Through the Pathway to the True Source of Kuklos, you have attained Absolute Flow, becoming capable of dictating your own Flow of Existence.|
BZZT!
|The Flow of the current Frequency of Existence has begun experiencing tumultuous changes due to the cut off of your Flow.|
The surroundings turned chaotic.
Weavings of Existence began to crumble as his flow became entirely cut off from the outside weavings!
The face of the Queen of Matter began to change as if she was witnessing a terrifying change of something in real time, and before Noah's eyes, a prompt arose.
|The Flow of the current Frequency of Existence has begun experiencing tumultuous changes due to the cut off of your Flow.|
Tumultuous changes were beginning to occur as for now....
"Proceed and resume with the same Flow observed before."
Noah spoke to the terrifying Wheel born inside of him that at this moment proceeded to overlap with his...Atlas of Existence!
The moment he gave the command, gaps were made between his weavings and the weavings of Existence stretching out all around him as the chaotic churning of weavings settled ever so slowly.
As if the flow they had before was slowly restored!
|The Flow of the True Severed Wheel of the Origin Osmontian has dictated to momentarily follow the persevered Flow of Existence permeating all around.|

|Through the Pathway to the True Source of Kuklos, your Atlas of Existence is being transformed to become a True Source Atlas of Existence. You can channel the weavings of everything within your True Source Atlas, and you can allow other Existences to reach out and connect to your True Source Atlas of Existence. Those touched by and channeling the power of your True Source Atlas of Existence will experience different weavings than the Weavings of the Wheel through which they are currently channeling complexity. Others can connect and channel their weavings through your True Source Atlas of Existence at no cost to you, and the more complexity channeling your Source, the grander and more complex this Source becomes.|
His Atlas...took on the form of an archaic Wheel, with massive unbreakable Spokes separating 9 Mundis of Power!
True Source Atlas of Existence!
Others could channel their weavings of Existence through it as they may come to find his Source...to be a better alternative to the Wheel of Existence they channeled their complexity through!
Noah looked at his Source as he realized at this moment what a tremendous change this could bring.
The dictation of his own flow. The channeling of weavings of existence through his own Source!
Just how ridiculous were the changes that he could make?

As he thought this, his mind went to Emelline of the First Flame who was currently connected to him, his weavings flowing through her as he was able to understand her Source of the Singed and how it had a unique Flow stretching out across this Frequency and even other frequencies.

He was able to see how her Prime Source complexity seethed with interminable might as all of it flowed through a grand and unfathomable Source- The Wheel of Existence where an unknown number of frequencies and complexities channeled their weavings through!
And now, such a being connected to him as she sought to make her Singed an Undeniable Telos Source.

Even when he just opened his Pathway to the True Source of the Singed, the late Persephael had accused him of having an Undeniable Telos Source. A type of source that was very hard for others to deny regardless of their complexity as she was not able to extinguish the Embers of his Flames!

If this was what Emelline of the First Flame sought, he could use her- someone unfathomably close to the Wheel of Existence, and see just how she would change if she attained qualities of a True Severed Singed contained within a True Source Atlas of Existence.
HUUM!
Interminable waves of complexity burned amidst...an entanglement between Noah and Emelline of the First Flame.
Amidst the mixing weavings, Emelline found a core part of her Source opening its eyes as she found herself standing...on a grand white gold flaming Pathway!
A Pathway that stretched out magisterially behind her, and ahead of her...it was still being built.
But the moment her feet touched it...
HUUM!
She felt her flames resonating and changing as their quality became different from what they used to be.
Her Prime Source became active as its weavings became even more complex!
She felt the quality...of something that could not be denied.
She simply stepped on a Pathway to the True Source as she felt its pristine wonder, and the fact that this Pathway was still being forged even now!
Her gorgeous expression was filled with sadness as tears fell from her flaming eyes, and she spoke out calmly.
"You...are not the Origin Singed, are you?"
She spoke.
But she knew the one who was enacting this Pathway to a True Source...was here. The man she was currently entangled with.
Behind her, sitting down and watching the Pathway that was being built, Noah's gaze was serene as he nodded in reply.

"I am not the Origin Singed you know. I am someone who managed to seek the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed though, and this seems to make any entity burnt by the Flame mistake me for the Origin Singed. Did that Entity also seek the True Source, or was he just given a truly close authority by the weavings of the Wheel?"
Noah asked calmly as the tears on Emelline of the First Flame stopped, a sad smile falling on her face as she shook her head.

"The Origin Singed was the Origin Singed. The one with the highest level of Purity of the Flame of the Singed as even if you are not him...you are also him. Paradoxical as it may be. You are not the Origin Singed, and at the same time, you are. It matters not. All that matters is that somewhere in the flow of the Wheel, there is the Origin Singed when he is needed. And currently, you have been needed."
WAA!
