|The Flow of the current Frequency of Existence has begun experiencing tumultuous changes due to the cut off of your Flow.|
Tumultuous changes were beginning to occur as for now....
"Proceed and resume with the same Flow observed before."
Noah spoke to the terrifying Wheel born inside of him that at this moment proceeded to overlap with his...Atlas of Existence!
The moment he gave the command, gaps were made between his weavings and the weavings of Existence stretching out all around him as the chaotic churning of weavings settled ever so slowly.
As if the flow they had before was slowly restored!
|The Flow of the True Severed Wheel of the Origin Osmontian has dictated to momentarily follow the persevered Flow of Existence permeating all around.|
|Through the Pathway to the True Source of Kuklos, your Atlas of Existence is being transformed to become a True Source Atlas of Existence.
You can channel the weavings of everything within your True Source Atlas, and you can allow other Existences to reach out and connect to your True Source Atlas of Existence.

Those touched by and channeling the power of your True Source Atlas of Existence will experience different weavings than the Weavings of the Wheel through which they are currently channeling complexity.

Others can connect and channel their weavings through your True Source Atlas of Existence at no cost to you, and the more complexity channeling your Source, the grander and more complex this Source becomes.|
His Atlas...took on the form of an archaic Wheel, with massive unbreakable Spokes separating 9 Mundis of Power!
True Source Atlas of Existence!
Others could channel their weavings of Existence through it as they may come to find his Source...to be a better alternative to the Wheel of Existence they channeled their complexity through!
Noah looked at his Source as he realized at this moment what a tremendous change this could bring.
The dictation of his own flow.
The channeling of weavings of existence through his own Source!
Just how ridiculous were the changes that he could make?

As he thought this, his mind went to Emelline of the First Flame who was currently connected to him, his weavings flowing through her as he was able to understand her Source of the Singed and how it had a unique Flow stretching out across this Frequency and even other frequencies.

He was able to see how her Prime Source complexity seethed with interminable might as all of it flowed through a grand and unfathomable Source- The Wheel of Existence where an unknown number of frequencies and complexities channeled their weavings through!
And now, such a being connected to him as she sought to make her Singed an Undeniable Telos Source.
Even when he just opened his Pathway to the True Source of the Singed, the late Persephael had accused him of having an Undeniable Telos Source.
A type of source that was very hard for others to deny regardless of their complexity as she was not able to extinguish the Embers of his Flames!

If this was what Emelline of the First Flame sought, he could use her- someone unfathomably close to the Wheel of Existence, and see just how she would change if she attained qualities of a True Severed Singed contained within a True Source Atlas of Existence.
HUUM!
Interminable waves of complexity burned amidst...an entanglement between Noah and Emelline of the First Flame.
Amidst the mixing weavings, Emelline found a core part of her Source opening its eyes as she found herself standing...on a grand white gold flaming Pathway!
A Pathway that stretched out magisterially behind her, and ahead of her...it was still being built.
But the moment her feet touched it...
HUUM!
She felt her flames resonating and changing as their quality became different from what they used to be.
Her Prime Source became active as its weavings became even more complex!
She felt the quality...of something that could not be denied.
She simply stepped on a Pathway to the True Source as she felt its pristine wonder, and the fact that this Pathway was still being forged even now!
Her gorgeous expression was filled with sadness as tears fell from her flaming eyes, and she spoke out calmly.
"You...are not the Origin Singed, are you?"
She spoke.
But she knew the one who was enacting this Pathway to a True Source...was here.
The man she was currently entangled with.
Behind her, sitting down and watching the Pathway that was being built, Noah's gaze was serene as he nodded in reply.
"I am not the Origin Singed you know.
I am someone who managed to seek the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed though, and this seems to make any entity burnt by the Flame mistake me for the Origin Singed.
Did that Entity also seek the True Source, or was he just given a truly close authority by the weavings of the Wheel?"
Noah asked calmly as the tears on Emelline of the First Flame stopped, a sad smile falling on her face as she shook her head.
"The Origin Singed was the Origin Singed.
The one with the highest level of Purity of the Flame of the Singed as even if you are not him...you are also him.
Paradoxical as it may be.
You are not the Origin Singed, and at the same time, you are.
It matters not.
All that matters is that somewhere in the flow of the Wheel, there is the Origin Singed when he is needed.
And currently, you have been needed."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3602 Wheels and Flames III
paragraphs: Somewhere in the flow of the Existence, an Origin Singed was needed!
And now, here was someone to play the role of the Origin Singed.

Emelline of the First Flame truly believed this as she saw the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed continue to be built, her Prime Source feeling a unique type of burn at this moment as she truly felt it become different than what it was before!
This...was what she needed.

"Ezekiel has already returned his Embers to the Wheel, and I did not know how many would have to do so as well. With this power, I can prevent many things as there are no regrets on my side. The enemy is one that passed through the gaps of defenses of the Origin Singed and many others. Whatever they wish for...is not something the weavings of the Wheel wish for."
She said this as she sat down on the flaming pathway, closing her eyes and feeling these burning flames as she looked utterly mystique at this moment.
Noah calmly walked beside her and looked at the darkness that the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed continued to light up, and he asked lightly.
"The place they went. The realm they reached. What does Emelline of the First Flame know about such a thing?"
He had called her here for more information.
Even though she jumped him right away, he still sought information!
She opened her eyes and blinked a few times at his question before she smiled and waved her hands as if she would play along.
On her palm, an incandescent white gold flame appeared and burned brilliantly as she spoke out.

"For me to conjure a flame requires an input of power. Authority, mana, anything...but a spark is needed to cause the flame to bloom. What many do not understand is that things are never that simple. For any unnatural thing to occur- for existence to produce a flame from my hand or the hand of a normal human, the flow of existence itself has to have slight alterations. Nigh instantaneously, there was a communication between my existence, my source, and the outside environment in order to cause this flame to bloom. My Source provided the fuel, but even with the fuel, it may not have done anything unless...I was able to channel the appearence of this power through a Source that stands over our current weavings of existence."
WAA!
Her gaze was serene.
Her words only confirmed what Noah just learned!
Emelline of the First Flame allowed the flame on her hand to blaze brilliantly as it swirled to form a scorching pillar of brilliance.

"The Source that every single being unknowingly channels all Extremes of existence, all weavings of their pathway and sources...is the Wheel of Existence. Every single entity channels the True Source of the Wheel of Existence in order to alter their surrounding existence. All Existences...are merely Channelers at the end. Entities drawing from a profound Source they do not even understand, and some may never even come close to understanding all their lives. The Origin Singed...you..."
Hey eyes glittered as she looked at Noah beside her, the pillar of flames in her hand flying out to wrap around him as it did absolutely nothing- akin to just air swirling around him!

"You and a few others became such powerful Channelers that you were able to easily attain Undeniable Telos Sources. The first step to elevating yourselves as after that, you can begin appraching the True Source you channel from and make demands of it. If the pathway you were utilizing to Channel was a single inch cylinder, you could now ask for and have a pathway a mile long in diameter. Your output of power would tremendously change. And some...sought to entirely move away from channeling through the True Source that is the Wheel of Existence, gain independence from it as their weavings channeled something else. But how easy is that? To find another True Source to Channel through?"
She asked a heavy question that many would not be able to answer.

And yet Noah almost wanted to tell her that just a few minutes ago, he had established his Pathway to the True Source of Kuklos and allowed his Atlas of Existence to become a True Source Atlas of Existence!
That at this moment, it was a budding True Source that others could connect and channel through!
But he remained silent as he thought of the future and coming implications.
If the Wheel of Existence was a True Source that Existence could channel in order to enact terrifying changes with their Extremes, Pathways, and Sources.
What did Bob, an Outsider, want with it? With the Primal Flame of the Wheel of such a Source?
His eyes pulsed with luminous weavings of possibility as his deep voice thundered out amidst blistering flames.
"And the Singed?"
The ones burnt by the Flame of a True Source.
He had an idea, but he wanted it to come from this Prime Source itself as Emelline clenched her hands and sensed her flames. Exhuberant.
Undeniable at this moment!
And yet against this being, they did absolutely nothing to him.
Was he the Origin Singed or not...was this even a question that had to be asked?
She smiled and hugged her knees as she looked like an ethereal flaming Queen, her gaze distant and looking at a far place as her voice echoed out like a lullaby.

"The Singed are more than just Channelers. We get to tap onto the Flow of the Wheel as we become Conduits that express its weavings. A...macrophage of a massive immune complex that moves around clearing dead weavings, infenctions, and anything else that may interrupt the flow of Existence. As Conduits, we gain more power due to our closeness with the True Source, and some of us..."
She lifted her head up while hugging her knees as she looked Noah with crescent eyes.
"Some of us are truly close with the True Source as the status of a True Conduit is unfathomably grander, gaining ways and means to channel that the rest of us cannot fathom."

chapters.title: Chapter 3603 Wheels and Flames IV
paragraphs: A True Conduit who had unfathomable means of doing things as others could not even understand!
This was what Emelline of the First Flame knew the Origin Singed to be!
She looked up at him upside down as she continued.

"We follow the flow of the Wheel. Some of us do not know what it means, but we follow it regardless. Someone like you understands the flow very well. You know exactly what you need to do. If you left, it was because you had to leave. If you are back now, even in a minimal capacity, then it means it is because you know you have to be here. So that is that. Now...it is time for me to return to accomplish the weavings of the flow I know. I have the Singed to lead as if you brought me here through Mysara, it should have been as a warning and to grant me this Undeniable Telos Source to prepare for a war."
She guessed things fairly well as Noah raised his brows when he saw her rising up.
"You see me, proceed to jump me, obtain something from me, and then you just want to leave freely?"

He turned his head inexplicably as the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed became even heavier and complex, the weavings of the True Source Atlas of Existence fully settling around the Mundi of the Source of the Singed as they became even more radiant!
There was no channeling towards any other Source.
He was no Channeler from this moment onwards.
He was currently the Administrator of the True Source Atlas of Existence as he did not need to channel to any True Source, with him being capable of pulling upon his own!
This...deserved a tremendously heavy distinction in itself.
To channel any power through something, it was an action.
An action had a delay. Some could cast abilities in minutes, some seconds, and others needed just an instant to cast abilities or enact a change.
But they did not know that they were still channeling through a True Source pervasive all around them to even be capable of conjuring any change to their surrounding existence!
For Noah...there would not be any theoretical delay.
He would simply be enacting weavings of his True Source Atlas of Existence right away onto a surrounding environment as he was curious how different this would be compared to before!
He smiled as he waved his hands and pulled the white gold queen like visage of Emelline of the First Flame into his embrace.
He was an imperfect being.
So he would simply continue to be himself even amidst all of these fantastical changes as he looked at the astonished Emelline of the First Flame.
"Come, let us continue this entanglement and walk the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed a bit more."
There were many changes to explore and understand.
What he who walked on an entirely different path and source represented. What an entity like Emelline of the First Flame represented.
And what those who would be Channelers of the True Source Atlas of Existence would experience!
As such weavings unfolded.
In a far distant place.
In an entirely different Frequency of Existence.
Waves of blue waters covered absolutely everything, this place having no skies as everything was just....water. Endlessly.

At this moment, sitting on an incandescent coral reef, the figure of Bob could be seen reading through a Book of Existence as behind him, a massive silver white Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence burned, surrounded by white and black chains as multiple decaying black and white Wheels spun all around it with terrifying waves of power.

The smooth head of Bob weaved back and forth with the clear waters as he hummed, his tentacle like legs swinging back and forth as moments later, he nodded while closing the book with a heavy expression.
"Let us start with the simple things first, shall we? Access to the weavings of the Wheel...let us make it simple and close it off first."
Closing access to the weavings of the Wheel of Existence!
For what he needed to do, this was but a simple first step.
Countless existences were channeling weavings across frequencies onto the Wheel of Existence.
Closing off access to it would allow him to accomplish part of the goal, but the byproduct would be for countless existences...to no longer be capable of channeling any power.
Weavings of Existence would be present.
It would be nothing like Hell Terra Firma where there were no weavings of authority at all.
Authority would still be present.
Just...nobody would be able to do anything with authority.
Those who were not meant to fly would no longer be able to fly.
Those who could conjure fireballs, galaxies, or omniverses with a swipe of their hands would find themselves unable to do so.
There would be no access to the one thing one needed to channel their power through as for the first time in history, true equality would start.
Everyone would be the same.
Well, almost everyone.
Bob's heavy expression remained as he shook his head and sighed.
"I am sorry for this. None of you deserve what is coming."
His eyes were filled with a tremendous weight other people would not be able to understand.
And at this moment, he moved as he appeared before the burning silver white Primal Flame of the Wheel, his tentacles sinking into it while the white and black Wheels around him began to spin!
HUUUM!
His body erupted with waves of terrifying complexity, the Primal Flame burning brilliantly as a cry could be heard as if it was being forced to do things it did not wish to!
But the Complexity commanding it was far too great.
Far above any other complexities in any nearby frequencies as it slowly recovered from its injuries.
So it exploded with undeniable power. And thereafter, unfathomable wonder bloomed.

It started with this frequency filled with water that Bob was in as on the Rift he just left, a shining Node of Existence could be seen becoming distorted as a massive silver white burn mark bloomed across it!

chapters.title: Chapter 3604 Alteration! I
paragraphs: A frequency filled with endless waves of water.
A serene blue covered everything as in a certain region, there was an Aquahaven holding an Empire stretching out for light years.

Towards the center of this Aquahaven, a humanoid Greater Source with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a fish floated grandly- an Atlantian of powerful stature as he carried a blue gold trident in his right hand that was currently shooting out rays of blue light onto Primaltrees of Atlantis- nurturing them and causing fantastical fruits to begin blooming!
Around him, massive multicolored fish swam serenely, many bowing their heads towards him reverentially as they passed.
A distance away, brilliantly lit walls stretching out for miles could be seen surrounding vibrant Aquacitadels of an Empire.
The Greater Source Atlantian continued his work as normal when all of a sudden...
WAP!
The light shooting out of his Trident instantly ceased!
"Huh?"
Bubbles left his mouth as, in the next moment, he felt the heavy pressure of the water all around him, and the gills on the side of his neck began to breathe as he was shocked!
He did not need to breathe.
Nor should he feel any pressure at this moment.
What...
His mind was buzzing as he reached out to weave his Greater Source when...
'Huh? Where...'
He was terrified to realize he couldn't...feel anything.
He couldn't sense anything!
As a Greater Source, his mind could even observe the makeup of his atoms as at this moment, the only thing he could observe was what he could see with his own eyes.
A form of 'inner vision' where he could see inside his body seemingly ceased to exist!
He also felt his hand sinking and being pulled down as the Trident made from the Core of an Omniverse slowly sank down, his hand feeling a tearing force as he let go!
This...
His heart was filled with trepidation and confusion as it felt like his Greater Source and everything he had worked eons for...had just silently disappeared!
As he faced such a terrifying situation.

Behind him, a school of predatory fish- Bluehaven Orcas, who were just reverentially swimming in the distance when they sensed his regal power...one blinked and turned towards the direction of the Atlantian as its eyes showed confusion first, but after that, they became covered by a predatory glint as it sped forth!

Its aim was the Atlantian that released no waves of power or regality, and the Greater Source Atlantian...could only see what was ahead of him with his eyes as he could not even sense the predatory fish silently coming behind him!
This was one being in this vast frequency of waters.
There were many like him, and an uncountable number who were below him in power.
On this day.
Inside the Frequency of Aqua.
Every single one found themselves unable to sense or utilize any form of authority.
All they had...was what their bodies were born with!
It would be the first of many as a Unique Existence moved right after- warping away from this frequency along with a silver white flame bound by black and white Wheels.
He warped away from a frequency where even though every single entity should not be able to access and channel to the Wheel of Existence, he was still able to use authority freely.
It was not because he was an exemption.
It was because he did not draw or channel from the True Source that all other beings here channeled from!
In the Prime Frequency of the End.

The new changes continued to settle over Noah as he monitored everything, this entire scene being one of utmost wonder as a Prime Source Theodosius kneeled quietly in the distance, Ruination had her hand behind his back with great focus, and the Queen of Matter had squinting eyes of excitement and expectation as if she was waiting for something!
But during her wait, what she came across was not something she wanted nor expected by a long shot.
The color drained from her eyes.
Her expression distorted and became ashen as Noah saw this drastic change and became serious, the Queen of Matter speaking before she could even be asked!

"The...the communication of all weavings of Matter with the Frequency of Aqua...are gone! Gone! Has...has an entire Frequency been erased like this?! If it was an action done by someone, it would have at least been gradual as I would see what was behind it. But this...it all just instantly gone!"
Her expression was heavy as she imagined countless dead in a matter of an instant.
Only a single being could possibly do such a thing.
Only a single one had the power to do so!
"BOB!"
She yelled out his name, her lips quivering with a sense of fury as the books connected to strings around her buzzed.
Bob.

Noah's gaze was heavy as he thought of the words of the Queen of Matter, and if there was anything true regarding Bob...he shouldn't have collapsed and killed an entire Frequency of Existence after his last failure!
So...
WAP!
Another body of his adorned in a white Emperor's Robe appeared in this place as he grasped the hand of the Queen of Matter.
"Send me the coordinates of the Frequency of Aqua."
His voice was thick and filled with undeniable command as if what he thought was right, Bob should have just been in that frequency or was still there!
The Queen of Matter held a face of sternness for the first time in a while as bundles of weavings left her and flowed into the body of the newly appearing Noah.
And the moment these weavings were ascertained...
HUUM!
Swirling weavings of existence flashed instantly around them akin to circular multicolored radiance which took the Queen of Matter by surprise, and they disappeared right after!
Foreign.
Noah's weavings...felt foreign and distinctly different from what the Queen of Matter knew as the normal weavings of Existence!

And when it came to the slow process of crossing into different Frequencies that took time and a great deal of Authority, she would come to find this jump Noah made from one frequency to another...took less than a millisecond!

sentences.text: A frequency filled with endless waves of water.
A serene blue covered everything as in a certain region, there was an Aquahaven holding an Empire stretching out for light years.

Towards the center of this Aquahaven, a humanoid Greater Source with the upper body of a human and the lower body of a fish floated grandly- an Atlantian of powerful stature as he carried a blue gold trident in his right hand that was currently shooting out rays of blue light onto Primaltrees of Atlantis- nurturing them and causing fantastical fruits to begin blooming!
Around him, massive multicolored fish swam serenely, many bowing their heads towards him reverentially as they passed.
A distance away, brilliantly lit walls stretching out for miles could be seen surrounding vibrant Aquacitadels of an Empire.
The Greater Source Atlantian continued his work as normal when all of a sudden...
WAP!
The light shooting out of his Trident instantly ceased!
"Huh?"
Bubbles left his mouth as, in the next moment, he felt the heavy pressure of the water all around him, and the gills on the side of his neck began to breathe as he was shocked!
He did not need to breathe.
Nor should he feel any pressure at this moment.
What...
His mind was buzzing as he reached out to weave his Greater Source when...
'Huh?
Where...'
He was terrified to realize he couldn't...feel anything.
He couldn't sense anything!
As a Greater Source, his mind could even observe the makeup of his atoms as at this moment, the only thing he could observe was what he could see with his own eyes.
A form of 'inner vision' where he could see inside his body seemingly ceased to exist!
He also felt his hand sinking and being pulled down as the Trident made from the Core of an Omniverse slowly sank down, his hand feeling a tearing force as he let go!
This...
His heart was filled with trepidation and confusion as it felt like his Greater Source and everything he had worked eons for...had just silently disappeared!
As he faced such a terrifying situation.

Behind him, a school of predatory fish- Bluehaven Orcas, who were just reverentially swimming in the distance when they sensed his regal power...one blinked and turned towards the direction of the Atlantian as its eyes showed confusion first, but after that, they became covered by a predatory glint as it sped forth!

Its aim was the Atlantian that released no waves of power or regality, and the Greater Source Atlantian...could only see what was ahead of him with his eyes as he could not even sense the predatory fish silently coming behind him!
This was one being in this vast frequency of waters.
There were many like him, and an uncountable number who were below him in power.
On this day.
Inside the Frequency of Aqua.
Every single one found themselves unable to sense or utilize any form of authority.
All they had...was what their bodies were born with!
It would be the first of many as a Unique Existence moved right after- warping away from this frequency along with a silver white flame bound by black and white Wheels.
He warped away from a frequency where even though every single entity should not be able to access and channel to the Wheel of Existence, he was still able to use authority freely.
It was not because he was an exemption.
It was because he did not draw or channel from the True Source that all other beings here channeled from!
In the Prime Frequency of the End.

The new changes continued to settle over Noah as he monitored everything, this entire scene being one of utmost wonder as a Prime Source Theodosius kneeled quietly in the distance, Ruination had her hand behind his back with great focus, and the Queen of Matter had squinting eyes of excitement and expectation as if she was waiting for something!
But during her wait, what she came across was not something she wanted nor expected by a long shot.
The color drained from her eyes.
Her expression distorted and became ashen as Noah saw this drastic change and became serious, the Queen of Matter speaking before she could even be asked!
"The...the communication of all weavings of Matter with the Frequency of Aqua...are gone!
Gone!
Has...has an entire Frequency been erased like this?!
If it was an action done by someone, it would have at least been gradual as I would see what was behind it.
But this...it all just instantly gone!"
Her expression was heavy as she imagined countless dead in a matter of an instant.
Only a single being could possibly do such a thing.
Only a single one had the power to do so!
"BOB!"
She yelled out his name, her lips quivering with a sense of fury as the books connected to strings around her buzzed.
Bob.

Noah's gaze was heavy as he thought of the words of the Queen of Matter, and if there was anything true regarding Bob...he shouldn't have collapsed and killed an entire Frequency of Existence after his last failure!
So...
WAP!
Another body of his adorned in a white Emperor's Robe appeared in this place as he grasped the hand of the Queen of Matter.
"Send me the coordinates of the Frequency of Aqua."
His voice was thick and filled with undeniable command as if what he thought was right, Bob should have just been in that frequency or was still there!
The Queen of Matter held a face of sternness for the first time in a while as bundles of weavings left her and flowed into the body of the newly appearing Noah.
And the moment these weavings were ascertained...
HUUM!
Swirling weavings of existence flashed instantly around them akin to circular multicolored radiance which took the Queen of Matter by surprise, and they disappeared right after!
Foreign.

And when it came to the slow process of crossing into different Frequencies that took time and a great deal of Authority, she would come to find this jump Noah made from one frequency to another...took less than a millisecond!

chapters.title: Chapter 3605 Alteration! II
paragraphs: A Milisecond.
This was all it took to jump from one Frequency to another for Noah, his white robed figure appearing in a sea of endless blue all around him as everything seemed more than normal!
Beside him, the Queen of Matter was just starting to look around in shock when...
"GRAGH....!"
Her body paled as she acted like she was drowning, a terrifying pressure pressing all around her as her nose began to gush out blood!

Noah moved right away, his fist striking out and forming a bubble of air in this whole area, his other hand still holding onto the Queen of Matter who heaved with a bleeding nose and reddened eyes as she puked out water.
Around her, books fell down as there were no more strings stretching out from her to connect her to them, and her brain buzzed as she could barely focus and maintain her consciousness!
She had nearly been crushed.
Her.
A Greater Source Complexity, had almost been crushed by the mere pressure of this vast sea!

She hung limply from Noah as she was about to lose consciousness when a blinding green light of the True Severed Weavings of Life surged into her from Noah, her bleeding stopping as clarity returned to her mind while she breathed easire.
And yet...
"No...." Her eyes freely leaked tears as she continued to hang in the air- only capable of doing so because of Noah as she looked down at the scattered books that were wet all over!
Noah floated down with her and set her down as she reached out towards her books while tears fell from her eyes.
"I can't feel anything!"
WAA!
Her words were heart rending as if she was experiencing the greatest pain in her life.
"My connection to Matter, my Source, my very Existence...I can't feel any of it. Its so dark. It's so dark!"
She wailed as she gathered her books and tried to open them, but she was not capable of doing so.
They held records she wrote herself. Fables that she hummed herself to sleep!
And yet, at this moment, she could not access them!
A low voice akin to a wail.
Noah looked at her distraught state as well as what she had said before they arrived here as he instantly understood what had happened.
The Frequency was still here.
Nothing had seemingly been affected.
But the moment the two of them arrived here, the Queen of Matter was affected while Noah...remained unbothered!
There was only a single reason for this.
It seemed like Bob had begun by doing utterly dreadful things as at this moment, Noah understood that somehow, Bob had cut off channeling to the Wheel of Existence for this frequency!
The Queen of Matter was only affected after she came here while he was fine because of a singular reason.
And for this reason, he floated down and looked at the distraught Queen of Matter who looked like she had lost everything.
Tears and snot freely flowed from her as Noah bent down and raised her head, her figure still trying to pry open the books around her.
She looked like a young woman who was always used to lock herself in her room, lost in the worlds of the books she read. And now, all of these worlds she knew and loved were gone.
"Sir Osmont, everything I had...I cannot feel any of it!"
Her mind was unfocused as her eyes trembled!
Noah looked at her with a trace of pity as he replied.
"I know."
He knew.
He knew how she felt at this moment as if he had lost access to his Mana. If he had nothing that he held right now.
Even when he went into Hell Terra Firma, there was still his part of Ozymandias that could still enjoy authority!
But the Queen of Matter was experiencing it fully right now as Noah looked at her in her distraught state as he called out.

"You lost access to everything you had because you have been channeling your power through something that could be altered by someone powerful enough. You need something else to channel your power through, and you will be able to sense everything you have again. Do you want that?"
His words coursed down like lightning in her mind as she wiped her snot and tears while looking at Noah.
Could he do even that?
Her reddened eyes looked at Noah for only a few seconds before she nodded.
In her lowest state.

As she hugged books she could not open anymore, she looked up at the visage of Noah as he took her now fragile hands and put them on this chest. His chest. There, she felt a terrifying warmth as her eyes just barely caught a glimpse of a Wheel.
Just barely.
But the warmth she felt traveled like arcs of electricity through her hands, going all the way into her body as the moment it reached a Source she thought did not exist anymore...
HUUM!
Her body began to illuminate with shocking radiance as her figure became bathed with multicolored light!

A dazzling white gold flame swept past her figure, her entire being feeling like it underwent a change as her source gushed out exuberant complexity that almost seemed ready to spill out towards a Prime Source.
The dress she adorned turned blue gold, her hairs gained a silver gold glow as her eyes opened with splendiferous luminosity.
She looked towards Noah in shock as she could feel everything once again, and what she felt was so much more than before!

The books she was always connected to rose around once more, linked by solid golden strings of existence as each book held a vibrant circular glow as if their very records were being fortified to never be lost for the eons to come!
She felt all of this as she had no words, tears still falling in her eyes as she shook her head with incredulity.
She felt a closeness towards this being she idolized that was not there before.
But she could not explain it!
She felt so unfathomably free that even this feeling, she did not know where it came from.
But the words of the Protagonist she idolized made a few things clear.
"The Queen of Matter, the first Lifeform to connect and channel your weavings of existence through my True Source and not the Wheel of Existence...how do you feel?"
His words caused her to tremble as many things dawned on her, her expression changing rapidly as she experienced too many emotions all at once!
She wanted to say many things.
She was always so talkative.
Yet at this moment as she stared at the True Emperor of Quintessence...she had absolutely no words to say!
The Queen of Matter who always had words to say was made speechless!
Noah waved his hands at her as she came out of her stupor, her tears disappearing into dazzling lights of stars as she looked away while sighing in a daze.
"I...can understand somewhat why all those prideful women threw themselves at you..."
She slowly began to go back to her old self as she spoke like this to evade saying what she truly felt right now.
How he...was just too brilliant for her to even look at.
But as she thought of his words about being the first and the implications this held...
"Ah, Bob!" She suddenly remembered this as her weavings erupted.
But Noah only waved his hands lightly.
"Don't worry, Bob is no longer here."
...! He could say this with confidence now.
The Affix of the Burnt Weaver was taken another step by Ruination as after its current update, what he was capable of mapping was not just a mere Megalos.
He could now map out...an entire Frequency!
He affirmed Bob was not here the moment he arrived. What he was able to find...was a dazzling Node of Existence many light years away from here that was left right out in the open!
As all this happened.
|The True Source Atlas of Existence has gained its first Channeler.|
|The distinction of the First Channeler has been granted to the Queen of Matter.|
|The weavings of the Source of the Queen of Matter have been grasped with extreme clarity and can be replicated at any time.|
Prompts began to rise within him!

chapters.title: Chapter 3606 Irreparable! I
paragraphs: Prompts began to rise as they expressed the wondrous allure of the True Source Atlas of Existence!
|As the First Channeler of the True Source Atlas of Existence, the quality of Absolute Infinitum Existentialism is momentarily granted to the Queen of Matter.|
|With her weavings attaining Absolute Infinitum Existentialism, there will be a constant and continual increase in her complexity with every passing moment.|
His terrifying Atlas buzzed.
And in the next moment, the Source of the Queen of Matter that already seemed brighter began to explode and surge up with complexity as her Greater Source...began to transform!
She was shocked at this as she sensed her grandiose Greater Source break past heavy shackles and begin to change, heading towards the austere weavings of a Prime!

The two pronged factor of channeling through another Source and as the First Channeler, being granted a shocking quality that Noah had only obtained after he stabilized all three states of matter in his body.
She was exposed to all of this simultaneously as her source rapidly transformed and made the jump from Greater to Prime!

She was dazed as the books around her had their covers become inlaid with gold, her Source shimmering with an ever radiant luster as she felt the constant explosive burst of complexity within her that stemmed from Absolute Infinitum Existentialism.
She couldn't help but utter out as she spoke in a daze.
"Is this...what you feel all the time?"
His bursts of complexity.
His ever radiant demeanor.
She felt like she grasped a minuscule part of it as Noah nodded lightly and asked while he looked in a certain direction.
"We'll have to get to what Bob has done in a second but...how do your weavings feel right now? How different or same are they?"
Tendrils of rivers of multicolored light began to cover his body and the Queen of Matter as he wanted to ascertain the sensation of channeling through different Sources.
The Queen of Matter sensed her changing Source as she replied with fascination.

"I feel like...my Complexity is uniquely not just more powerful perse, but as if it is under a different flow. As if the definitions of what I could do before are being redefined. The limitations, the boundaries. The fact that at this moment, I feel like Fabled Matter...has a possibility of adaptability and change as potentially, I could expand it to cover Dark Matter and Anti-Matter as well."

A terrifying answer came from her as Noah nodded lightly, realizing there was much work to be done to study just how uniquely different an experience different Entities would have if they switched from channeling through the Wheel of Existence they always knew, to channeling through his True Source!
At this thought.
WAP!

Their figures disappeared once more as when they reappeared, they were light years away where Noah had seen on the Map of the Frequency of Aqua, a clear Node of Existence was displayed out in the open.
It looked like a miniature star of cerulean radiance as at this moment, two heavy silver white burn marks could be seen stretching out across it!
"That..."
In the midst of her transforming source, the Queen of Matter reached out to grasp the Node of Existence in shock and Noah's weavings also settled around it.

He shook his head while his eyes shone sharply as he was able to quickly understand what each mark meant- something that came akin to a natural language for him, who also held a significant portion of the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence and what it could do!

He looked at the first burn mark as it was an alteration made to this Frequency of Existence through its Node- a change to the Flow that stated all those with this Frequency could no longer channel their weavings to the Wheel of Existence!
This was the first scorch mark.
The second one...was a communication and challenge directly from Bob to Noah himself!

The second scorch mark was another change on the Node that stated...any future attempts to alter this Node of Existence or its flow in any way...would result in the instantaneous breakdown of the Frequency itself.
"This fucking guy..."
Noah spoke out with a domineering light as the face of the Queen of Matter looked up with confusion, and he replied while looking around the reefs of the waters nearby where Bob should have been.
"Bob has made it so we cannot reverse what he did. If I seek to alter the Node again, he has it set that the whole Frequency will shatter thereafter."

He spoke such words calmly to the Queen of Matter, who turned ghastly, thinking of all the countless lifeforms here who could no longer utilize their power and just how terrifying that would be, alongside the unknown chaos, upheaval, and deaths that would occur from this!
As such thoughts churned, Noah looked around as he wanted to try something.
He raised his hand as a moment later, the True Severed Weavings of Chronos bloomed.
He had a terrifying number of things under his banner as with his True Source Atlas of Existence, he held his own True Source.
He could dictate his own flow as he felt like to a certain extent...he could also violate some flows!

His hand clenched into a fist as the truly Severed Weavings of Chronos burned, a burst of purple radiance erupting out and covering this whole region as an illusory purple clock that also looked like an ancient Wheel bloomed.
And this Wheel...began to turn.
HUUM!
The flows in the surroundings turned chaotic and began to reverse as illusory purple weavings bloomed!
The seas moved in reverse as existence distorted, and in no time...
WAA!
An illusory figure of tentacle limbed entity with a round head appeared in front of a burning flame bound down by rotating Wheels above it.
Everything looked illusory and not real as if it were merely replaying what had occurred in these weavings of existence not too long ago!

Noah turned it all back until the massive purple Wheel conjured by Chronos began to vibrate and crack, and he only stopped then as the distortion of time stopped...and the illusory weavings of a past began to play out in real time before his eyes!

The flows in the surroundings turned chaotic and began to reverse as illusory purple weavings bloomed!
The seas moved in reverse as existence distorted, and in no time...
WAA!
An illusory figure of tentacle limbed entity with a round head appeared in front of a burning flame bound down by rotating Wheels above it.
Everything looked illusory and not real as if it were merely replaying what had occurred in these weavings of existence not too long ago!

Noah turned it all back until the massive purple Wheel conjured by Chronos began to vibrate and crack, and he only stopped then as the distortion of time stopped...and the illusory weavings of a past began to play out in real time before his eyes!

chapters.title: Chapter 3607 Irreparable! II
paragraphs: The past.
Noah forcefully conjured it as he rewound the flow of existence, and he began to watch what happened here not too long ago.
He saw the visage of Bob as he sat on the reefs, his gaze locked onto a Book that the Queen of Matter beside Noah gritted her teeth at seeing!
His gaze seemed to be blank before his voice echoed out as he closed the Book of Existence.
"Let's start with the simple things first, shall we? Access to the weavings of the Wheel...let us make it simple and close it off first."
Noah heard these words as his eyes became sharper.
The simple things first.
Closing off access to the True Source for all Channelers...was considered something simple among the things that Bob had to do!
Just what exactly would come after?
Such a thing was still unknown as the scene continued playing out.
As he stood over a flame and did what he did...
"I am sorry for this. None of you deserve what is coming."
He expressed a sense of regret for the inevitable!
He actually did such a thing before a moment later, he utilized the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence not once, but twice!
And that should've been it.
But a moment after a second silver white scorch mark appeared on the Node of Existence...
"This one is for you, my friend. Is it a good present? You taking over half of the Primal Flame of the Wheel was not among my calculations as I have had to change a few things due to it."
HUUM!
The voice of Bob echoed out from the illusory purple recreation of a past flow!
The Queen of Matter was astonished as she moved backwards and came to hide behind Noah.
As if she was scared even this illusory purple figure that should have just been a reversed flow playing out...might somehow be cognizant and be able to take action!
The figure of Bob smiled as the Wheels he had binding the Primal Flame of the Wheel began to turn.

"Surprised? Shocked?" His expression was bright as his singularities turned into crescent smiles, as if he understood that even as a reversed flow of existence, he still had cognizance and was himself!

"Haha, am I truly here with my understanding and complexity? Or did I know you would do something like this and just choose to speak like this to freak you out in the case you did? Or if you did happen to peer into the weavings of past flows, was I able to sense it and talk to you?"
The illusory figure of Bob spoke like this as he turned towards a certain direction and looked head on as he asked!
"Isn't that right, friend?"
The direction he looked at...had nothing there.
Just blue waters of the sea.
Bob's illusory figure couldn't help but laugh lightly as he shook his head.

"Haha, did I guess the direction right or wrong? I'm just playing with you, how could I possibly know all of this? Even now, I'm probably speaking of weavings nobody will be able to see or know about. When you become as old as I, you start to get senile. And the possibility of a genuine friend seems to have made me senile. Oh well."
HUUM!
He was his hands as the Primal Flame of the Wheel bound by two massive ancient decaying wheels disappeared, his figure beginning to disappear as well as at this time...
His head turned. He did not look in any random direction.
His terrifying singularities honed in exactly where Noah was as his eyes locked with his!

"For you to be in this Frequency and be capable of channeling any power like this has too many implications. It was not something even I accounted for. It actually now makes you very challenging to what I wish to accomplish. Now, I have to answer the question...if you do not draw your weavings from this Wheel of Existence, exactly where do you draw them from?"
His eyes burned with a horrific radiance as he said these words with a wide smile, his visage giving a small nod to Noah while his eyes also glanced at the Queen of Matter beside him!
"Till next time, Friend."
WAP!
With such words, Bob disappeared.
And Noah's expression became stern.
The entity that was Bob...was eccentric and loved to play around even while he did the unspeakable!
Even his flow in the past knew when it was being gazed at.

The illusory purple weavings of the past continued...until he and the Queen of Matter arrived here as soon, the past met the present as everything shattered, purple radiance fading away and only leaving them behind.
"Fuck, he's scary...." The Queen of Matter cursed out even as her complexity reached Prime Source.
Noah's white robes fluttered as he looked at the blue waters around him that maintained a wondrous level of serenity in all this.
"Our enemy is moving quickly and decisively. We have to move even quicker. "
WAA!
His vision saw a distant place others could not even imagine as to get there, many smaller things had to be done!
This Frequency was irreparable after what Bob had done as all those in here would not be able to channel through the Wheel of Existence.
But he...was not the Wheel of Existence.
He would give the people of this frequency a new Source to draw from.
Those of this Frequency, yes, but also his own people.
Such a process had to be fast as with his people and the countless lines of entanglements he had, there was no worry.
But for the masses across an entire Frequency or multiple Frequencies...there had to be another way!
"Begin the design of another Source of Existence..."
WAA!

He gave a command to his True Source Atlas of Existence as another Mundi lit up brightly, the weavings of Anti-Matter and Dark Matter rising as they asked from which of them this new Source would be based on?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3608 Channelers! I
paragraphs: Inside endless waves of blue, another one of Noah's bodies sought to enact an additional Source.
The more that were made, the more that the True Source Atlas of Existence would be compete!
As one of his bodies sought to do this. Back in the Prime Frequency of the End, near another Node of Existence, only Noah and Ruination remained alongside a kneeling Theodosius.

Crimson gold brilliance pulsed around Ruination as the Affixes of Burnt Weaver and Severed Extractor finished their ridiculous elevation- with Burnt Weaver of course gaining the capability to map out an entire Frequency while Severed Extractor...

"Even incompatible Sources of Existence should be ones that Master is able to study and infer from. And so long as an entanglement exists, Master should be able to begin analyzing and studying said Sources."
Ruination spoke out calmly while keeping her hand behind Noah's back.
Noah heard this and nodded with bright eyes as even without asking...

"With that being said, I've already placed the highest priority on understanding the weavings of Bob. His Source seems to be masked under layers of truths and falsehoods as the Affix has only just theorized and uncovered a decimal percentage worth of progress regarding this. It could take hours, days, or even more..."
The Source of Bob!
The entity who should be a Channeler drawing from an entirely different True Source!
Noah sought to understand just how and what the Source of this being was as such a thing began to be processed.
Ruination was doing all that she could and more as her status as a Ruined Miniare Wheel of Existence gave her tremendous uniqueness.
Her eyes held a clear crimson gold brilliance as she said lastly.

"Another Seed of an Affix is also budding within Master, and I am still constructing it to match utility and usefulness for the future to come. But something else is ready within the Forge, Master. I have been changing it as I advanced recently, and it should have grown to a sufficient enough level to be of use. Inside the True Severed Osmontian Forge..."
It had gone by many names before.
The forge where countless waves of Loot light bloomed within Noah's own existence- where Ruination resided in!
At this moment, amidst waves of changes, Noah looked deep within himself as his weavings went into the depths of the True Source Atlas of Existence.
Into the crevices of his soul where a system of existence relating to Loot spun.
Like all things, it was truly severed as it felt like a world inside of him.
He delved into it as the skies were filled with spinning cerulean infinity symbols that gushed out indeterminate waves of golden Loot light.

Down below, a spinning golden sea of Loot light spun as at the very center, a floating island rose above an ancient, archaic golden wheel that was bathed with golden waters of loot and constantly spun.

Every time this golden wheel spun, it sent beams of light into the island that looked utterly serene and celestial, with golden rivers and lakes flowing through it as vibrant grass born from Loot itself waved calmly in the surging winds.
At the center of this island.
In what looked like a farm, Ruination was in simple farming attire as she had long blue denim overalls, a simple white shirt under them, and a small straw hat that covered her head.

She looked up as Noah made his descent on the dazzling core of the True Severed Osmontian Forge, her eyes turning into crescent smiles as she pointed towards a mountain of...Purified Source Complexity Pearls near her!

"I tried to hide it from Master, but I know you know what goes on inside you more than anything else. This has been something I've changed constantly over the days as I sought to aid in Master's goal of self sufficiency. Of not needing Loot from other Sources to rely on for your growth. The answer was to naturally make the forge capable of spitting out as much if not more Loot than what enemies could. So...I have been able to set up the Forge to produce a single Purified Greater Source Pearl...with every passing second."
WAA!

Above the hazy gold skies of the floating island, Noah had watched multiple singularities form while Ruination was talking, these singularities becoming dazzling Purified Source Pearls that fell on a mountain of other Pearls as there had to be hundreds of Greater Source Pearls alone here!
Noah came before the mountain of Source Pearls and smiled as he took one while looking at it.
A goal of self-sufficiency.
With Absolute Infinitum Existentialism, this was already a reality as now, with Ruination's ridiculous efforts, it would be cemented as an undeniable reality.
He did not need enemies to obtain Loot.
Loot was...
Loot was....!
HUUM!
True Severed Weavings descended.
The brilliance of Loot churned!
|Purposefully, the selection of an instant has been made after countless formulaic equations that have altered and triggered the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity.|

|The passage of an instant may not be allowed without your complexity undergoing a targetted, significant burst of elevation that will be supported entirely by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.| |The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity has purposefully declared the burst of elevation to stem from the weavings of...Loot.|
|The Severed Weavings of Loot, backed by the Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity, are undergoing a resurgence of their Pathway to attain a different Final Severed State!|
Granted a Pathway before, but never truly defined. Today, Loot was given a resurgence with even greater authority as their distinction was made clearer!

A storm of golden brilliance erupted as Ruination looked around with wonder, and Noah nonchalantly walked towards her figure that looked like a simple farm girl who was cultivating terrifying Source Complexity Pearls of Existence.
He patted her head while lifting up the straw hat as he spoke with a genuine smile.
"Thank you for working so hard."
A few words.
But they caused Ruination to feel a burst of happiness from the depths of her heart as all she ever wanted...was to be useful.
All she ever wanted was to stand side by side with him and not feel like she couldn't give anything.
She knew he didn't think of her any less whether she gave or didn't give anything, but this was just something in her heart that she wanted to achieve!
And now, the results bore fruit!

chapters.title: Chapter 3609 Channelers! II
paragraphs: The results bore tremendous fruit as down below, in a surging sea of Loot, a Wheel turned.
With every full turn, a Purified Greater Source Pearl would be produced and added onto a tall mountain on an island above!
And at this moment...
|The Severed Weavings of Loot have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of Loot has opened.|
|In the True Severed Osmontian Forge, the Severed Weavings of Loot make their home.|

|Through the Pathway to the True Source of Loot, you have attained Absolute Loot Generation- such a wonder fusing into the True Severed Osmontian Forge and empowering it even more. Its principle states that a Pathway leading to the True Source of Loot should make one independent of all needs of Loot from outside Sources. And once the True Source of Loot is obtained...|

|Through the Pathway to the True Source of Loot, it is recognized that while attaining independence from needing any outside Source of Loot, such things still exist. In the case that Loot is obtained outside, it only acts to supplement as it is not the main source for you. Any Weavings of Enemies with a sufficient enough complexity that have their weavings decimated by you will have their complexity transformed to become an Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Existence. From such a Loot Box, Undeniable Telos Purified Source Pearls may come out, or any myriad of wonders that lie in the realm of Uncertainty and Possibility across nearby True Sources.|
Loot took a tremendous step forward as its own Pathway was opened. From this pathway comes Absolute Loot Generation and Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Existence!
The latter was outside.
The former that dealt with Noah's weavings...
HUUM!

Caused the Forge to churn as even denser waves of gold flowed down from the spinning infinity symbols in the skies, while the golden sea below that had a golden archaic wheel at the very center became chaotic.
The Wheel turned.
And the whole forge instantly flashed with multicolored radiance all around.
On the island above, nine radiant singularities of heavy complexity bloomed, an allure of a terrifying Source being felt from them as a prompt came down!

|Every time a minute passes, 9 Purified Prime Source Pearls will be generated within the True Severed Osmontian Forge. Based on countless formulations and possibilities under the banner of the Golden Ratio, Undeniable Telos Purified Source Pearls also have a chance of generating ever so often.|
Noah looked at this prompt and smiled, holding Ruination close to him as he reached out to hold nine dazzling Purified Prime Source Pearls.
Every minute, they would form.
Outside of here, could he kill 9 Prime Source entities every minute for the foreseeable future?
The answer was no as this...was the answer that Ruination and Loot gave for Noah's own sustainability!
With Absolute Infinitum Existentialism. With Absolute Loot Generation. With this True Severed Osmontian Forge...
With all of it, he had multiple pathways of pumping his complexity in a manner that even hunting entire frequencies filled with Greater or Prime Sources could not provide.
With this...
"Direct it all to the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed. Let us see the halfway point to the True Source of Singed itself after all this time..."

He gave the command to his weavings as all of these flows of Loot would head towards a singular direction- and he expected to make a significant enough advancement in the coming minutes to finally push a Pathway past a significant milestone!
And while all of this occurred.
Upheaval began within the Infiniverse Megalos. Noah gathered his people under glorious Pantheonic Havens as he tugged upon their entanglements.
He tugged on their weavings of Existence as his voice thundered out within their minds!

|This whole time, you have been Channelers of weaving you do not know nor understand. You have been Channeling a True Source that is grand, but malleable to changes. Malleable to alterations. Leave such a True Source behind as from here on out, you shall join the True Source of the True Severed Origin Osmontian- the True Source Atlas of Existence!|
HUUM!
His voice was a booming undeniable command that his son heard.
His women heard.
All those closest to him, and the countless others that he did not interact with or truly know!

But so long as they were within the vast lands of the Infiniverse Megalos, their weavings were taken from channeling towards an unknown and not too entirely understood Wheel of Existence, and they were steered towards another True Source!
They were steered to become Channelers of something with much clearer demarcations and distinction as this...nobody but Noah himself could alter!
They were the Channelers that followed the Queen of Matter.
They were among the first, but they were certainly not the last as away from the Megalos Ynnere where the Infiniverse Megalos was contained in.
With the neighboring Megalos Beyond and Megalos Nihilos where all states of existence were meeting in one area.

In the location where Ozymandias was floating while Outerversal Morphons led by the Great Mother, Aspasia, and others...pledged their Allegiance not to the Instrument of the Beyonder, but the Protagonist, Ozymandias!
As they looked at him, he gave the answer as to what state of Existence the upcoming System of Existence being forged would be.
Something to allow his weavings to stretch unto those he knew and those he did not know.
When he thought of this as a method to gain more Channelers, he naturally remembered the Outerversal Morphons who could fish across the Megalos to attain connections and attain followers.

So his singularities burned as he felt his True Source Atlas of Existence begin the design of another System- Dark Matter surging at its base as just at its formation...Ozymandias found himself asking!
|Why not both?|
HUUM!
From the base of Dark Matter alone, Anti-Matter also bloomed!
Who said a System of Existence had to be built on a single State of Existence alone?
There were also qualities of Anti-Matter that were unique to think of when it came to spreading one's weavings!
So...
"Made of Dark Matter and Anti-Matter...."
HUUM!
Ozymandias proclaimed grandly as he looked to obtain countless more Channelers.
"Let the System of Existence of...Eldritch Expanse come to fruition."

Noah looked at this prompt and smiled, holding Ruination close to him as he reached out to hold nine dazzling Purified Prime Source Pearls.
Every minute, they would form.
Outside of here, could he kill 9 Prime Source entities every minute for the foreseeable future?
The answer was no as this...was the answer that Ruination and Loot gave for Noah's own sustainability!
With Absolute Infinitum Existentialism.
With Absolute Loot Generation.
With this True Severed Osmontian Forge...
With all of it, he had multiple pathways of pumping his complexity in a manner that even hunting entire frequencies filled with Greater or Prime Sources could not provide.
With this...
"Direct it all to the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed.
Let us see the halfway point to the True Source of Singed itself after all this time..."

He gave the command to his weavings as all of these flows of Loot would head towards a singular direction- and he expected to make a significant enough advancement in the coming minutes to finally push a Pathway past a significant milestone!
And while all of this occurred.
Upheaval began within the Infiniverse Megalos.
Noah gathered his people under glorious Pantheonic Havens as he tugged upon their entanglements.
He tugged on their weavings of Existence as his voice thundered out within their minds!
|This whole time, you have been Channelers of weaving you do not know nor understand.
You have been Channeling a True Source that is grand, but malleable to changes.
Malleable to alterations.
Leave such a True Source behind as from here on out, you shall join the True Source of the True Severed Origin Osmontian- the True Source Atlas of Existence!|
HUUM!
His voice was a booming undeniable command that his son heard.
His women heard.
All those closest to him, and the countless others that he did not interact with or truly know!

But so long as they were within the vast lands of the Infiniverse Megalos, their weavings were taken from channeling towards an unknown and not too entirely understood Wheel of Existence, and they were steered towards another True Source!
They were steered to become Channelers of something with much clearer demarcations and distinction as this...nobody but Noah himself could alter!
They were the Channelers that followed the Queen of Matter.
They were among the first, but they were certainly not the last as away from the Megalos Ynnere where the Infiniverse Megalos was contained in.
With the neighboring Megalos Beyond and Megalos Nihilos where all states of existence were meeting in one area.

In the location where Ozymandias was floating while Outerversal Morphons led by the Great Mother, Aspasia, and others...pledged their Allegiance not to the Instrument of the Beyonder, but the Protagonist, Ozymandias!
As they looked at him, he gave the answer as to what state of Existence the upcoming System of Existence being forged would be.
Something to allow his weavings to stretch unto those he knew and those he did not know.
When he thought of this as a method to gain more Channelers, he naturally remembered the Outerversal Morphons who could fish across the Megalos to attain connections and attain followers.

So his singularities burned as he felt his True Source Atlas of Existence begin the design of another System- Dark Matter surging at its base as just at its formation...Ozymandias found himself asking!
|Why not both?|
HUUM!
From the base of Dark Matter alone, Anti-Matter also bloomed!
Who said a System of Existence had to be built on a single State of Existence alone?
There were also qualities of Anti-Matter that were unique to think of when it came to spreading one's weavings!
So...
"Made of Dark Matter and Anti-Matter...."
HUUM!
Ozymandias proclaimed grandly as he looked to obtain countless more Channelers.
"Let the System of Existence of...Eldritch Expanse come to fruition."

chapters.title: Chapter 3610 Channelers! III
paragraphs: Eldritch Expanse.
Such a set of words were called out nonchalantly at a spot where seas of three states of Existence met.
Ozymandias called them out as the distant Great Mother and many other Outerversal Morphons barely even heard it, but in the next moment...
HUUM!
The surrounding weavings churned as rivers of Dark Matter and Anti-Matter began to flow into Ozymandias en masse!
They were the backbone for a new System of Existence entirely as a lot could be needed!
And the Administrator of the True Source Atlas of Existence...began to design and etch out a System of Existence with the very authority of this Atlas.
It was akin to a man making up a word and, in the next few seconds, proceeding to make a definition for the word.
What it stood for. What its parameters were.
He used inferences from other observations made within different Sources of Existence, but at the end of the day, the definition was his.
What it meant.
What it stood for. In the Eighth Mundi of Power, regal black and white tentacles began to bloom as even when Noah's weavings looked at them, these black and white tentacles seemed foreign. Pervasive.
As if the moment they would bloom, they would spread out across countless weavings of Existence in ways others couldn't even comprehend.
This...was a critical factor of Eldritch Expanse as even while it was being constructed...
|The weavings of the Golden Ratio have already made countless formulaic calculations and tipped the favor of change and probability to the newly designed System of Existence.|

|As long as a sufficient level of complexity in design is complete, Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity will be triggered to truly sever and take the weavings of the new System of Existence towards their Final Severed State.|
His weavings of existence were already there and ready to go as inside of him...the heavy Wheel that was overlapped with his Atlas of Existence turned.
A single turn. DUM!
And the moment this turn was made, a weaving of a terrifying complexity bloomed as a singularity shooting out stellar white and black tentacles truly bloomed.
|A new System of Existence is being established within the True Source Atlas of Existence.|
|It is the first Source of Existence being designed while the Atlas is at its current stage of a True Source.|

|The Source of Existence, Eldritch Expanse, has gained accelerated qualities of a Source from the True Source Atlas of Existence as its elevation and progression as a Pathway to its True Source will be accelerated by an unknown factor.|
|The True Severed Weavings of Pathogenicity are in heavy support of the Source of Eldritch Expanse and throw their weight fully into it.|
|The True Severed Weavings of Cheats are in heavy support of the Source of Eldritch Expanse and throw their weight fully into it.|
|The True Severed Weavings of the Protagonist...|
Multiple weavings rose up in tremendous support.

Around Ozymandias, a horrific aura that caused one's heart to palpate echoed out, the distant Outerversal Morphons feeling their Sources of Existence tremble as the sensation of prey looking at a horrific predator bloomed.
Stellar white and black radiance leaked out from Ozymandias as from his obsidian skin, tendrils of beautiful and grotesque white and black tentacles began to emerge.
They vibrated with heaviness and tenacity as they sensed their surrounding, their level of cognition seeming to be unfathomably high.
|The budding weavings of Eldritch Expanse gaze at the Complexity of Existence and despairs at their imperfect form.|
|The budding weavings of Eldritch Expanse pull upon the True Source Atlas of Existence and undergo True Severing!|
The weavings of Ozymandias and Noah buzzed!
The blooming new Source...did not even wait for others to move on its behalf as it pulled upon the power of the True Source Atlas of Existence to sever itself!
And after that...
|The True Severed Weavings of Eldritch Expanse pull upon the connection of the Heart of Infinity and the Singed to instantly achieve 27 rounds of Severings.|

Around Ozymandias, more and more heart-shaking stellar black and white tentacles bloomed- the figure of Ozymandias being drowned out as these tentacles grew unfathomably huge- very quickly becoming larger than a world, a sun and continued to stretch out like a circular pulsing mass of tentacles for hundreds of thousands of miles!
Eldritch Expanse!
It showed a shocking level of initiative and control at this moment as if was far from being done!
|The Severed Weavings of Eldritch Expanse forcefully extend into the True Source Atlas of Existence and trigger Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity.|

|The passage of an instant may not be allowed without the complexity of the Eldritch Expanse undergoing a crucial, significant burst of elevation that will be supported entirely by the True Severed Heart of Infinity.| |The Limited Infinitum Weaving of Complexity had been commanded to impose its weavings on the Eldritch Expanse.|
|The Severed Weavings of Eldritch Expanse surge across Severings and head towards their Final Severed State!|
HUUUM!
The phenomenon...was unheard of.
DUM!
The Wheel overlapping the True Source Atlas of Existence turned as a colorless radiance began to flow out.
|Quintessence observes Eldritch Expanse with caution and coldness.|
|Tyranny gazes towards Eldritch Expanse with eyes of unscalability.|
|The weavings of Ozymandias are under the extreme influence of the Severed Weavings of Eldritch Expanse.|
Something was happening.
Something unexpected.
Something new!
Many of Noah's terrifying Sources rose up with care and caution as they sensed this!
Yet in the midst of all of this...
|The Weavings of Uncertainty throw their full support to Eldritch Expanse.|
|The Weavings of Plot throw their full support to Eldritch Expanse.|
|The Weavings of Entropy throw their full support to Eldritch Expanse.|
|The Weavings of Armageddon throw...|
|The Weavings of Apocalypse...|
Noah's weavings buzzed as while some cautioned, others rose in support of the First Source to bloom while the Atlas of Existence was a True Source Atlas of Existence!
The interminable authority and control that Eldritch Expanse was gaining became even more profound as quickly, its Final Severed State was obtained!

chapters.title: Chapter 3611 Channelers! IV
paragraphs: |The Severed Weavings of Eldritch Expanse have attained their Final Severed State.|
|The Pathway leading to the True Source of Eldritch Expanse has opened.|
HUUUM!

The mass of stellar black and white tentacles that had Ozymandias at the very center attained a terrifying glow- white and black flames of virulence and pathogenicity blooming over them as in the distance, the hearts of the Great Mother and others shuddered.
What was this? Just what was happening? Was this still part of the weavings of the Protagonist?

Many began to edge back unknowingly as they saw what was happening ahead, the figure of Tam of the Singed also coming from a distance as he finished clearing out the last Faceless Lifeforms in distant Pantheon, and even he looked towards the scene in shock!

Far from here, in the Megalos Ynnere where Mysara brought Emelline of the First Flame who was currently still undergoing Dual Cultivation with Noah...even their weavings were interrupted by the horrifying and foreign aura leaking out from a far distance, their will gazing out to understand just what it was.
In the midst of all this...
|The Pathway to the True Source of Eldritch Expanse gazes at the weavings of existence.|
|Eldritch Expanse gazes at the complex Flow of Existence.|
|Through the Pathway to the True Source of Eldritch Expanse, Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis has been claimed.|
|Through the Pathway to the True Source of Eldritch Expanse, Absolute Frequency Ontopathogenesis has been claimed.|
Terrifying capabilities bloomed as a pathway for something utterly glorious was made.
And right away...
|Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis has been triggered, powered by the Heart of Infinity.|
HUUM!
The stellar black and white tentacles of mass that had spread out tremendously around Ozymandias.
At this moment, they pulsed eerily as an instant later, countless thin, barely discernable tentacles barely half an inch in size shot out in all directions!
Little Aspasia and Other Outerversal Morphons backed up the moment they observed such a thing.
The Great Mother...her tentacles trembled, but she did not move a muscle.
She stayed still.
And whether it was her or other Outerversal Morphons, the moment they even saw the stretching out thin tendril, it had already reached them as it was far too fast.
WAP!
A single thin tentacle for every being.
Some were struck by a stellar black tentacle, others were struck by a stellar white tentacle.
But undoubtedly, every single one was unable to even defend against it no matter what their complexity did, and the moment their bodies were stuck by it...
They became utterly still.
HUUM!
Their bodies glowed with a faint stellar black and white radiance as their eyes and singularities opened wide, but they held no cognizance.
The brilliance in their eyes....was only that of Eldritch Expanse.

In another direction, the figure of Tam of the Singed watched with a sense of wonder and trepidation as a white tentacle struck his forehead, his head being knocked back as his pupils, which were always covered by white gold flames, turned a hazy white gold.
They blinked right after to show no emotion, and they only looked at the surroundings with calm!

Countless unfathomable stellar black and white tentacles shot out from the region where three states of Existence met, all of them stretching out across the Megalos Beyond, Megalos Nihilos, and Megalos Ynnere!
They bound onto every single complexity they came across as the ability that initiated all of this...was Unidemic!
Not Epidemic.
Not Pandemic.
But Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis.
Across the Megalos.
And not just the Megalos...with countless more thin tentacles transcending the weavings of existence and shooting out into the Expanse.
The Weavings of Eldritch Expanse proliferated in such a rapid manner as even the Megalos Ynnere...

One of Noah's bodies disconnected from Emelline of the First Flame and straightened out his robe, his expression cold as he looked at the Prime Sources Complexity before him who had just attained an Undeniable Telos Source.

Yet at this moment, her body was frozen as a white tentacle connected behind her head, her figure floating serenely without an expression as when she blinked and opened her eyes, they were covered by a hazy stellar black and white radiance.
Not the radiance of Emelline of the First Flame, but that of a part of Noah...of Eldritch Expanse!
Noah also gazed nearby where the visage of Mysara was, and she held the same state as she floated serenely, her body beginning to pulse with a unique sense of power as...

|Through Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis, all infected Complexities are being automatically redirected as they are granted the glorious distinction of the Channelers of the True Source Atlas of Existence.|
What Noah sought to do with the enactment of a new Source.
To rapidly and quickly change the Source that countless existences across the Megalos and Expanse held to that of his own!
It was being achieved at this moment, but...even after the Sources of these complex beings became Channelers of his True Source Atlas of Existence.
Even as he felt trillions of connections flow towards his Atlas as its Wheel began to conduct heavy spins of complexity...
Those he looked at remained under the effect and control of Eldritch Expanse.
The faint half an inch tentacle connecting to countless beings became transparent as if it did not even exist.
But their eyes remained flashing with a hazy black and white radiance as the singular prevailing identity and control within the affected beings...was that of Eldritch Expanse.
Noah looked into that black and white glow.
He was essentially looking at himself.
And he asked.
"What are you doing?"
HUUM!
He asked a newly born part of himself that because of the factors leading to its birth, it gained far too much cognizance as it moved based on how its Source felt.
He knew what it was doing, and yet, he still had to ask...his new System of Existence.
Eldritch Expanse!
In front of him, a deep voice came from Emelline of the First Flame.
|Complexity...Existence itself...is filled with uncertainty and contradiction.|
WAA!
The voice was deep.
The voice was his.

A part of him...with a different ideology. |All sources of conflict stem from the countless clashing ideologies and complexities across the different Flows of Existence. The Flows under this Wheel of Existence. The Flows of the Beyonder and the Omnifather under this Wheel of Existence. The Flows under the Wheel of Existence Bob and the Faceless Lifeforms stem from. We can eliminate all this conflict by taking over their flow. By controlling existence to move as we see fit. By our flow. The elimination of their flimsy ideologies and emotional complexity that make them take actions that only create unstable chaos. We can come to deny and control all of this. No uncertainty. No contradiction. Only stable chaos. Just countless, endless flows filled with certainty...under the banner of the True Severed Origin Osmontian.|
