chapters.title: Chapter 3612 Complexities and Contradictions! I
paragraphs: A part of him.
A part of him forged under the True Source Atlas of Existence proceeded to look at existence itself after waking up and deemed the countless complexity across it...to be far too unstable.

The Pathway to the True Source of Eldritch Expanse deemed that the best possible path...was to eliminate the countless ideologies and emotions that were always mixed in with the complexity of Existence as they made way for unstable chaos!
Noah gazed into the white and black glow in the eyes of Emelline of the First Flame and Mysara who held absolutely no cognizance as around him, heavy flows of budding complexity bloomed.
Above, a colorless Pathway burning with Quintessence manifested as an illusory figure with his likeness appeared, his gaze cold and calculating.
He was only the first.
Nearby, a glorious white gold Pathway burning with flames of the Singed bloomed as a Noah wreathed in flames appeared, his flames burning everything nearby with an overpowering light of brilliance!
Near this Pathway, a gorgeous blue Pathway burning with Infinity bloomed- multiple parts that made Noah blooming one after another at this moment as they all looked at each other.
The Pathway to the True Sources of Plot and Cheats also appeared as among the many different parts of Noah, there were some that supported Eldritch Expanse.
There were those who cautioned and opposed the Eldritch Expanse.

And behind Emelline of the First Flame and Mysara, a glorious black and white pathway filled with countless tentacles bloomed, another version of Noah sitting in the middle of all these tentacles as his gaze was a calm one. His gaze was a cold one.
|We all know it.|
His deep voice, filled with complexity, echoed out as intent was shared with all parts of himself.

|Ideologies and Emotions mixed in with a high level of complexity only lead to unstable chaos that leads to chaotic flows. Take a look at Azzurra. A remnant of Beyonder- a creature born from an obsession to protect, and yet she backed another Channeler of this Wheel who abandoned it and joined hands with Channelers of another Source. All for the sake of his ideology and emotions. Because of it, countless complex lifeforms in an entire Frequency of Life perished. Because of it, the Change and proliferation of countless Faceless Lifeforms took place. Unstable chaos. Uneeded chaos. If these ideologies were to be eliminated, something like this would not happen again. Everything would flow under our guidance. Our principle.|
The words of Eldritch Expanse were heavy.
He had black and white pupils and looked exactly like Noah as he looked at the other parts of him.
He gazed toward Infinity and the Megalos.
He gazed towards the Singed and Quintessence.

|We have the capability. We can stabilize countless flows and ensure prosperity that spreads not just across this Wheel of Existence but also other True Sources. Because once we get started, we cannot stop. One True Source. Another True Source...and Another True Source. The flow of the True Severed Origin Osmontian would spread across every true Source and ensure no possibility of haphazard ideologies mixing in with complexities. We...have the capability!|
WAA!
Its vision was grand.
Its weavings were heavy.
Noah, surrounded by many parts of him, walked towards the figure of Mysara whose eyes held no cognizance of her past self as he spoke calmly.

"In their current state, what difference is there between this Mysara and the Persephael whom we scorched the weavings of Existence of? Persephael is dead, but is Mysara...also not dead? If you take away what she is, would you not be taking away what countless other complexities are across frequencies and effectively be killing all of them?"
What was the difference?!
Noah asked calmly as Eldritch Expanse did not take long before replying.

|This depends on the definition of what it means to be alive. Mysara's weavings are still alive. Her Record persists. Her Record is her life. We can preserve the records of all others and prevent the actual cessation of life- the cut off and erasure of their existence and records.|
WAA!
The definition of life!
Eldritch Expanse viewed life as the accumulation and records one held- where so long as this was preserved, one was alive!
Noah shook his head at this as he replied.

"The moment you take away their ideology. The emotions that go along with their complexity, their records will stop. They will no longer be capable of enacting any more records as their Will to do so will be gone. They will just exist...but be dead inside. We would be responsible for the cleansing and deaths of countless records across countless Frequencies. How will we be any better than those we have defeated before?"
Eldritch Expanse was silent.
This part of Noah was just born, but it knew many things- as well as the fact of who was in control.
It turned and looked at Noah tenderly before it replied.

|This whole time, you have always been in control, and yet you allowed me to do this. Part of you...part of us believes in this. That there lies the possibility of this being a true path to follow. We could do this. We could be...ever so glorious.|
HUUM!
The part of him that had its tendrils spreading out across the Frequency of the End said such words as Noah was silent to this.
Above him, his part brimming with Quintessence had a cold gaze as it was the one to reply.

|As we crush any other ideologies and emotions, our ideologies will remain. Our emotions will remain. Who will be there to stifle our weavings and ensure the collapse of any ideologies across complexity? For true, absolute efficiency across existence?|
Quintessence spoke out grandly as nobody was there to answer.
Nobody.
Until the weavings of Cheats smiled and looked towards a distant place that they could all see.
|Well, one thing is clear. This Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis has allowed us to sniff out a rat of unique significance.|
WAA!
Cheats looked towards a distant place within the Expanse as all parts of Noah's weavings knew exactly what he was talking about!

chapters.title: Chapter 3613 Complexities and Contradictions! II
paragraphs: Noah looked out towards the distant place Cheats was gazing at as he remained unfettered, his gaze going towards Eldritch Expanse as he gave a light command.
"Make all Channelers here follow our True Source, but leave their weavings be. Their ideologies and emotions are their own as I do not take the Will of others."
He gave the command calmly as he began to rise up.
On the black and white Pathway to the True Source of Eldritch Expanse, his other self had a complex look as he uttered out.
|We could have been...even more Quintessentially glorious...|
It looked discontent. It seemed to still want to carry out at its will!
And at such words, Noah's eyes became sharp as he turned towards another part of him with lividity.
"Will you listen and obey, or will you revolt?!"
HUUM!
Unfathomably terrifying waves of complexity seethed around Noah, his True Source Atlas of Existence buzzing as he looked towards Eldritch Expanse coldly!

"I face countless unknown threats outside of me, I will not have conflict within my own weavings. Will you obey, or will you revolt? I can strip you down to countless minuscule particles of Dark Matter and Anti-Matter, utterly shred everything to do with Eldritch Expanse within a Mundi of Power with but a thought and build something else right after!"
His face held boundless waves of Tyranny as his weavings of Eldritch Expanse closed their eyes sadly.
They then nodded.
They then followed.
In the surroundings, Plot smacked his lips and began to disappear.
Entropy, veiled in the back, was silent the whole time as he also began to fade away.
Ultimately, the colorless Pathway to the True Source of Quintessence remained as it observed everything for a little while longer before even it faded away.

Eldritch Expanse, on his black and white brilliant Pathway, let out a pulse of radiance that traveled to the countless quintillions of thin tentacles he had connecting to countless existences as he also disappeared.
Clouded in even more darkness, the True Severed Weavings of the very concept of Existence itself buzzed with silent contemplation as it also disappeared.
A Council of different parts of Noah had formed ever so briefly and dispersed even more quickly.
Cheats still had an interested gaze as he looked at a certain location within the depths of the Expanse, even his weavings beginning to fade away.
Ultimately, the colorless Pathway to the True Source of Quintessence remained as it observed everything for a little while longer before even it faded away.

Eldritch Expanse, on his black and white brilliant Pathway, let out a pulse of radiance that traveled to the countless quintillions of thin tentacles he had connecting to countless existences as he also disappeared.
HUUM!
In the next moment, the eyes of Mysara and Emelline of the First Flame flashed before they lost their black and white luster.
"Ah, shit...what the hell happened?"
Mysara grabbed her head as if she had a horrid headache, Emelline of the First Flame doing the same as she blinked before looking around to see Noah.
She placed her hands on her chest as she felt...different.
In a way she couldn't explain.

She raised her hands as terrifying flames bloomed from her Undeniable Telos Prime Source, feeling that they were familiar to her old flames, but they carried a sense of lethality and complexity that was not there before!
"I...I felt something, but I cannot remember..."
Her Prime Source buzzed as if it was trying to remember something critical, but nothing arose as she looked toward Noah!
The Origin Singed.

Noah simply looked back at her as he knew because of their prior connection, when Eldritch Expanse made a move, the Undeniable Telos Prime Source of Emelline was not even able to react as her weavings, which were empowered by his treated the attack as if it was not an attack.
That action did not mean that the Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis was capable of ignoring even weavings of Undeniable Telos Sources, but...it could easily infect Greater Sources!
As for Prime Sources, this varied.
Depending on the Prime Source.
Depending on their power.
And he was learning this first hand as he also thought about the location Cheats was looking at where they found...a Rat!
But he shook his head at this as he spoke towards Emelline of the First Flame.
"You have your Undeniable Telos Source, and as a Channeler...you should be able to sense some changes. Can you still perceive...the flow of the Wheel?"
He was curious about the Singed.
Burnt by the Flame of the Wheel, and yet now...one of their most powerful Singed was no longer channeling through the Wheel of Existence.
At his words, Emelline of the First Flame blinked as she closed her eyes before she opened them in surprise.
"I can sense the Flow of the Wheel with much greater clarity, but..."
There was something she could not put a finger on!
Noah nodded at her words as he noted that though she was now a Channeler of a different True Source, she knew that something was different, but could never pinpoint exactly what.
"Head back to the other Singed. I will start clearing Faceless Lifeforms across frequencies soon as there a small fight for the Singed remaining."
He talked to her as if a superior was giving their follower a command.
And Emelline of the First Flame felt no dissonance from this as she nodded!
"Yes, Origin Singed."
BZZT!
Flames burned around her as she disappeared.
She left behind Mysara who looked towards Noah bashfully before she cleared her throat and spoke while blue flames surged around her.
"Sir Origin Singed! I would also like an Undeniable Telos Source!"
She had seen what he had just done as she wanted to jump on board as well, Noah shaking his head lightly with a sigh as he beckoned her over, whispering to himself along the way.
"An imperfect man...I'm just an imperfect man..."
With a glimmer of brilliance, a veil came to settle down.
And far, far from here.
In the Expanse.
BOOM!
Newly forming Strings of Existence shattered as millions of thin black and white tentacles chased after a single being.
A Rat.
An Old Man whose weavings were unfathomably vibrant- an old man discovered while Eldritch Expanse cast Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis to cover all entities across this frequency!
"Haha, I thought myself to be a learned man of the Origins of Existence, but what the hell is this?!"
Burning brilliantly with a unique Prime Source that looked to be distorted and mutated by many things.
It was an Existence that had interacted with Noah before under different power.
Under veiled weavings!
It was Ashmole...who had gained a drop of Noah's Blood within the Commonwealth!

chapters.title: Chapter 3614 Complexities and Contradictions! III
paragraphs: In the Expanse.
Millions of thin black and white strings chased after an Old Man whose weavings brimmed with a Prime Source Complexity!
He had been so deeply veiled and hidden inside small gaps of Megalos within the Expanse as even with other Prime Source complexities searching, they may have not been able to find this entity.
But Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis sought every single creature across the Frequency.
Nothing escaped its sight as this old man was discovered this way.
Ashmole!
"Hey! Do you know who I am?! How about you reveal yourself first, huh? And then we can see whether any of this should be happening. You see, I am just a Scholar of Existence..."
He spoke as his Prime Source ebbed and flowed in a unique manner.

Half black and half white garments covered him currently as even though he was visibly old, he seemed to have returned to his prime as his hair shone with lustrous black glow rapidly, his eyes twinkling with brilliance as a force existed around him which seemed...Undeniable.

It knocked away anything that came even though he was being pushed back, and at this time, another voice descended as from the surroundings, Noah's figure stepped out from the golden strings of existence.
"I know very well who you are. Did you forget about me, Alchemist Ashmole?"

The black and white tentacles pulsed and spread out all around like spears that waited to strike as Ashmole blinked and rubbed his eyes as if he couldn't believe it, pointing towards Noah with utter surprise as he laughed jovially!
"Haha! Osmont? Osmont! I thought you were dead and banished after I stopped messing around with the Commonwealth. So you are alive and well! But..."
Ashmole looked around at the terrifying bursts of tentacles that were supported by Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis.
"...this type of power here is excessive even for you, don't you think? How about we-"
"What did you do with my drop of blood?"
WAA!
Noah interrupted the ramblings of the old man.
They had made an exchange what seemed like many, many days ago when Noah was first exploring the weavings of the Commonwealth.
Who knew that all the way back then, Noah had met a Prime Source Complexity who was veiling himself to be so weak?
Hearing the question posed to him, Ashmole stopped and smiled.
"Oh, that?"
He hummed lightly as his Source did the same.
He looked around and seemed thoughtful for a second before he replied.

"I truly do study Existence. Especially anomalous Existence. You, other creatures in separate frequencies who hold a massive flow of the Wheel around them, Singed, and now...even those Faceless Lifeforms."
WAA!
As he spoke, his body undulated and gradually changed as he seemed to be many people at the same time.
Multiple faces came and went on his aged face as he smiled eerily and continued.

"I study this Existence so that I can incorporate such anomalies into myself. You were among those who helped supercharge my existence and grant me an Undeniable Telos Source, for that, I thank you. Your little drop of Blood...I was able to extrapolate many things from it, as, surprisingly, my inherent energy and complexity have been edging toward the edge of Infinity! As if I have inexhaustible waves of authority to spare...well, almost. When I lean too much into it, it turns my chimeric weavings a bit unstable. But you made many things possible for me..."
Noah's expression was cold as he listened to this being, now fully allowing him to ramble on as he was revealing quite a lot freely.
And Ashmole seemed to know this as he had a bright smile while shaking his head.
HUUM!

"Man, look at that look in your eyes...all you anomalies with a heavy flow of the wheel always have this main character syndrome. You think yourselves to be the only creatures with stories that matter across existence, and you so ridiculously downplay the existence of all others as if they don't matter at all. Even now, what do you see me as? Someone that lied to you and you are now discovering the truth as you will try to kill me? My story is more than that, you know..."
HUUM!
His existence began to buzz.
On his chest, skin faded and tore as a dazzling black nine pointed star manifested.
On this star, dazzling sockets holding jagged Gems that glimmered with the allure of Omniverses could be seen as the smile on Ashmole faded!

"I have met a few like you, Osmont. I have tried replicating their qualities with some success, but as always, there is a level of defectiveness. Impurity. You remember that? You said something about purity and how it keeps the Wheel turning...well, something along those lines, anyway. But did you know how impure someone like me is? But even I...can have a flow that makes the Wheel turn, O Lumen Emperor."
HUUM!
He called out a past distinction of Noah's as his Source emenated a unique sense of danger.
A danger exceeding even that of entities like Giuseppe!
Tentacles erupted from behind him and formed into black wings as he smiled eerily again as he spoke.

"I've taken from your qualities. From that pesky Peacemaker that keeps sending attacks my way. From a Usurper that nearly devoured a part of me. From the Lost Avatar of the Beyonder, Azzurra. From the Antideluvians...and truly, any traces of those Legends that transcended the Wheel of Existence to go to that place."
HUUUM!

"That place...I am close to it, you know? I just need to completely join or do something else to all my possibilities- all versions of me across the Frequencies, and I will be complete. Right now, you are interrupting my progress, Osmont. A day of progress as I was hurrying before the weavings of that monstrous unknown creature swallowed up this Frequency!"
His eyes flashed with power and madness.
Stability and chaos.
His Prime Source was utterly terrifying as Severed Extractor analyzed it, and Noah couldn't help but shake his head with pity.
"What a sad life you have led, Ashmole."

Your little drop of Blood...I was able to extrapolate many things from it, as, surprisingly, my inherent energy and complexity have been edging toward the edge of Infinity!
As if I have inexhaustible waves of authority to spare...well, almost.
When I lean too much into it, it turns my chimeric weavings a bit unstable.
But you made many things possible for me..."
Noah's expression was cold as he listened to this being, now fully allowing him to ramble on as he was revealing quite a lot freely.
And Ashmole seemed to know this as he had a bright smile while shaking his head.
HUUM!
"Man, look at that look in your eyes...all you anomalies with a heavy flow of the wheel always have this main character syndrome.
You think yourselves to be the only creatures with stories that matter across existence, and you so ridiculously downplay the existence of all others as if they don't matter at all.
Even now, what do you see me as?
Someone that lied to you and you are now discovering the truth as you will try to kill me?
My story is more than that, you know..."
HUUM!
His existence began to buzz.
On his chest, skin faded and tore as a dazzling black nine pointed star manifested.
On this star, dazzling sockets holding jagged Gems that glimmered with the allure of Omniverses could be seen as the smile on Ashmole faded!
"I have met a few like you, Osmont.
I have tried replicating their qualities with some success, but as always, there is a level of defectiveness.
Impurity.
You remember that?
You said something about purity and how it keeps the Wheel turning...well, something along those lines, anyway.
But did you know how impure someone like me is?
But even I...can have a flow that makes the Wheel turn, O Lumen Emperor."
HUUM!
He called out a past distinction of Noah's as his Source emenated a unique sense of danger.
A danger exceeding even that of entities like Giuseppe!
Tentacles erupted from behind him and formed into black wings as he smiled eerily again as he spoke.
"I've taken from your qualities.
From that pesky Peacemaker that keeps sending attacks my way.
From a Usurper that nearly devoured a part of me.
From the Lost Avatar of the Beyonder, Azzurra.
From the Antideluvians...and truly, any traces of those Legends that transcended the Wheel of Existence to go to that place."
HUUUM!
"That place...I am close to it, you know?
I just need to completely join or do something else to all my possibilities- all versions of me across the Frequencies, and I will be complete.
Right now, you are interrupting my progress, Osmont.
A day of progress as I was hurrying before the weavings of that monstrous unknown creature swallowed up this Frequency!"
His eyes flashed with power and madness.
Stability and chaos.
His Prime Source was utterly terrifying as Severed Extractor analyzed it, and Noah couldn't help but shake his head with pity.
"What a sad life you have led, Ashmole."

chapters.title: Chapter 3615 Complexities and Contradictions! IV
paragraphs: What a sad life he led!
Noah uttered such words as Ashmole couldn't help but look at him incredulously before he laughed, his enlarging hand holding his belly as if what was said was the funniest thing he heard.

"Man, the main character syndrome has delved itself in you more than any others. You do not have to pity my life. I have lived for cycles. I have taken many lovers and have had many children. I have lived as a peasant, and ruled as an emperor. I have worked for the Commonwealth in one Frequency, and commanded the Commonwealth in others. I have joined the Watchers of Wheelomachy in some and even waged war against Singed in others. I have lived...Osmont, I have lived!"
HUUM!

His words were resonant and filled with power as the quality of undeniability around him became even more intense, the Nine Pointed Star on his chest beginning to spin like an engine as his weavings released a devouring light that tainted and usurped anything nearby.
Noah looked at this as he shook his head.
"If you have lived this much, then it might be time for you to die, Ashmole."
In his hands, multiple statues of himself appeared. Ashmole gazed towards him coldly as at such a moment...
BZZT!
In the distance, space fluctuated as from the golden strings of existence, a figure made of light manifested.
Humanoid.
Adorned in a green gold robe.
And on his chest...a dazzling Nine Pointed Star could be seen.
What Ashmole had on his chest seemed to be a mere imitation as this Nine Pointed Star seemed genuine.
Complete.
And at this moment, this Nine Pointed Star had many Sockets that held multicolored Gems shimmering with the light of the Megalos themselves!
Noah looked at the newly appearing being calmly as he sent Severed Extractor to do its job, but he found that the entity he was looking at...was not actually here for him to study his Source!
Ashmole turned and looked towards this being coldly as he spoke with a hint of anger.
"The Peacemaker comes to join the fray? Why now? My dear Gem Master, do you anomalies share the same senses?"
The Peacemaker. Gem Master!
Noah heard this name as he raised his brows, thinking back to the weavings he had heard from another conversation he had not too long ago!
The man who appeared in the distance buzzed with weavings of a Source as it was not too clear whether he was Lesser, Greater, or Prime as it seemed to fluctuate.
He placed his hand on his chest as he looked towards Noah briefly before his gaze locked onto Ashmole!

|I came across the knowledge that the moment to make or break you had arrived. If you are to succeed, my peace might be ruined in the future, so I came back to this place that I truly did not want to return to, even in this limited capacity...to ensure your failure, Ashmole. To ensure my peace.|
WAA!
He came back.
He was here, but not really here!

Noah's eyes were luminous as when this being talked about coming back, he seemed to be talking about the very weavings of the Wheel of Existence as he should not be a native of the Prime Frequency of the End.

"Haha...at the precipice of success or failure, and the anomalies that helped me get here are appearing one after another? What, should I expect even more to come? Is that what the Wheel intends? Will it not let me have even this after eons of experimentation?!"
HUUM!

The weavings of Ashmole shook tumultuously as around his enlarging and increasingly distorted body, his faces that had been changing this whole time settled back to that of an old man as around him, stability slowly began to return.
His gaze became cold and detached as he looked at Noah and the Peacemaker.
He gave them both a sidelong glance as he spoke out impassively.

"Did you know? Every single creature under this Wheel of Existence channels through it. All their weavings. All their power. It all flows across a singular channel that is unfathomably hard to change. The Beyonder, The Omnifather...those being managed to overcome the limitations of their channels. The more straightforward forward is to be the only you remaining across frequencies. I theorized they may have stably merged with all their other selves and attained a vastly expanded channel, and they reached that place. But for me...I already have too many transmutations mixed in. If I try to fuse with even more parts of me across frequencies...everything will collapse. So tell me, O Anomalies, what is another path I could take?"
The Alchemist asked calmly as around him, millions of black and white lines seemed ready to strike.
And from the newly appearing Peacemaker, a simple white bow carved with countless runic gems appeared in his hands- this bow becoming raised as a bowstring was slowly pulled back!
Noah looked at this being that provided another viewpoint on the elevation of power that the Beyonder and a few others might have gone through as he replied to his question calmly.
"If you cannot fuse with your other selves, then you can naturally...kill them."
HUUM!
Cold, dreadful words.
And yet they caused Ashmole to smile and nod sadly.

"Yes. My other selves that I have been sharing memories with this whole time...I have ordered them all to die. Do you anomalies understand the weight of that? This...moment that will make or break me as you so said, Peacemaker, is a moment of extreme sadness filled with death. So why not just leave this old man be? After years of studying existence, I am about to change my status from a mere Channeler of Existence...to a Transcendent Channeler of Existence. Free from the influence of others, and capable of doing unfathomably more. After I attain that...I will just do my own thing. There will be no karma between us."
His body gradually became rigid and stable as even while he was finishing his speech, Noah had already unwound a Tzar Versepiercer as it shone with a heartshaking allure.
And the Peacemaker...had already pulled back a bowstring as an arrow shimmering with multicolored brilliance of multiple Megalos buzzed!
"You have lived, Ashmole. It is just time for you to die."
Noah's expression was calm as he released a Versepiercer.
And the Peacemaker gazed out coldly as he released his bowstring and supplemented.
"For my peace, you have to fail, Ashmole."
HUUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3616 Glory I
paragraphs: Bindings were unwound.
An arrow was released.
All of it went with a unique ebb and flow of the Wheel of Existence as someone like Noah who held a True Source was able to perceptively feel many more things compared to before.
Because of his True Source Atlas of Existence, he could control his own flow.
When he did dictate his flow, even if it was momentarily, the surrounding weavings of existence had momentarily turned chaotic as if an important piece of a puzzle was taken out of circulation!
A piece of a puzzle.
He never liked such an analogy of feelings like something that simply had a part to play in a grand scheme.
But this was how it could best be described as at this moment, while he released a single Tzar Versepiercer, his True Source Atlas of Existence pulsed as the heavy Wheel superimposing it spun once.
HUUM!
A single spin, but it turned everything around him black and white as his vision was able to see something else.
The Flow.

He saw everything as if it was a stretch of an endless sea of strings moving out with ancient ebbs and flows, and of those mixed inside this sea...he held a shockingly abundant rotation of a Flow around him.
A flow that shone gold in a sea of black and white.
When he made a move, he affected many things.

Then, there was the figure of the Peacemaker who was here and not here at the same time, presenting a Paradox as he saw a massive icy white blue flow around this being, even if it was lesser than his, and he then did not see it again!
As for Ashmole...
His flow was chaotic, black and white as if it held no uniqueness, but it was rising and expanding rapidly. Tremendously!
BOOM!

Nine ancient wooden Wheels bloomed around Ashmole as he was made the target at the very center, while the thin strings of Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis flung out from all directions and still sought to infect!

At the same time, from the released bowstring of the Peacemaker, glacially cold Megalos Mountains bloomed as there were nine in number, each one releasing pulses of a heavy chill as these alone were capable of freezing Lesser Sources.
The glacial mountain spun with a heavy show of glory before they suck down like hammers to nail Ashmole!
"You! Foul! Narcissists!"
HUUM!

The Nine Pointed Star on Ashmole's chest spun heavily. His weavings radiated a tremendous eruption of power that almost seemed endless- a sense of undeniability erupting out as he withstood both of these attacks coming his way.
Nine wheels converged around his figure and exploded.
Nine Megalos Mountains thrust down to pierce and destroy for peace!
Space toiled and tumbled as strings of existence snapped, a heavy impact exploding out as even before the dust could settle, millions of parasitic strings shot into the point of the explosions.
SAA!
What was revealed was a mass of wriggling complexity with many faces, some frozen over and others burned but, nonetheless, still very much alive.

A Nine Pointed Star spun in the depths of this mass as Ashmole immediately erupted with black gold waves of undeniability that blocked off the lines of Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis once more.
His power began to recover as if his existence had nearly perished and instantly been rejuvenated at the same time!
His many faces were livid as he roared.
"I can die, but I will live again!"
WAA!
With brilliance, Noah gazed coldly at this Undeniable Telos Prime Source who had survived a Tzar Versepiercer as he was about to unwind three more status.
He was about to, when he saw the flow around Ashmole instantly explode in the world of black and white to be filled with a faint multicolored allure!
And Noah could read this flow.
He could read it as he was very surprised by it, his hands stopping from unwinding the other Tzar Versepiercers as he contemplated before putting them away!
And in the next moment, the roars of Ashmole could be heard while another nine glacial Megalos Mountains thundered with precision from the stone cold Peacemaker.

"Do you know the biggest thing that I got from all the anomalies I have studied the existence of and taken from? A level of your narcissism. A level of what makes you all advance and succeed again and again! The random Epiphanies. The powering up in the middle of battle. Plans on top of plans and even more backup plans. Your flow...I have imitated it, and am perfecting it. What I wanted will not be perfect as this hurt me greatly to do, but I will tell you narcissists that as of this moment...no other Ashmoles exist across the weavings of the Wheel."
HUUM!
What he had to do was ensure that he either absorbed all parts of himself across frequencies, or that there were no other parts of himself across frequencies.

Noah looked at this being who seemed to have undertaken a heavy action, his flow that held no color before gaining rays of faint multicolored radiance and reaching levels it could not have possibly reached before as, at this moment, Noah was actually curious about the result!

He changed the course of killing and instead wanted to know if this was the same path that the Beyonder and others took- with them expanding their roles as Channelers to become True Channelers of the Wheel of Existence.
He looked at the flow of this being and the swirling brilliance it was gaining as Noah's True Source Atlas of Existence buzzed, releasing silent and invisible ebbs of flow known only to it.
Flows of the Atlas of Existence holding no relation to the Wheel of Existence!
Eldritch Expanse seemed to buzz with activity to silently mix in the Flow and infiltrate what was swirling around Ashmole- this Alchemist entirely focused on his ascension as he had no idea!
"I shall be just like you all, overcoming adversity and coming out the other side...unfathomably glorious."
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3617 Glory II
paragraphs: Glory.
Far too many sought it, and very few ever ended up achieving it.
But at this moment, after years of research and experimentation, an Alchemist became the only possible version of himself across countless frequencies of existence!
"I feel it!"
WAA!

He roared out as his weavings denied Megalos Mountains smashing into him, the eyes of the Peacemaker flashing dangerously as he became stern and seemingly was about to make a critical decision of whether to use more of his power here.
But before he did so, brilliance flashed in his eyes that stopped him.
As if he had received a feed of information from the depths of his being!
And his Bow lowered down slowly.

He looked at Ashmole, whose Undeniable Telos Prime Source looked like it was burning and undergoing a nirvanic procession, his complexity spilling out into a place it had never arrived at before as he laughed madly!
"I FEEL IT!"
BOOM!

Everything nearby shuddered a truly fantastical emergence of complexity bloomed, the visage of Ashmole being reconstructed as his source pulsed to radiate waves of complexity that could even make a Greater Source fall to their knees from the sheer pressure.
A joyous shout rang out from Ashmole as his gaze was turned up, lustrous back hair and beard showing on his face as he gazed up as if there was something only he could see.
The Peacemaker could not see it in his current state.
But Noah, burning with a light of brilliance as he had already silently entrenched a great deal of unique flows into Ashmole that he had no idea about...he could see it.
A path that Ashmole followed.
A path shooting up and connecting towards an endlessly vast flow- the reason why Ashmole's own flow had gained color and size.
At this time, this path had been expanded tens of times compared to before, as what Ashmole could channel through it was many times grander!
This was...
"A True Channeler...A True Channeler of Existence!" Ashmole roared boisterously as golden tears ran down his face.
His complexity buzzed with heaviness as around him, the sense of impurity was suppressed so tremendously that he seemed a wholly new man.
On his chest, a clear black Nine Pointed Star shone as his whole demeanor gave off a feeling of immensity.
He turned towards Noah and gave a sidelong glance to the Peacemaker as he smiled, bright white teeth burning with brilliance showing as he bowed.

"I thank you, the great contributors to my cause. None of you are used to failures if any, so this will be a good learning opportunity. I, Ashmole, stand before you now having exceeded the weavings of any common Source. Any common existence. I have become a True Channeler of Existence as already; I can feel a calling towards a place...a place where the Legends you all have only heard over the eons should be!"
His whole existence seemed to be brimming with exuberance and complexity as after he bowed, his eyes flashed with a dangerous light.
His gaze became as he seemed about to shift his entire demeanor and begin talking about revenge, but at this time...Noah turned and shook his head with perplexity as he asked.
"That's it?"
WAA!
A simple question that caused Ashmole to frown.
"Horrid narcissism until the very end. I shall start with you, Osmont. This time, I won't just ask for a drop of your blood. This time, I want it all."
He dropped all pretenses and got ready to move as opposite him, Noah shook his head with disappointment and replied.
"This...seems to not be the path that the Beyonder and others have taken, or maybe they have exceeded it. But either way, this about wraps up this little experimentation."
Utterly cold and dreadful words came from him as he began to float towards Ashmole.
He nodded to him as if letting him know he could give it a try.
"Go on. Let me see your elevated complexity."
Words of utter disregard echoed out coldly as, under the smiling eyes of Ashmole, rage began to seethe as he touched his chest.
"I will not make it easy for you, Noah Osmont. I will...?"
Ashmole stopped and looked down at his chest.
He was activating his weavings, but...why was nothing coming out?
"What...?"
His eyes shone dimly with perplexity as, in the next moment, he began to sway as he floated in the Expanse.
As if...he could not even control his body.
"What is this?!"
Confusion gave way to shock as his eyes looked up to see Noah's figure nearing him, coming to tower over him inches away as he looked down with eyes that Ashmole hated the most.
Eyes of control and majesty.
As if everything happening was solely under his calculations and control!
But this should not be.
He had exceeded himself. He had just become a True Channeler!

And yet...why could not sense any of the grandiosity he just had? Any of the tremendously wide channel he could course unlimited power through?! Why...did his unfathomably elevated Source seem so distant? As if did not even exist?!
Standing over him, Noah seemed like an insurmountable force of nature as he spoke out coldly while a tendril of white radiance unfolded from his palm.
"Channeler or True Channeler...what difference does it make if you draw from the same True Source? All one has to do...is block your access to said Source."
HUUM!
Dreadful words that caused Ashmole to raise his head with incredulity rang out.
Block access to the True Source?
The Wheel of Existence itself?
That...
"That is...impossible?"
He seemed to question even his own words as his eyes shook with incredulity and a sense of despondency.
"I did everything. I...I studied. I observed. Across cycles. Across Frequencies. All parameters, I...I..."
His lips trembled as truly, no matter how much he reached out to his complex Source, he could not reach it!
What possible explanation could there be apart from what this monstrous creature had just said?
But that...should be impossible, right?
Ashmole gazed up towards Noah.
And as if Noah could read his thoughts of impossibility, he spoke out coldly.
"In Existence, nothing is impossible."
WAA!
From his hand, the white tentacle shot out like a dagger, sinking into Ashmole's forehead as right after, his eyes became glazed with a black and white radiance!

A distance away, a Bow disappeared from the hands of the Peacemaker as he found his already transparent body began to fade away even more. His eyes buzzed with their own unique complexity as he looked up towards Ashmole, his gaze coming across the entity who had taken him down even after his feared success as such a being...was looking towards him with interest!

sentences.text: Glory.
Far too many sought it, and very few ever ended up achieving it.
But at this moment, after years of research and experimentation, an Alchemist became the only possible version of himself across countless frequencies of existence!
"I feel it!"
WAA!

He roared out as his weavings denied Megalos Mountains smashing into him, the eyes of the Peacemaker flashing dangerously as he became stern and seemingly was about to make a critical decision of whether to use more of his power here.
But before he did so, brilliance flashed in his eyes that stopped him.
As if he had received a feed of information from the depths of his being!
And his Bow lowered down slowly.

He looked at Ashmole, whose Undeniable Telos Prime Source looked like it was burning and undergoing a nirvanic procession, his complexity spilling out into a place it had never arrived at before as he laughed madly!
"I FEEL IT!"
BOOM!

Everything nearby shuddered a truly fantastical emergence of complexity bloomed, the visage of Ashmole being reconstructed as his source pulsed to radiate waves of complexity that could even make a Greater Source fall to their knees from the sheer pressure.
A joyous shout rang out from Ashmole as his gaze was turned up, lustrous back hair and beard showing on his face as he gazed up as if there was something only he could see.
The Peacemaker could not see it in his current state.
But Noah, burning with a light of brilliance as he had already silently entrenched a great deal of unique flows into Ashmole that he had no idea about...he could see it.
A path that Ashmole followed.
A path shooting up and connecting towards an endlessly vast flow- the reason why Ashmole's own flow had gained color and size.
At this time, this path had been expanded tens of times compared to before, as what Ashmole could channel through it was many times grander!
This was...
"A True Channeler...A True Channeler of Existence!" Ashmole roared boisterously as golden tears ran down his face.
His complexity buzzed with heaviness as around him, the sense of impurity was suppressed so tremendously that he seemed a wholly new man.
On his chest, a clear black Nine Pointed Star shone as his whole demeanor gave off a feeling of immensity.
He turned towards Noah and gave a sidelong glance to the Peacemaker as he smiled, bright white teeth burning with brilliance showing as he bowed.
"I thank you, the great contributors to my cause.
None of you are used to failures if any, so this will be a good learning opportunity.
I, Ashmole, stand before you now having exceeded the weavings of any common Source.
Any common existence.
I have become a True Channeler of Existence as already; I can feel a calling towards a place...a place where the Legends you all have only heard over the eons should be!"
His whole existence seemed to be brimming with exuberance and complexity as after he bowed, his eyes flashed with a dangerous light.
His gaze became as he seemed about to shift his entire demeanor and begin talking about revenge, but at this time...Noah turned and shook his head with perplexity as he asked.
"That's it?"
WAA!
A simple question that caused Ashmole to frown.
"Horrid narcissism until the very end.
I shall start with you, Osmont.
This time, I won't just ask for a drop of your blood.
This time, I want it all."
He dropped all pretenses and got ready to move as opposite him, Noah shook his head with disappointment and replied.
"This...seems to not be the path that the Beyonder and others have taken, or maybe they have exceeded it.
But either way, this about wraps up this little experimentation."
Utterly cold and dreadful words came from him as he began to float towards Ashmole.
He nodded to him as if letting him know he could give it a try.
"Go on.
Let me see your elevated complexity."
Words of utter disregard echoed out coldly as, under the smiling eyes of Ashmole, rage began to seethe as he touched his chest.
"I will not make it easy for you, Noah Osmont.
I will...?"
Ashmole stopped and looked down at his chest.
He was activating his weavings, but...why was nothing coming out?
"What...?"
His eyes shone dimly with perplexity as, in the next moment, he began to sway as he floated in the Expanse.
As if...he could not even control his body.
"What is this?!"
Confusion gave way to shock as his eyes looked up to see Noah's figure nearing him, coming to tower over him inches away as he looked down with eyes that Ashmole hated the most.
Eyes of control and majesty.
As if everything happening was solely under his calculations and control!
But this should not be.
He had exceeded himself.
He had just become a True Channeler!
And yet...why could not sense any of the grandiosity he just had?
Any of the tremendously wide channel he could course unlimited power through?!
Why...did his unfathomably elevated Source seem so distant?
As if did not even exist?!
Standing over him, Noah seemed like an insurmountable force of nature as he spoke out coldly while a tendril of white radiance unfolded from his palm.
"Channeler or True Channeler...what difference does it make if you draw from the same True Source?
All one has to do...is block your access to said Source."
HUUM!

The Wheel of Existence itself?
That...
"That is...impossible?"

I...I studied.
I observed.

All parameters, I...I..."

chapters.title: Chapter 3618 Impossibilities! I
paragraphs: The Peacemaker.

Noah gazed at such a being with a calculating expression as he placed Ashmole's dazed body beside him, the eyes of this old man shining with the black and white light of Eldritch Expanse as, at this moment, every single shred of his records, memories, and weavings were being analyzed.
Around them, golden strings of existence reformed as the white gold glow of the Expanse returned, calmness and serenity settling in as Noah spoke out nonchalantly.

"Peacemaker...I believe I've heard of your weavings from Bob. You're here and not here as you must be another Ankyra, or at the very least someone with a heavy flow that Bob was forming connections with?"
He spoke nonchalantly.

Yet his words had very clear intent as when he spoke about Bob, there was clear distaste and animosity towards him as he left no possibility of misunderstanding for the Peacemaker to look at him and question whether he was aligned with Bob.

Initially surprised by the direct mention, the Peacemaker was silent with contemplation before he nodded and replied. "Osmont. I've heard this name a few times before, the first being from the Alchemist beside you in our first meeting. As for Bob, that creature is...something to be feared."
"Oh?" Noah raised his brows as he looked at the figure of the Peacemaker that became more and more illusory.
And this being opposite him nodded as he touched the Nine Pointed Star on his chest while continuing.

"He is not alive. His Source is dead. What he draws from is dead. He has nothing to live for, and yet he is moving with such activity and complexity in these Weavings of the Wheel. He is the first enemy I have run away from for the sake of my peace...forcing me to find a new home in another True Source entirely. Once I elevate my complexity a bit more, I will come back to eliminate him for my prolonged peace. But until then..."
His eyes held a heavy complexity as he did not have any hesitation for his actions!
And Noah thought about his words.
A being that was not alive.
He was dead. The True Source he pulled from was dead.
So naturally, why would he come to a place with a vast and mighty True Source?
The answers to be extrapolated were many as each one was more dreadful than the last.
Noah shook his head as he looked at the Peacemaker, who was about to entirely disappear.
He ran from Bob due to his power as at this moment, Noah also knew his complexity was still not enough for Bob.
He didn't run because he had certain layers of protection, but he still needed a high enough complexity that when he fought this being again, it would not be so one sided!
There was a lot to be done to prepare for everything as there were Nodes, Frequencies, and Wars to clear out.
But he would be ready.
He nodded towards the Peacemaker who was giving one last gaze to Ashmole.

"This man was another thing that had me on edge, but my weavings tell me you have truly neutralized him as he shouldn't be an issue. Be careful of man. For a dead man, revival can be the only thing he seeks. But existence is balanced. Nothing dead can come back to life unless the life of another is taken in exchange. If he seeks to give life to a Dead True Source, then naturally, another True Source has to die..."
Heavy words echoed out from the Peacemaker as his visage dissipated entirely, and yet the nearby weavings of existence held no change at all as if nothing had been there to begin with!
Noah looked at such a scene with sharp eyes as he tugged on Ashmole as if he were pulling along a dog.
"What a unique existence..."
This time had provided a great deal of things and success.
First, he could effectively say that the Prime Frequency of the End...only had his True Source Atlas of Existence as the source that all Entities within it could pull from!
Countless Channelers were all connected to his True Source.
Every time they channeled...
BZZT!
The wheel of his Atlas spun as it gushed out heavy waves of Complexity.
Pristine complexity that was all directed towards the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed!

And since Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis ensured every entity was a Channeler of his True Source, his other body utilized the Primal Flame of the Wheel to do exactly what Bob had done to the Frequency of Aqua.
Channeling to the Wheel of Existence was blocked off.
A simple action, but it was one that allowed him to easily incapacitate a True Channeler who had exceeded Undeniable Telos Prime Source complexity.
And now, this entire Prime Frequency of the End was secured as he had one more alteration to make to the Node of Existence of this Frequency.
That whatever changes were done to other Frequencies connected to the Wheel of Existence, this particular Frequency would remain unaffected!
This...was just the first time and layer of protection.
Noah would leave no stone unturned as he did this to ensure that whatever Bob was doing would not result in a catastrophe here, and in the meantime, the main thing he waited for...
BZZT!
Was complexity.
He smiled as he felt a certain Mundi within his Atlas buzzing with brilliance, the Wheel of the Atlas making another turn and giving a burst of complexity to the foremost Pathway as...
|The Pathway to the True Source of the Singed has crossed the critical threshold of the halfway point to the True Source.|
Yes.
The Singed.
The Loot obtained from enemies. The Loot from Ruination and the Forge!
And now, the complexity that arose from the Wheel of the Atlas turning every second as countless entities Channeled through it!
From F-rank hunters in small worlds just coming in contact with mana and casting fireballs.
To Source Complexity Entities among the Watchers of the Wheelomachy that he was purging at this very moment to ensure this Frequency was clean!
From all of this, a road was more than half walked.
And the result of this...was indubitably glorious!

chapters.title: Chapter 3619 Impossibilities! II
paragraphs: A road was half walked as because of it...
|The Flames of the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed are able to purify and Sever all parts of your Existence up to the 54th Severing.|
Yes.
All parts of his were capable of being severed 27 times through the Singed before.
And now...this was elevated to 54!
It would be a thorough elevation all around.
An increase in complexity that would be heavy!

|Embers of the True Source of the Singed converge around you in even greater complexity and concentration as at this moment, your Embers can singe other lifeforms and transform their weavings to more heavily revolve around your flow of existence. Their complexity will be transformed, and they gain a benefit from the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed.|
More and more wonders came with his flames as the Flames of the Wheel of Existence could enact a Lineage of Singed. Now...so could he!
His own Singed of Existence.

He felt like there was much to be done as he pulled along the captures Ashmole, waves of memories surging into his mind regarding all the things across frequencies that this Alchemist did, as well as everything he knew.

As he did this, the Source of the Eldritch Expanse within him buzzed as it affirmed that Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis had spread out across the expanse, altering the channeling of the True Source of all entities it came across while those deemed enemies were currently in the same state as Ashmole!

After he finished draining out all the weavings of this Alchemist, he planned to let his vibrant complexity fall under the allure of the Pathway to the True Source of Loot. All would occur in due time.
But as he moved, he already gave the command.
"Begin the elevation of all True Severed Weavings towards the 54th Severing."
WAA!
His Atlas pulsed as a Mundi within it burned furiously.
Thereafter, fiery tendrils of white gold flames began to spread out all across his weavings of existence as burning Embers crackled, a heavy light of purification spreading out!
All weavings that had not attained their Final Severed State and opened up their pathway were about to become ever closer as everything would be purified upwards!
His Eyes.
His Wings.
The main concepts under the banner of the Conceptual System of Existence.
Uncertainty. Relativity. Continuity.
Even the very Ordinance of Existence itself that Noah was expectant of.
Existence.

If it could attain a Final Severed State and open up a Pathway to the True Source of Existence...just what would the end result be? He thought of many things and moved with a great deal of possibilities as at this moment, he felt like a hurried farmer who had to move to tend to many crops!
As flames furiously burned and elevated many things across his weavings, his other bodies continued to move.
In the junction where three Megalos met.
Ozymandias stepped out countless black and white tentacles that stretched out across the Frequency as he gazed towards the Great Mother and others who had returned to their own cognizance.
They looked towards him in shock as they could sense something was different, but they did not know exactly what!
Ozymandias looked at them as white gold flames began to burn over his hand.
"You closely followed the legend and weavings of the Beyonder as initially, I did not deny them. But now, only my weavings remain prevalent as I ask...do you wish to fully come under my banner?"
A grandiose question.
One that the Great Mother's tentacles vibrated with fervor as she was the first to bend down!
"For the Protagonist!"
WAA!
For the Protagonist, she said.

Others who already saw the terrifying power he portrayed thought about the Great Beyonder and all the things promised for the Megalos Beyond that were still unfolding as one by one...they all bent their wills towards Ozymandias!
Not the Instrument.
Not the Inheritor of the Megalos.
But Ozymandias!
In the seas of stellar black waves of radiance, Ozymandias nodded gloriously.
"Very well."
HUUM!

Flames burned furiously around his body as, at this moment, they began to wash out like cleansing flames of purification all around him- their range extending outwards as its goal was to eventually cover all of Megalos Beyond.
Ozymandias looked at this with a sense of majesty as he proclaimed.
"From this day forth, the Outerversal Morphons of the Megalos Beyond shall become the Singed of the True Severed Origin Osmontian!"
WAA!
A heavy proclamation of change.
Change that would cover all of Megalos Beyond!

They began by toughing the infinity symbol of tentacles that was the Great Mother, her stellar black appearance trembling as her complexity exploded upwards, bands of white and gold appearing around her!
It was an advent of fantastical changes.
And as such, changes occurred here.
Far from this location, in the distant Frequency of Aqua affected by Bob, another one of Noah's bodies stood beside the Queen of Matter as he called out loudly.
"Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis."
He called out lightly as around him, millions of thin white and black lines exploded, and they caused the Queen of Matter to yelp as she moved away while looking towards him in shock.

"Sir Osmont...you're a fan of tentacles too? Just what are you doing right now? I'm getting different musings from the state of matter as even they can barely make heads or tails of what is going on..."
His number one fan asked such a question as Noah watched the millions of thin black and white tentacles explode into billions as they turned invisible and stretched out across the Frequency of Aqua.
The blue waters around him gave him a sense of peace and serenity as he replied slowly.

"I am patching up all the areas that an entity with a Dead True Source is destroying. In the coming days...I will face him once again as, at that time, I do not know how many frequencies will have been affected and what all of this will boil down to. But as always...the answer is complexity. If there is a sufficient amount of complexity...even the strongest enemies can be extinguished with but a thought."
WAA!
As he said such words, he knew them to be true as did he not just defeat an Alchemist that had become a True Channeler by utilizing things the Alchemist didn't even think of!?
In all of existence, so long as the complexity was right....anything was possible.
He said such words simply, but the Queen of Matter who heard them nodded religiously before she began to write them down!

chapters.title: Chapter 3620 Impossibilities! III
paragraphs: In the grand weavings of existence, so long as one's complexity was enough...there were no impossibilities.
Noah knew this firsthand as while his existence continued scaling upwards at a rapid pace, he conducted multiple heavy actions simultaneously.

The forging of the Eldritch Expanse Source of Existence made way for the rapid spread of the usage of his True Source Atlas of Existence- where he started off with the Prime Frequency of the End and now continued with the Frequency of Aqua where Bob had altered the Node of Existence of.

Since he stopped the Channelers of this Frequency from accessing the Wheel of Existence, Noah would grant them another True Source to channel from, as this would be done without any additional changes to the Node of Existence!
He stared at the endless expanse of blue, his pupils reflecting its brilliance as at this moment, even he could not say where everything would go.
Against the foe that was Bob, entities with heavy flows of the Wheel, like the Peacemaker he had just met, were forced to temporarily leave due to the sheer complexity of this being.
He did not know how everything would unfold, but he would make sure that he would not fail.
He could not fail.
The lives of too many lay on his shoulders for him to fail!
When he thought of the countless entities entangled with him, he turned towards the figure of the Queen of Matter beside him as he spoke out while tapping with a single finger in front.
PAH!
A single tap, and yet a radiant blue portal leading into a location within an entirely different Frequency bloomed.
"Someone would like to meet you to utilize your Source in other ways."
He spoke calmly towards the girl surrounded by books as she pointed to herself and became stern, her eyes trying to peer into the portal to see what lay on the other side as she asked nervously.
"I've met the great Ruination, I've been with you, there isn't anybody as grand as....!"
Her eyes opened wide as she thought of something.
The only other wonder of Noah's that she had yet to meet.
Her face changed drastically as radiant waves of white and gold began to pulse around her as she asked in shock.
"You can't mean...no way! Apart from you and Ruination, the third and only one can only be the Spirit of Spiritual Land! The Infiniverse Dowager! Is it? Is it really?!"

Her entire weavings of existence buzzed with activity as Noah grabbed her neck as if he were grabbing a cat, flinging her into the portal before she could speak any more nonsense as yes, the Infiniverse Megalos Body had asked for the entity with the Source of Fabled Matter who could spy on and gain knowledge of anything relevant happening in the state of matter across Frequencies.
If such a capability could be applied not just for Matter, but also Anti-Matter and Dark Matter...what secrets would there be across Frequencies for them?

Such weavings became set in stone as while this occurred, Noah was also about to take another major action after he continued reading the countless memories of Ashmole that spanned across Frequencies.
A True Channeler.
Someone that had made a jump past Prime Source Complexity as after Noah was done with him, the only thing he would be was loot.
But his weavings led Noah to think of those who truly had attained a terrifying level of power that Ashmole looked up to!
He thought of the Emelline who called herself and other Singed more than just Channelers. That they were Conduits of the wheel that acted like macrophages of an immune system.
She had also called the Origin Singed a True Conduit who was unfathomably close to the Wheel of Existence itself.
Noah wondered about that being and others as at this moment, he moved to get answers.
Answers from a source that he had actually already ensnared!
Far from any set weavings of existence, far from any Frequency.
In a field of sandy gold mountains and clouds within an Amarantos Dream.
The figure of Azzurra sat atop a cloudy mountain peak as she played with the stellar sand below her in the form of a white gold gold-furred cat.
She used to be a black cat, and yet her captor using her as a spy had altered her source so much that she felt like another person entirely!
He let her be since then as she remained within this dream, and she couldn't help but pace around the golden sand below her paws as she thought of how everything would end.
"It could all end with a very positive result you know?"
She was startled to alert as the voice of Noah echoed out alongside his appearance, his figure looking towards her calmly as she hissed while jumping away just like any cat!
Noah gazed at her up and down calmly as he came to float above her, his voice heavy and filled with power as he spoke.
"I had to confirm from a True Channeler, but you seem to also be known as Azzurra, the Lost Avatar of the Beyonder. Do you know of your own identity or did your main body lock everything away?"
His words left no space for rebuttal or discussion as when she heard them, Azzurra became stern as she shook her head.
"What are you talking about? I am myself- you have probed my Source as you should know there is nothing there but me..."

Azzurra spoke stiffly but seriously, and yet Noah remained towering over her as from his chest, a heavy wheel spun as a terrifying black and white tentacle was released- instantly shooting out like a whip to smash toward Azzurra's forehead as his voice rang out!
"Let us see if she has entirely abandoned a part of her, or if I can entirely alter and take away the very Will of a part of the Beyonder!"
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3621 Impossibilities! IV
paragraphs: He was past asking nicely, and there were no more moves to be made apart from this as Absolute Unidemic Existence Pathogenesis struck out towards the Lost Avatar of the Beyonder, smashing onto her forehead as her cat-like eyes rapidly began to turn black and white!
Her Records.
Her Weavings.
All of her existence would be under Noah's fingertips soon unless...
BZZT!

An utterly horrific complexity instantly bloomed from the small cat-like body of Azzurra, Noah's black and white tentacle snapping off her forehead while his body received a heavy impact that flung him back across multiple sandy gold cloud mountains!
BOOM!
He smashed onto the ninth mountain and came to a stop, his eyes sharp as he looked ahead to see a cat floating in the air while looking around with a sense of confusion and ancientness.
The eyes of this cat eventually came to focus on Noah as they flashed with a deadly sharpness!
Noah looked back at her without so much as an ounce of fear as he dusted off sand and remnants of clouds as he asked.
"Am I talking to the Great Beyonder? In the flesh?"
He asked calmly.

And yet, in the next instant, the sandy gold mountains and clouds in this Amarantos Dream became tinged with stellar obsidian radiance- the whole landscape changing as a certain cat also transformed into the figure of a dazzling woman with black and gold robes draping over her.
Her hair shone with dazzling black and gold strands as her eyes...carried an unfathomably luminous light of existence.
"You try to alter everything about me within Dreams? My very own sandbox?"

Her voice carried tremendous undeniability and power as she appeared right before Noah, clouds of stellar obsidian gold gathering below her as she sat down, her arms hanging on her knees as in front of her- stellar black chains rose to pull Noah down in place!
She looked down akin to a queen staring at someone lesser, trillions of small Runes of Amarantos exploding around her as every landscape of this dream seemed to fall under her control!
Noah gazed at the chains binding him as well as the horrific complexity he felt above, and he found himself affirming that this...felt genuine.
This was nothing like Ashmole as his heart felt more at ease that even a trace of someone like the Beyonder could be this powerful!
He was fearful of meeting these old legends and being disappointed at the complexity they held as so far...it did not seem like this would be the case.
"I know you..."
Sitting there coldly with regality and power, the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder squinted her eyes while she looked at Noah.

"One of the kids who took my Inheritance. Have you grown up so much to try and alter the very Primeval Source of a remnant I left behind? While knowing who it was? Do you even know how much it is costing me, you, and the countless others under the Weavings of the Wheel for me to awaken even this trace Will here?"
Bound by obsidian chains, Noah looked up at the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder as from his chest...
HUUM!
A Wheel turned.
A True Source burned.
And the chains binding him began to burn and fall down like paper as his figure became unbound!
Sandy gold clouds gathered around him and elevated his figure until he was leveled with the Great Beyonder, his arms also freely hanging atop his knees as he looked at her calmly.
"Spare me any sophistry and riddles if you can. There is a creature with a Dead Source running freely across the weavings of the Wheel. Where are you? Where are those like you?"
His words were straight to the point as the Trace of the Great Beyonder frowned, looking at him up and down as she asked.
"The small half dead rat that slipped in all those years ago still has not been taken care of? Even with all the measures we left behind?"
Her frowning eyes were filled with a trace of disappointment as she looked around, her body releasing trillions of Runes of Amarantos outwards as she closed her eyes!
Noah looked at such a being as he shook his head while continuing to ask.
"Where did you all go? Why is it that you cannot even send a simple trace of your power back into the weavings of the Wheel to potentially take care of something like this?"
He had many clones. He could move around freely.

These truly powerful entities who were supposedly protecting the Wheel from harm that he and others could not fathom were not able to even send a small part of themselves to ensure things were not destroyed from within.
As he asked this, the eyes of the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder opened and looked at him coldly before she replied.
"You forcing me to appear here by itself will come at a heavy cost to my Weavings out there. I need every shred of myself just to survive. Every last shred...for all these past years."
WAA!
She spoke with deadly seriousness as even while Noah heard such words, he still shook his head and asked with a frown!
"Illuminate things for me. The more I know, the more I can help. No riddles or words of obscurity. Just what is going on?"
He wanted her to speak clearly and without any confusion.
And as if she had a limited amount of time, she looked at her fair hands and spoke out coldly.

"A True Source of Existence...a Wheel of Existence capable of supporting countless frequencies and lifeforms is rare. Very, very rare. Existence...is never so easy. Nor is it so simple to have. Out there, there are countless Dead True Sources as finding a True Source Wheel of Existence that is alive and well is unfathomable. We hold such a type of True Source. So because of this...we face an onslaught of countless Existences with dead sources seeking something. Constantly. Daily. Hourly. With every shred of what we have. The moment they notice even a small gap of concentration, they will attack it to get through as my True Weavings have just been placed in another perilous war because you forced a trace of me to appear here."

chapters.title: Chapter 3622 Impossibilities! V
paragraphs: He put her True Weavings in peril just by forcing a trace of her to come here!
Out there there were countless Dead True Sources!
Noah listened to such words as his expression flashed with a profound level of coldness.
Existence was not easy.
Weavings of Existence seemed like they were not truly all that easy to have and stabilize!
The Wheel of Existence was actually something of a rarity as outside of it, waves of countless other existences sought to enter it.
As for the reason why?
Noah was silent in contemplation, as he asked calmly.
"How long before the weavings of existence of someone with a Dead True Source collapse?"
A question he asked after some contemplation as opposite him, the figure of the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder looked towards him with a knowing gaze.

"At least you are not too stupid. Yes, the reason why so many existences throw themselves towards our Wheel of Existence is because their time is limited. With a Dead True Source, unless they have attained a tremendous level of complexity where they can live without the need of an outside True Source, their weavings of Existence will surely collapse. It is only a matter of time, and this time could be a hundred years, a thousand years, or even a million years, depending on their complexities."
Death.
As always, it came down to the complete cessation of life.

"And no, we cannot just simply allow them in or even form a process where we tell them that if they do not fight and have conflict, they can simply connect to our Wheel of Existence. Those whose complexities that are bathed with the light of a Dead True Source carry this like an infected aura around them. At the moment they connect to our Wheel of Existence, they will begin setting it on a path of no return as the more entities that connect to it, the more that they lead it to become another Dead True Source. Thus, we fought. We have been fighting. For cycles. For eons. To the point that some...grew despairing at this endless fight as they asked themselves whether they would do this for the rest of their lives. Either until they perished, or their complexities were dried enough and they simply collapsed. So some...have left."
Heavy words echoed from her long monologue as around her, the obsidian mountain of dreams she sat on seemed desolate!
After such long periods of time filled with endless battles, some left.
"The Dead Channelers keep coming. As if out there, in any nearby Weavings of Existence, only our Wheel is present. It has been endless. So...so...endless..."

Noah's eyes became stern as he listened to the words of the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder, her facial expression and eyes portraying a sense of tiredness as if she would soon join the throngs of beings who grew tired and left.
And he looked at her like this freely as she was quickly able to notice his piercing gaze, and she harrumphed!
"Hmph, I am not so weak minded as those fools who left, so you can drop your judgmental gaze. You..."
She looked at him closely and then closed her eyes as if she was looking for something else.
"Entities like you should have been able to gain access to some safeguards we left behind in case of emergencies. My Crucibles, My Instrument...you fucking destroyed it, did you not?"
WAA!
She opened her eyes to look at him with an accusatory gaze as Noah simply shrugged his shoulders!
"An enemy came for me, and I simply retaliated. There were waves of causality here and there but for the most part, that was it."
He did not have a shred of doubt about his previous actions as the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder snorted out before she uttered a rebuttal.
"Whatever it may be, we cannot leave that place. We cannot leave the Infinite Ravines. Even a Trace Will like this..."
The Great Beyonder raised her hands and looked at the body of Azzurra as she shook her head.
"A Dead True Source?"

"This alone has allowed a tricky Dead Channeler to feel the slightest changes to my weavings as they have launched another assault at the position I protect. I knew I could handle it, which is why I spared this Trace Will, but I cannot stay here too long or do much. Even this conversation cannot be a useless one! So, since you destroyed the safeguards I left behind, you have to be the one to take care of things in their place. The Dead Thing walking around within the Wheel should just be that infinitesimally small thread of a Dead True Source that passed by me and the Stellar Weaver."
WAA!
Noah's eyes flashed sharply.
"A Dead True Source?"
He heard something heavy as he had to ask!
A Dead True Source!
The Trace Will of the Great Beyonder had her immeasurably deep eyes focus on him as he asked, and she replied coldly.

"There are different True Sources out there. A True Source, regardless of the type, could theoretically survive even without a Wheel of Existence. But the Wheel of Existence is an unfathomably vast Absolute Complex True Source. Any True Source the rest of us could theoretically obtain will be a simple Existential True Source. A Source born from a concept or weaving of existence. I...have attained my True Source after guidance from the Wheel of Existence. Since you question me here so cluelessly, it means that even with your complexity, you have yet to enter...the True Frequencies of Existence that are isolated from all other frequencies of the Wheel."
The Trace Will of the Great Beyonder revealed information that for the first time...allowed Noah to smile!
"Haha!" He did not just smile, he even laughed as the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder looked towards him as if he had gone mad.
"Did my words break you, Noah Osmont?"
The Trace Will of the Great Beyonder asked coldly!
