I...have attained my True Source after guidance from the Wheel of Existence.

Since you question me here so cluelessly, it means that even with your complexity, you have yet to enter...the True Frequencies of Existence that are isolated from all other frequencies of the Wheel."
The Trace Will of the Great Beyonder revealed information that for the first time...allowed Noah to smile!
"Haha!" He did not just smile, he even laughed as the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder looked towards him as if he had gone mad.
"Did my words break you, Noah Osmont?"
The Trace Will of the Great Beyonder asked coldly!

chapters.title: Chapter 3623 Impossibilities! VI
paragraphs: He smiled and laughed freely at the words of the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder as this whole time, part of him expected tremendous disappointment from the legends whose names were mentioned across eons.
The Great Beyonder. The Omnifather. The Stellar Weaver!
They and other unknown entities were mentioned in hushed whispers as when it came to the possible power they could hold, Noah reserved his expectations after what he observed Ashmole doing.
The Advancement of the Wandering Alchemist was not one that showed him a truly deep complexity even as he stated he was going towards a place that those similar to the Great Beyonder had arrived at.
But at this moment, the Great Beyonder stated that she and others had attained their True Source!
He felt happiness at this as he also felt like...he was no longer alone.
In Existence, he was not alone in attaining a True Source.
Well, he still was an exception as he would not just have a single True Source of Existence!
Facing the perplexed gaze of the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder, Noah shook his head and looked towards her with an interested smile.
"I was just happy that I would not be disappointed by the complexities that came before me. You were talking about True Sources?"
There were different True Sources.
Ones that were far too profound and complex like that of the Wheel of Existence, and then there were Existential True Sources that entities could obtain.
The Great Beyonder attained her True Source a long time ago as she mentioned True Frequencies of Existence.
She looked towards him with a cold gaze as she continued.

"There isn't much time to waste. If that Dead Thing has recovered even a bit of its complexity, it will try to brute force its way into the True Frequencies of the Wheel. Even if it taints Common Frequencies and Prime Frequencies of the Wheel, it would still not be able to do much..."
She was speaking thoughtfully when right after, Noah stopped her as he spoke out.
"Oh, that so called Dead Thing has already obtained the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence from Hell Terra Firma."
The Trace Will of the Great Beyonder blinked as her eyes became sharp.
"What?" She asked as if she wanted to make sure she heard correctly.
BZZT!
Her figure then rose up with a sense of anger on her face as she looked towards Noah with even greater coldness, and he continued calmly once more.

"I'll rephrase that- he has obtained less than half of the Primal Flame of the Wheel of Existence from Hell Terra Firma. He is currently going around sealing the connection of Channelers to the Wheel of Existence across different Frequencies."
He gave more information regarding what was happening as the hands of the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder clenched, and she took deep breaths as her blessed chest heaved up and down.
She then closed her eyes and enunciated each of her words clearly as if she was almost at the absolute end of her patience.
"Where...is the remaining portion of the Primal Flame of the Wheel?"
Her stellar waves of dark hair pulsed.
Her fair skin shone with resplendent as Dark Matter was vibrant around her.

A unique sense of beauty surrounded her as Noah looked at her with a silent smile while he replied. "I hold the remaining part of the Primal Flame of the Wheel. Safely tucked away in a place he cannot reach."
Her eyes flashed sharply as the gaze she gave him gradually changed.
It still maintained its coldness as she uttered out through her teeth.

"The Primal Flame of the Wheel is one of the keys one could use to enter the True Frequencies of Existence. Within, the Dead Thing would have gained true access to the Wheel of Existence to do as he saw fit. If the Dead Thing is shutting off the connection of Frequencies to their existence, then he should be seeking to lower the influence of Existences across the Wheel just enough to perceive where any of the myriad True Frequencies are, and he would then gain access. This is the most roundabout way he could use, though, as I'm curious why he didn't just destroy multiple Frequencies easily..."
Her gaze was contemplative.
Opposite her, Noah waved his hands as he thought of Bob and spoke out.
"That so called Dead Thing is a sentimental and emotional one. They have said that they apparently care for the many lifeforms out there."
He spoke words even he found laughable as the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder became stern as she shook her head.

"Do not even speak to Dead Existences. Those with Dead True Sources can taint you. Alter Existence in ways you cannot fathom. Even their words are poisonous and filled with deception as some can have their own discrepancies, but they are all ultimately the same. As for you...since you hold the Primal Flame of the Wheel and destroyed the safeguards I personally put in place, you will have to be the one who stops this Dead Thing. I will also relay words to others to see if any of their safeguards are active or capable of being activated. But you...you need to enter a True Frequency of Existence. You need to follow the Flow and attain your True Source. Only a True Source can eradicate a Dead True Source."
WAA!
Only a True Source could eradicate a Dead True Source.
The Trace Will of the Great Beyonder stated such words with absolute confidence as Noah maintained his composure.
He...already had the True Source Atlas of Existence.
And he was already halfway to attaining another True Source.
And there were many more on the way!
But he didn't say any of this.
He looked towards the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder with interest as she looked back at him with a sigh before she continued, her finger tapping out and releasing a bundle of light.

"You could potentially use the Primal Flame of the Wheel if you hold the more significant portion to access True Frequencies. Or you can use the Singed as another Key. I know there was a child by the name of Ezekiel? He should know the method all the Singed could enact to open a pathway to the True Frequency of the Singed. There, you could find a viable Existential True Source to establish at the core of your existence, and the resources to nurture it. Do this, and we will continue our defenses in the Infinite Ravines..."

chapters.title: Chapter 3624 Sources! I
paragraphs: She spoke and came up with a plan so easily.
She mentioned the name Ezekiel as she said this Singed knew the methodology left behind in order to open the True Frequency of the Singed!
But...
" Ezekiel has already had his Embers of the flames returned to the Wheel..."
No one spoke with a straight face as he told Trace Will of the Great Beyonder that Ezekiel had long been dead!
The face of the dark-haired woman paused slightly at such words while Noah continued.
"His weavings were among the first collapsed by the so called dead thing, that is Bob. At this moment, the Singed are led by Emelline of the First Flame."
Emelline.
He just mentioned her name and nothing else as the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder closed her eyes thoughtfully with a silent sigh before she opened them and continued.
"Even she should still know the methodology left behind for the Singed. Connect with them and see if you can get through to the True Frequency of the Singed. As for the Dead Thing...Bob, you said?"
Bob.

The name became amplified and scrutinized in her eyes as she held her chin thoughtfully as if she were trying to remember something critical. "Bob...there were whispers of this name many, many years ago among the Dead Things that we were fighting. Some...were cautious and fearful of this name alone..."
WAA!
She pulled from the last vestiges of her memory as she uttered such words and caused the atmosphere to become even over here.
Around them, the weavings of the Amarantos Dream pulsed with a heavy ebb and flow as Noah gave a light nod.

"As much as I would like to discredit the Dead Thing that you call Bob, he is a creature with a unique level of complexity who seems like he will make things a tad bit difficult for us. I never give compliments to my enemies, but this one...has caused me a bit of a headache..."
The Patience.
The schemes.
The lack of rambling about his grand plans like a psychopath!
None of it fit the mold of the many enemies he had come across in the past as he had to make a new mold for this being.
The Trace Will of the Great Beyonder shook her head eventually as she replied.

"I will ask around more regarding this to make sure that I did not miss anything. In the meantime, do what you can to locate and enter a True Frequency of Existence. I will leave behind scattered weavings of myself within this Avatar as a trace of my cognizance should still remain, and if I need to return, I will."
This Great Entity made plans to leave already as Noah remained seated while asking in a low tone.
"The Infinite Ravines where you all are fighting...where are they located?"
He wanted more direct answers without leaving too many mysteries behind as when he asked, the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder looked at him coldly and only answered a moment later.

"When a True Source has grown complex enough to be capable of living independently from the Wheel of Existence, it will be capable of following a pull towards an exit point filled with endless weavings. The only place to go in and out of the influence of the Absolute Complex True Source. Easiest to reach them through a True Frequency of Existence. The Infinite Ravines. Without a sufficient enough complexity, you will not be able to make a trek there. As for you..."
She looked at him closely before shaking her head.
"You're still a ways off, so keep at it."
WAA!
She truly said he was still ways off!

He smiled calmly while the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder clasped her hands together, millions of Amarantos Runes returning to her as her eyes lit up with a dark light of brilliance, and she shook her head right after.

"I had spread out my weavings across nearby frequencies to see if I could locate this Dead Thing myself, but I have come back with nothing and I cannot stay here any longer than I need to. They have already begun their assault in the region I protect and with much grander intensity. All of this..."
She spread her hands out within this Amarantos Dream as she looked towards Noah.

"All of this is existence. It's ups and downs. It's good and bad. Sometimes it is fair; sometimes, it is unfair. All of it is still existence. I don't know what your motivation is for doing all the things that you have done so far, but..."
Her stellar black eyes filled with countless Runes locked with his.

"Keep at it. Don't be like those who gave everything up in the end. Don't let up. There won't be some grand reward waiting for you on the other side. There won't be groups of people waiting to congratulate you. It will feel like thankless work as you even ask yourself what you're doing everything for..."

She had been talking to him as if she was giving a speech to tell him not to give up, but halfway through it, Noah could see she became half here and half not as the same words she was giving him...felt like they were for her!
How many years had she been fighting? At a certain point, did all these great beings start to question and grow tired?

Noah sighed internally as he knew there had to be a more permanent solution than this, and he rose from his pulsing mountain peak as he looked at the complex weavings of the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder, and his deep voice echoed out.

"At the end of the day, we continue to protect the weavings of Existence, yes? There won't be others to recognize or congratulate on the work, but we all have each other. I'll be the first to congratulate and acknowledge you, the Great Beyonder, for all that you have done for the Wheel. Your contributions mattered and saved many for countless cycles, and they will save even more for the years to come.:
In front of him.
The pupils of the Trace Will of the Great Beyonder shook!

chapters.title: Chapter 3625 Sources! II
paragraphs: Her pupils shook as if she had received a great shock!
She turned silent thereafter and closed her eyes, and when she opened them again, all emotions had been swept away as she looked towards Noah.
She couldn't bring herself to say anything substantial as she could only sigh, brilliance beginning to leave her as the weavings of her Avatar returned.

"In an Amarantos Dream, it is somewhat easier. Somewhat manageable as it is an existence between false and real, and it does not take away too much from my weavings. A bit of myself will be left here as if you come across too much trouble, or even the Dead Thing is discovered; tell me."
As she said these words, the terrifying brilliance in her eyes entirely faded in the next moment as the surroundings of the dream began to return to their golden sandy brilliance.
The weavings of Azzurra returned...somewhat as she blinked and looked around, eventually settling on Noah in a daze as she voiced out.
"I am...not me..."
The Lost Avatar of the Beyonder.
She remembered everything as in the back of her mind, the presence of her true self blinked. It was still there as it could be pulled upon at any time to come back.
How did it even feel to live for eons and knowing your identity was one thing, only for all of this to change as you realized that you had an entirely different life?

Noah shook his head at this and patted the shoulder of Azzurra before his figure fell back onto vibrant golden clouds of this Dream, thinking about everything that had to be done as his figure floated serenely in this dream.
A distance away, there was a woman who continued to have a miniature Existential crisis!
Towards entirely unique weavings of existence.
Inside the Infiniverse Megalos.
"No. Fucking. Way!"
The figure of the Queen of Matter looked at the terrifyingly massive Infiniverse Vein in the form of an infinity Symbol, and the many Pantheonic Megalos Havens surrounding it as...
"How can a tiny Spiritual Land from a Beast World do this? How?!"
The Queen of Matter almost pulled her hair out as she could not believe the weavings of this place.
Everything was currently shaking and vibrating with a terrifying ebb and flow as all the things she looked at...seemed to be expanding and growing larger.
She also sensed Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter swirling together as every time they clashed, even more explosive waves of growth occurred!
"What is even happening..." The Queen of Matter was utterly dazed as she asked this, and in the next moment.

"The Infiniverse Megalos is undergoing the fastest period of growth it has ever gone through. Within this day, its density and complexity of Existence will surpass the Megalos Ynnere of this Prime Frequency of the End, and it will soon grow larger and more complex than all three Megalos and the Expanse combined as at that time, its complexity would rival a Frequency."
The body of the Queen of Matter trembled as she looked to her left.
There, the figure of the Infiniverse Megalos Body appeared grandly, a stellar white dress donned on her visage as her being shone with multicolored radiance.
The Queen of Matter fell to her knees as she floated to be right before the Infiniverse Megalos Body, her hands reaching out hesitantly as if she was before someone sacred!
"I have...I have dreamed of you. I have been obsessed with you. The impossibility of your very existence...ah!"

The books around the Queen of Matter trembled as she barely managed to utter such words, the Infiniverse Megalos Body smiling as she looked out into the constantly expanding weavings of complexity and existence.
The incorporation of Anti-Matter caused the exponential growth to kick an even higher gear, but it was not alone.

The expansion of the Severed Weavings of Manadynamics, Relativity, Dreams, Genesis, Avalon, Polarity...and the countless pillars that made a core part of its beings heavily contributed to the growth of the Infiniverse Megalos.

The more these weavings became Severed, the more they opened their Pathways towards their True Sources....the growth of the Infiniverse Megalos would explode even further as at this stage of its existence, it did not need to do what it did in its earlier stages.
Before, it had to devour the worlds, galaxies, Cosmos, and countless other weavings of its surroundings in order to become bigger and bigger.
Now, it did not need to devour Omniverse X-999 or the Megalos Ynnere or anything else in order to become more complex!
Its weavings- the weavings that Noah expanded, were leading it towards a path of self sufficiency and reliability as it did not need outside input for growth.
What it needed was itself.
And now...the Infiniverse Megalos looked towards the kneeling Queen of Matter as she voiced out calmly.

"Your Source interests me. I wish to freely observe the pertinent weavings of Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter across the Frequencies of the Wheel as I wish to study you and your source. It might be a bit invasive as-...!"
The figure of the Queen of Matter rose up while ripping her dress right off, her figure being revealed as she voiced out with an extremely serious expression!
"Dissect me as much as you wish, Ma'am!"
The Infiniverse Megalos Body looked at the valiant figure of the Queen of Matter as she nodded while keeping her words to herself.
She wondered why the most unique existences out there seemed to also be the most eccentric ones.
Did complexity slowly alter their minds and make them just a little bit crazy?
She had this thought as she beckoned towards the figure of the Queen of Matter, waves of light wrapping around them as they disappeared!
Quite a distance away from here, in the Megalos Ynnere.
A flushed Mysara donned her clothes as her body radiated the terrifying, undeniable pressure of a Prime Source at this moment.

Similar to the Queen of Matter, the Source she Channeled to was changed as she also underwent the additional weaving of Dual Cultivation on the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed, her weavings gaining a quality of an Undeniable Telos Source as her power was currently exuberant!
Near her, Noah was already adorned in a white gold Emperor's Robe as he looked towards a certain direction while voicing out.
"Let's go join your Main Body in the Prime Frequency of Flames. Wars and passageways to True Frequencies seem to go hand in hand..."

"The Infiniverse Megalos is undergoing the fastest period of growth it has ever gone through.

Within this day, its density and complexity of Existence will surpass the Megalos Ynnere of this Prime Frequency of the End, and it will soon grow larger and more complex than all three Megalos and the Expanse combined as at that time, its complexity would rival a Frequency."
The body of the Queen of Matter trembled as she looked to her left.
There, the figure of the Infiniverse Megalos Body appeared grandly, a stellar white dress donned on her visage as her being shone with multicolored radiance.
The Queen of Matter fell to her knees as she floated to be right before the Infiniverse Megalos Body, her hands reaching out hesitantly as if she was before someone sacred!
"I have...I have dreamed of you.
I have been obsessed with you.
The impossibility of your very existence...ah!"

The books around the Queen of Matter trembled as she barely managed to utter such words, the Infiniverse Megalos Body smiling as she looked out into the constantly expanding weavings of complexity and existence.
The incorporation of Anti-Matter caused the exponential growth to kick an even higher gear, but it was not alone.

The expansion of the Severed Weavings of Manadynamics, Relativity, Dreams, Genesis, Avalon, Polarity...and the countless pillars that made a core part of its beings heavily contributed to the growth of the Infiniverse Megalos.

The more these weavings became Severed, the more they opened their Pathways towards their True Sources....the growth of the Infiniverse Megalos would explode even further as at this stage of its existence, it did not need to do what it did in its earlier stages.
Before, it had to devour the worlds, galaxies, Cosmos, and countless other weavings of its surroundings in order to become bigger and bigger.
Now, it did not need to devour Omniverse X-999 or the Megalos Ynnere or anything else in order to become more complex!
Its weavings- the weavings that Noah expanded, were leading it towards a path of self sufficiency and reliability as it did not need outside input for growth.
What it needed was itself.
And now...the Infiniverse Megalos looked towards the kneeling Queen of Matter as she voiced out calmly.
"Your Source interests me.
I wish to freely observe the pertinent weavings of Matter, Dark Matter, and Anti-Matter across the Frequencies of the Wheel as I wish to study you and your source.
It might be a bit invasive as-...!"
The figure of the Queen of Matter rose up while ripping her dress right off, her figure being revealed as she voiced out with an extremely serious expression!
"Dissect me as much as you wish, Ma'am!"
The Infiniverse Megalos Body looked at the valiant figure of the Queen of Matter as she nodded while keeping her words to herself.
She wondered why the most unique existences out there seemed to also be the most eccentric ones.
Did complexity slowly alter their minds and make them just a little bit crazy?
She had this thought as she beckoned towards the figure of the Queen of Matter, waves of light wrapping around them as they disappeared!
Quite a distance away from here, in the Megalos Ynnere.
A flushed Mysara donned her clothes as her body radiated the terrifying, undeniable pressure of a Prime Source at this moment.

Similar to the Queen of Matter, the Source she Channeled to was changed as she also underwent the additional weaving of Dual Cultivation on the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed, her weavings gaining a quality of an Undeniable Telos Source as her power was currently exuberant!
Near her, Noah was already adorned in a white gold Emperor's Robe as he looked towards a certain direction while voicing out.
"Let's go join your Main Body in the Prime Frequency of Flames.
Wars and passageways to True Frequencies seem to go hand in hand..."

chapters.title: Chapter 3626 Sources! III
paragraphs: Wars and Passageways.
Noah uttered these words seamlessly as in the next instant, he tugged on the True Source Atlas of Existence, causing the distinct absence of Channeling from any outside source to manifest once more.

He could clearly sense where Emelline of the First Flame was, and his weavings honed in on their entanglement. His intention was simple, to transition from his current Frequency onto the Prime Frequency of Flames.

As this thought crossed his mind, the authority of the Administrator of the True Source Atlas of Existence pulsed. It was as if countless authorities had been activated simultaneously, and multicolored radiance enveloped both him and Mysara, swirling around them like a cocoon of brilliance.
BOOM!
And in the blink of an eye, they vanished.
In the Prime Frequency of Life.

A vast expanse lay decimated, obsidian radiance flowing across the Megalos that stretched into the void. Yet, despite the vibrant weavings that filled this place, the allure of the weavings present was...
Dead!

The more Giuseppe became acquainted with these weavings, the more he realized that the Weavings of Existence he had aligned himself with exuded the distinct essence of death- an undeniable divergence from the life they were originally meant to represent.
But under the Wheel of Existence, Giuseppe would have never achieved anything of this magnitude.
He understood his limitations.
Unlike great beings like the Omnifather or the Great Beyonder, his complexity was not sufficient to surpass his old weavings and obtain a True Source.
Yet, under the guidance of that Entity...
A True Source was guaranteed.
Giuseppe floated in a field of black radiance when suddenly, his consciousness wavered.
His vision twisted and distorted.
And an instant later, he found himself standing amidst a vast black and white sea, a stellar ocean that stretched endlessly both above and below him.
Above and below the identical stellar seas of black and white, there were swirling intricate black and white Wheels of Existence that rotated silently across the expanse.
Dead Wheels of Existence.
Giuseppe's expression grew solemn as he witnessed this eerie scene.
And then, in the next moment...
BOOM!
His existence shuddered.
A terrifying aura flooded the surroundings as the one who had summoned him made their presence known.
The Despondent One.
Giuseppe didn't need to see him to know who had called him here.
This was an entity whose authority was undeniable, whose weavings were far too complex for Giuseppe to ever comprehend.
Without turning around, Giuseppe bent his knees and bowed deeply, lowering his head in reverence.
"I recognize the Despondent One...how may I serve you?"
His voice echoed across the silent expanse.
The Despondent One.
Giuseppe knew this being by that name- the one who occasionally summoned him and others.
Even without looking, Giuseppe could vividly imagine the being's round, bald head and the tentacles for limbs that extended from its form.
It rarely revealed itself like this as most of the time, communication occurred through the intricate weavings of existence.
So why now?
For the Despondent One to appear directly...
Was something of such importance unfolding? Was it the War that was about to occur?
From the swirling black and white seas, profound waves of power emanated as the deep magnetic voice of the Despondent One echoed out.
"Your assault against the Singed...is going to fail."
Giuseppe's entire being trembled upon hearing these words.
Failure?
The Faceless Lifeforms had already reorganized. Multiple Prime Source Entities, including himself, were ready to move out!
And yet the Despondent One was certain that failure was imminent?
Giuseppe's head remained bowed, vibrating slightly with confusion and doubt. He wished to ask for clarification, but he knew better than to question the Despondent One.
Silence was his answer.
And as expected, the voice of the Despondent One echoed again, breaking the stillness.

"Since that is the case, I will grant you all a bit more power as my complexity has managed to recover further. Whether you succeed or fail matters not this time. What is required, is for their focus to be drawn to that place."
Power.
More power.
Giuseppe's body trembled, but he remained silent.
"Raise your head."
The voice of the Despondent One commanded.
Giuseppe complied immediately, lifting his head, and what he saw...left him speechless.
The black and white Wheels of Existence that were emitting unfathomable waves of death and desolation had descended from the stellar sea above.
And now, they hovered dangerously close to him.
"You will be able to channel directly and freely from both of these True Sources. Dead as they may be, they are still True Sources of Existence. With unfiltered and expanded access to them..."
HUUM!
Giuseppe felt his weavings of existence explode.
The cap that had kept him bound, a barrier he could never breach no matter how many cycles he lived...shattered seamlessly.
His complexity surged to unprecedented heights as he felt the call of an Undeniable Telos Source wrapping itself around him.
But that wasn't all.
There was...
Something else.
Something he couldn't understand.
A new level of complexity!
Giuseppe's eyes were wide as he gazed at the Despondent One, fear and awe mixing in his expression as he voiced out.
"I thank you for the opportunity and trust, Sir."
His voice was steady, but a flicker of hesitation followed as he spoke softly.
"If I may, I wonder if my partner, Azzurra, could obtain the same? It would empower us both and allow us to achieve your aims more effectively."
His tone was filled with sincerity as he asked, hoping that the one he loved could obtain the same power without enduring the heavy price he had paid.
The Despondent One, however, shook his head calmly.
His gaze shifted upward, looking at the black and white Wheels of Existence with a mixture of emotions before he responded.

"I cannot elevate the complexities of those whose weavings do not align with mine, nor those who do not trust me. Your partner's Weavings inherently don't trust me. But it does not matter. So long as I achieve what I desire, you will achieve what you desire. At that time, since your partner trusts you, you may grant her as much complexity as you wish."
The words were heavy.
They were undeniable.
Giuseppe nodded, his expression cloudy, but he did not question the Despondent One any further.
"The other Bearers of Despondency have been elevated in a manner similar to you."
The voice echoed once more.

"Go now. Begin your assault on the Singed. Success or failure is entirely dependent on you all. Even if you die though, do not concern yourself with that. You have begun to walk the path of becoming a True Bearer of Despondency. Even if your weavings were to shatter, be broken, or devoured by another, I will call them back, and I will prepare you for resurgence."
WAA!
"So fight freely, my child."

chapters.title: Chapter 3627 Sources! IV
paragraphs: Fight freely!
Giuseppe's body trembled as he heard these words, but this time, it was not from fear.
It was from the immense, immeasurable power that now flowed through his being.
A True Bearer of Despondency.
The title echoed in his mind as he prepared to take the next step.
"I will not fail you!"
He spoke vehemently towards the Despondent One who nodded with a calm sense of apathy, and the stellar weavings Giuseppe found himself in disappeared.
Soon enough, he found himself back where he floated before, but his Complexity was unfathomably much greater.
He raised his fist as it caused the surrounding weavings to tremble, feeling like even a Prime Source Complexity like him in the past could only take a few strikes of his current power!
"You okay?"
Near him, the voice of Azzurra rang out as she appeared, her eyes slightly unfocused as if she was thinking about something else as Giuseppe couldn't help but smile when he saw her.
"Yeah. I...I was just given new directives by the One We Follow. Things seem to be a little difficult as he had to be involved again."
He spoke about the Despondent One without mentioning too many things as Azzurra nodded. And Giuseppe continued. "I have to set off right now, but wait for me once more, okay?"
He looked at her with deep care as Azzurra seemed concerned while she asked.
"You're off to fight against the Singed already? What about Osmont? What if he interferes?"
She asked out of genuine care!
But the weavings of Giuseppe pulsed at the mere mention of Noah Osmont as he harrumphed.
"I wish he would make himself present again! This time, he won't be able to stand so freely against a True Bearer of Despondency!"
WAA!

His expression carried a sense of lividity and power as he exploded out with Complexity, his expression heavy as he kissed Azzurra's forehead and began to disappear. "Do not worry, this battle won't be as dangerous as it seems. Success or failure aren't the true determinants of victory as we simply need this battle to occur."
His voice slowly faded alongside his weavings of existence.
Across distant weavings within this same place, many Faceless Lifeforms also began to disappear- with some entering massive Dark Towers that hummed like vessels!
Azzurra was left behind with a complex expression as in her eyes, the Runes of the Amarantos Dream flickered.
In the Prime Frequency of Flames.
Gorgeous colored flames danced freely all around, the temperature being akin to that of multiple suns constantly shining miles away from each other as those who could exist here were a powerful few.
Noah appeared within such weavings alongside Mysara as he had a smile on his face, having received new waves of information from Azzurra.

"It seems that Bob can freely hand out power-ups, too. And he simply wants this war to happen regardless of the results...a diversion while he continues altering Nodes of existence, or something else?"

He wondered of the schemes continuing to unfold from that being as he took the hand of Mysara who was breathing in the flames while humming happily, their figures disappearing right after as from a single step...
PAH!
They manifested in a region filled with powerful lifeforms, alongside a massive Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel shining brilliantly!

Ahead of them, Singed of different types were moving with power and purpose as they looked to be preparing, some already grouped up in specific squadrons as nearest to the massive burning Flame of the Wheel...the visage of Emelline of the First Flame turned towards their direction in shock.
The body of Mysara shimmered as clone and main bodies joined each other, scorching blue flames of an Undeniable Prime Telos Source burning around her as she looked towards Noah.
"Sir, are you going to unveil yourself to all Singed?"
Her eyes shone with vibrant luminosity as she asked what she believed to be a critical question.
Yet Noah only shook his head while turning around to gaze towards the far distance.
"There won't be time for anything like that. Let's see what this war amounts to..."
In the distance.

Black radiance began to spread amidst the scorching flames as massive Dark Towers broke past crimson gold scorching flames- making their arrival here in a grand fashion as alongside their appearance, the auras of multiple terrifying Prime Sources bloomed!
Massive Faceless Lifeforms. Glimmering Dark Towers.

They all seemed to hold a vile sensation of death as at the forefront, three Faceless Lifeforms burning with an undeniable brilliance stood beside a Faceless One with a very unique muscular figure that looked more humanoid than others.

His gaze was piercing as even while he adorned the suit of the Faceless Lifeforms again; he was distinctly different as he looked around the moment he appeared- gazing at the burning waves of life of the Singed in the far distance of this flaming Expanse!
And among the Singed he saw...he managed to see the eyes of a calm figure staring back at him.
Giuseppe naturally recognized Noah's unrelenting visage.
"YOU!"
HUUM!
The visage of Giuseppe was unfathomably bright and carrying billowing waves of black and white radiance as an Undeniable Prime Telos Source burned around him- his gaze undoubtedly locked onto Noah.
He pointed towards him with fervor as even without waiting for others, illusory black and white Wheels bloomed and began to turn behind him as he surged forward!
"I want to see if you can stay still this time! I! WANT! TO! SEE!"
WAA!
This terrifying figure barreled down like an unstoppable force of power.
And on the other side, Noah's gaze was calm as he was-...!
He frowned as instantly, his weavings became different, and black and white brilliance flashed around him.
|Your weavings have subtly changed.|
|Ordo Ab Chao has subtly shifted your Existence as you transition from the Cycle of Ordo to the Cycle of Chao.|

Such a thing made him sentimental as when he looked towards the rushing Giuseppe and the thousands of powerful Source Complexity Faceless Lifeforms behind him, alongside three massive ones radiating a light of an Undeniable Prime Telos Source that seemed devilishly powerful...

|In this Cycle of Chao, the complexity of your weavings obtains Absolute Infinitum Penetration, allowing the output of your complexity to scale up by 250,000% between the set parameters of 1,000% to 1,000,000%. In exchange, the complexities of others can also damage your weavings by the product of a fourth of the Complexity Scale of 250,000%.|
His weavings of existence changed at a critical time.
But even then...his eyes only brightened as he adapted to the change his eyes looking at the terrifying Complexity Scale of 250,000% from Absolute Infinitum Penetration!
His weavings were already terrifyingly complex.
And if his output of complexity was further multiplied by 250,000%...
He breathed in the flames around him calmly.
Flames.
A Prime Frequency of Flames where fiery heat filled everything.

Such a thing made him sentimental as when he looked towards the rushing Giuseppe and the thousands of powerful Source Complexity Faceless Lifeforms behind him, alongside three massive ones radiating a light of an Undeniable Prime Telos Source that seemed devilishly powerful...
He raised his hand towards them all as he called out.
Just to test things. Just to see.
"Fireball."
The Pathway to the True Source of the Singed seethed.
HUUUM!
The True Source Atlas of Existence vibrated.
Existence trembled.
The light years of Expanse of the Prime Frequency of Flames began to shake and tumble!
And instantly.
Before Noah and the Singed.
A terrifying ball of flames- a horrific sun that bloomed to cover half of the endlessly massive Prime Frequency of Flames bloomed!
A Fireball that painted half of an entire Frequency...bloomed!

Such a thing made him sentimental as when he looked towards the rushing Giuseppe and the thousands of powerful Source Complexity Faceless Lifeforms behind him, alongside three massive ones radiating a light of an Undeniable Prime Telos Source that seemed devilishly powerful...
He raised his hand towards them all as he called out.
Just to test things.
Just to see.
"Fireball."
The Pathway to the True Source of the Singed seethed.
HUUUM!
The True Source Atlas of Existence vibrated.
Existence trembled.
The light years of Expanse of the Prime Frequency of Flames began to shake and tumble!
And instantly.
Before Noah and the Singed.
A terrifying ball of flames- a horrific sun that bloomed to cover half of the endlessly massive Prime Frequency of Flames bloomed!
A Fireball that painted half of an entire Frequency...bloomed!

chapters.title: Chapter 3628: Existence Can Be Ridiculous! I
paragraphs: Complexity was an interesting thing.
Depending on its utilization, one could achieve stupendous effects- but even these effects had limitations.

One could conjure Megalocides, Megalos Mountains, Strings of Existence, and countless other manifestations of existence, with some relying purely on raw power as all of this complexity could be collected into the body and expressed through sheer physicality alone.
Giuseppe walked such a path.

His body was the vessel that channeled the entirety of his complexity. A single step or punch from him could unleash the power equivalent to Megalos Mountains, Megalocides, or any other myriad conjured forms of attacks.
All of this fell under the realm of normal.
And then, there were anomalies.
Anomalies who stacked multiple, absurdly complex factors together to achieve utterly dreadful and incomprehensible weavings of existence!
[Fireball] was a unique F-Rank Modus Operandi from a world that empowered its lifeforms with the ability to manipulate Mana and conjure a ball of flames.
A round, glowing ball of flames.
Fairly straightforward.
Fairly simple!
Yet, such a simple, F-Rank methodology of power, when wielded by an F-Rank Hunter or by an anomaly with a True Source Atlas of Existence, could yield astoundingly different results.

The result this time was observed under the eyes of many, and it was one that caused even the most complex existences, at the stage of Undeniable Telos Prime Source, to question what they were witnessing!
From the tap of a hand, aimed toward thousands of powerful Faceless Lifeforms, each carrying variations of Lesser, Greater, or Prime Sources...Fireball was called out.
Emelline of the First Flame, watching from a distance, saw it.
Mysara, standing beside the anomaly who cast Fireball, saw it.
Thousands upon thousands of powerful Singed, who were present, saw it!

They witnessed the brilliance of a crimson-gold sphere of flames that pulsed with intense waves of heat. The flames released waves of heat all around that surged like a relentless tide, crashing against the bodies of these beings!
Beings who were composed of fire themselves, and yet, their very existences, regardless of complexity, were forced to acknowledge one thing.
'It's hot!'
The Singed felt the heat.

And their eyes trembled as they saw, from the point where Noah was floating, an incandescent flame extending outward, stretching for uncountable millions upon millions of light-years across the Expanse of the Prime Frequency of Flames and beyond any Megalos.
A scorching sun had bloomed.
It engulfed the Faceless Lifeforms.
It surged toward the charging Giuseppe.

And it extended even further- so far that even if they couldn't fully observe its reach, the one who conjured this Fireball felt the outer edge pulse at the very boundary of observable existence of this Prime Frequency!
HUUUUM!
An incandescent fireball bloomed, covering half of a Prime Frequency.
Those caught inside it- designated as enemies, were now facing waves of complexity so dreadful that even the most powerful entities could barely comprehend them.
The complexity belonged to a man who held many, many True Severed Weavings of Existence.
A man who wielded a True Source Atlas of Existence and had access to the Pathways of True Sources linked to multiple concepts.
Complexity that stemmed from the Pathway to the True Source of the Singed- a pathway more than halfway to becoming its own True Source.
And all of this was further amplified by 250,000% in its output.
The result was catastrophic.
A mere second after the manifestation...
"OOOOH!"
"AAAH!"
"NO!"
Faint, brief screams echoed, filled with shock and horror.
For a second.
The briefest of a second.
And after that... silence.
A complete cessation of any noise or complexity within the ball of flames that continued to cover half of the Prime Frequency.
All Dark Towers.
All Faceless Lifeforms.
Even Giuseppe, who had been pulsing with an Undeniable Telos Prime Source backed by two dull White and Black Wheels of Existence...
All of them were incinerated.
Not even ash remained.
Noah knew this. He could feel it.
Every lifeform that fell under the Fireball was gone.

Yet, amidst the chaos, he had precisely designated the Faceless as the only enemies affected by its complexity. Across the half of the Prime Frequency of Flames that was engulfed, Noah sensed trillions upon trillions of other flame-based lifeforms that were untouched. For them, there was no destruction. They merely felt...a rise in temperature.
Within the same fireball that had incinerated Prime Source Complexities in a mere second, flame-based lifeforms blinked and looked around, wondering why it had suddenly gotten a bit hotter.
Beside Noah, Mysara rubbed her eyes, her gaze fixed on the blazing sun that still burned in the distance.
It remained.
A flaming sun whose edges stretched beyond her sight, tendrils of fire dancing across its surface with unwavering stability. It did not waver or fluctuate. It simply remained.
Mysara extended her complexity outward to search for the army of Faceless Lifeforms that had just appeared.
But...
She could not feel anything.
They were gone!

In the far distance, Emelline of the First Flame stood with a spear burning with a small Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel. Her body radiated an Undeniable Telos Source as she had been preparing for war.
A Holy War for the Singed against the Faceless Lifeforms burning with a Dead True Source that sought to infect and taint their Wheel of Existence.
She had rallied the Singed for such a grand war as when their enemies arrived...
She spread her senses outward to confirm.
Nothing.
All their enemies had been erased.
And as far as the eye could see, a burning sun covered the entirety of the Prime Frequency of Flames- extending infinitely outward in a certain direction.
It did not plan to fade away.
The Singed gasped, their weavings churning.
Their eyes weaved and locked onto the figure who had nonchalantly tapped out to conjure this Fireball.
They sensed the utter complexity of the flames. Even a single tendril of it felt more pristine than all the flames enveloping their own existences!
The flames covering half of the Prime Frequency of Flames felt as complex and sacred as the Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel burning near the Singed.
They could not help but feel their very existence shudder as their eyes locked onto one man.
The man who stood at the center of it all!

chapters.title: Chapter 3629: Existence Can Be Ridiculous! II
paragraphs: One man floated before the burning ring of a vast sun that silently blazed, its weavings smoldering as if they had no intention of fading away.
A light nod followed as he surveyed the results, his eyes flashing with brilliance as prompts filled his vision.
|A Lesser Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Existence has been obtained from the collapsed Weavings of the Lesser Source Complexity, Tukrux.|
|A Lesser Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Existence has been obtained from the collapsed Weavings of the Lesser Source Complexity, Thrulgen.|
|A Greater Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Existence has been obtained from the collapsed Weavings of the Greater Source Complexity, Chumars.|
|An Undeniable Telos Prime Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Existence has been obtained from the collapsed Weavings of the Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity, Giuseppe.|
|An Undeniable Telos Prime Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Existence has been obtained from the collapsed Weavings of the Undeniable Telos Prime Source Complexity, Madhaed.|
|An Undeniable Telos Prime Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Existence has been...|
The prompts came by the thousands.

The True Severed Weavings of Loot burned gloriously. Even though, like the Infiniverse Megalos, he was gradually becoming self-sufficient and capable of supporting his own rapid advancement, it did not mean he would refuse loot from external sources.
If they presented themselves, he would gladly take them.
Since the days when he was merely an F-Rank Hunter first utilizing Fireball, the exhilaration of acquiring loot had never left him!

With the Severed Affix of Burnt Weaver confirming no remaining Faceless Lifeforms in the gradually forming Map of the Prime Frequency of Flames, he turned to Mysara while his body floated toward Emelline of the First Flame and the others.
"Let's go."
He was utterly nonchalant about it all.
The war that Bob had orchestrated, whether it was merely a scheme to divert attention or something layered with complex plans they had yet to perceive, had been ended in a single second.

Whether this was a setback or a step forward, he would discover in due time. For now, as he floated toward the Singed who gazed at him with awe and reverence, his focus shifted toward the Loot Boxes as he called one out.
A dazzling, multicolored square box materialized before him.
Its allure was painted with a radiant glow of gold, inscribed with symbols of golden infinity signs and adorned with musings of wealth that others could only dream of.
It reminded him of the Treasure Caches of the past as the moment the Loot Box appeared, it spun with glorious waves of golden light!
Then, with a resounding explosion of fireworks, the top of the box burst open, releasing an array of dazzling Loot.
|17x Undeniable Telos Purified Source Pearls have been obtained from the Undeniable Telos Prime Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Giuseppe.|
|A Torn, Scattered Record of an Unknown Dead True Source has been obtained from the Undeniable Telos Prime Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Giuseppe.|
|The Records of the Weavings of Giuseppe have been obtained from the Undeniable Telos Prime Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Giuseppe.|
|Scorched Remnants of an Existence Isolator Armament have been obtained from the Undeniable Telos Prime Absolute Infinitum Loot Box of Giuseppe.|
Waves of wonder erupted as dazzling singularities of Undeniable Telos Purified Source Pearls burst forth, accompanied by other marvels that raised Noah's brows.

He absorbed them all into himself and began perusing their weavings as he floated through throngs of Singed who looked upon him and the distant flaming sun with profound reverence. They instinctively made way for him, some bowing their heads with fervor and respect.
Noah and Mysara seamlessly arrived before a dazed Emelline of the First Flame with Noah offering her a calm, steady smile before asking softly.
"The late Ezekiel seemed to have known the methodology to access a path into a True Frequency of the Wheel. Do you or the remaining Prime Source Singed know it as well?"
He did not mention the Faceless Lifeforms he had just reduced to ash, nor did he speak of their complete incineration. Instead, he asked for what he had truly come here to find.
In a daze, Emelline of the First Flame shook her head before pointing toward the massive Wisp of the Flame of the Wheel behind her.
"We may not know much regarding that, but the Embers of Ezekiel were returned to the Sacred Flame here. They should contain his records..."
WAA!
Noah's eyes gleamed with anticipation as he nodded, his gaze shifting toward the vibrant Flame in the distance!
Away from the Weavings of the Prime Frequency of Flames.
Inside the weavings of an Amarantos Dream.
Noah sat atop a flowing mountain of sandy gold clouds, gazing at a scene displayed before Azzurra.
It was the scene that had unfolded in the Prime Frequency of Flames- a scene where Giuseppe, someone close to her for many years as a Lost Avatar of the Beyonder, had been reduced to nothingness.
Azzurra's eyes were clear as she silently watched the blooming sun that had engulfed Giuseppe and incinerated him, along with thousands of other Faceless Lifeforms.
She closed her eyes afterward as Noah waved his hand, clearing the illusory scene.
Giuseppe...was gone!
This fact was undeniable as after offering her silent respects, Azzurra reopened her eyes, speaking softly with acceptance.
"Since I stem from the Great Beyonder, all other weavings are false. Any entanglements I had... are false. It is right that things ended this way."
Her obsidian-gold robe only magnified her desolate beauty. Her dark hair shimmered as she placed her hand gently on her chest and continued, her tone heavy with melancholy.

"I can feel her... I can feel me, more and more. My weavings of the Expanse. Of the Megalos Beyond. Of the Outerversal Morphons. But what I thought I had in Existence, none of it remains. Only Legends across Frequencies. Apart from that, I have nothing. Absolutely nothing."
Her words carried a deep sense of desolation and self-deprecation as if the weavings of her existence were overlapping, tangled, and fragmented with all of herself, including the Great Beyonder.
Noah could only sigh as he looked at her, shaking his head softly.
"Since I have altered your weavings and connected you to me, you will always have me."
Words of solace for an entity who blinked and gazed up at Noah.

The weavings of Azzurra and the Great Beyonder in the unfathomable Infinite Ravines seemed to overlap and become one entity, the shared sense of loneliness between them stretching to unbearable levels. And in that moment, Noah, the only tangible figure in her existence at this moment apart from endless battles of Dead Things...became a warm flame that the weavings of the Great Beyonder gravitated towards!
In the Amarantos Dream, Azzurra, the Great Beyonder, looked up at Noah's visage as he raised his brows at her actions. Her voice, barely above a whisper, echoed out.
"You will always be there?"
Her eyes, glowing with the vibrant Trace Will of the Great Beyonder, sought assurance in these endless weavings of existence.
And Noah simply nodded.
"I do not foresee my weavings collapsing anytime soon so...yes, I will always be here."

His words were like havenly water descending upon a desolate flower in a desert of loneliness. The weavings of the Great Beyonder moved closer toward him within the Amarantos Dream as Azzurra floated toward him, her obsidian gold robe falling away to reveal a fantastical visage underneath!
A veil of the Amarantos Dream rose around the region, obscuring anything that could possibly be happening beyond as the weavings of two beings intertwined!
